summary: Clearwater Analytics' 2026 Insurance Investment Outsourcing Report found third-party managed general account assets rose 23% year-over-year to $5.5 trillion, with insurers increasingly turning to outside managers for private-markets expertise.

headline: Convex Group launches Kinetic, a new technology-enabled specialty MGA
summary: Lloyd's-focused insurer Convex Group unveiled Kinetic Insurance Services, a wholly owned managing general agency built to trade specialty and niche lines using Convex's underwriting technology, with UK regulatory approval secured.

headline: Singapore's AI scribe tool spreads across the country's public hospital clusters
summary: Note Buddy, an ambient AI documentation tool built with Microsoft and Synapxe, has expanded beyond SingHealth to Singapore's other public healthcare clusters, with thousands of clinicians now using it to cut charting time.

headline: Corgi Insurance teams up with Silicon Valley Bank to embed startup coverage into banking relationships
summary: AI-native commercial insurer Corgi struck a partnership with Silicon Valley Bank so SVB's startup clients can access Corgi's digital insurance and risk-management tools directly through their banking relationship.

headline: Arca Wealth raises $48.5M to rip out legacy software from over $1B of RIA roll-ups
summary: Arca Wealth secured fresh growth capital to migrate the firms it has acquired onto a new AI-driven technology stack, though some industry critics argue the model is a repackaged version of an existing RIA consolidation playbook.

headline: LPL Financial's $2.7B Commonwealth deal and Osaic's CW Advisors buy headline a wave of mega RIA mergers
summary: Two of the largest wealth-management M&A deals in years closed within weeks of each other, with LPL Financial absorbing roughly 2,900 advisors and $285 billion in assets from Commonwealth Financial Network, while Osaic picked up Boston-based RIA platform CW Advisors and its $13.5 billion book.

headline: Wells Fargo debuts Advisor Gateway with AI-generated portfolio commentary
summary: The new tool gives Wells Fargo advisors on-demand client proposals and real-time portfolio analytics, including a generative-AI "Auto Commentary" feature built on BlackRock's Aladdin Wealth platform.

headline: Homeowners insurance premiums projected to climb 16% cumulatively through 2027
summary: Even after a moderation from the sharp increases of 2023-2024, U.S. homeowners can expect continued rate hikes over the next two years, while auto insurance relief is expected to be limited mostly to the safest-rated drivers.

headline: Florida governor touts rate relief for Citizens Property Insurance policyholders
summary: Governor Ron DeSantis announced that state insurance reforms are translating into meaningful premium reductions for Citizens Property Insurance customers starting at spring renewal.
source_name: Florida Executive Office of the Governor

headline: Private equity-backed Vistria buys specialty MGA Lumen to expand into niche underwriting
summary: The deal gives Vistria a platform to grow in the fast-expanding specialty managing general agent segment, which continues to draw private capital drawn to its asset-light, fee-based economics.

headline: Gallagher's wholesale unit RPS buys Kansas MGA Med James as consolidation of general agencies continues
summary: Risk Placement Services' purchase of the wholesale broker and MGA is part of a broader trend of large brokerages snapping up managing general agencies to expand specialty distribution reach.

headline: Cigna's leadership handoff becomes official as Evanko takes the CEO seat from Cordani
summary: Brian Evanko formally became Cigna's chief executive on July 1, succeeding David Cordani, who moves into the executive chair role after nearly three decades leading the insurer.

headline: Ardonagh Group launches Axiiem to digitize specialty insurance placement
summary: UK broking group Ardonagh unveiled Axiiem, a new digital trading platform meant to connect data, distribution and underwriting capacity so brokers and carriers can place specialty risks faster and more transparently.

headline: Colorado shifts workers' comp claims reporting to new EDI 3.1 standard for carriers and TPAs
summary: Colorado's Division of Workers' Compensation moved its electronic data interchange requirement to the newer EDI 3.1 format in July, requiring carriers and third-party administrators to update claims-submission systems.

headline: UK's new Pension Schemes Act rewrites the rules for workplace DC saving
summary: The Pension Schemes Act 2026 has become law, creating a trustee duty to offer default retirement-income solutions for defined-contribution savers and setting new scale requirements for multi-employer default arrangements from 2030.

headline: Retirement-plan TPA consolidation continues as Fiduciary Services Group buys Pension Investors Corp
summary: The parent of DWC – The 401(k) Experts is absorbing a Florida-based administrator overseeing about 900 retirement plans, folding the business into its existing TPA operations.

headline: IRDAI's one-hour cashless claim mandate shows uneven compliance across insurers
summary: India's insurance regulator's rule requiring insurers to clear cashless pre-authorization within an hour is now being met in about 87% of cases, per 2026 regulatory data, with some insurers still lagging on turnaround times.

headline: Retirement giant Voya draws renewed takeover interest
summary: Voya Financial, which manages roughly $350 billion in retirement assets, is reportedly fielding ongoing acquisition interest from suitors including Principal Financial, underscoring continued consolidation appetite in the defined-contribution recordkeeping business.

headline: UnitedHealth stock jumps after insurer tops estimates and lifts its 2026 profit forecast
summary: UnitedHealth shares surged roughly 10% after the company beat quarterly expectations and raised its full-year earnings outlook, with executives citing improving medical-cost trends.

headline: Insurers keep piling into private debt despite tighter spreads
summary: AllianceBernstein's latest insurance-investor commentary argues that private debt remains attractive for insurers matching long-duration liabilities, even as compressed illiquidity premiums make manager selection and structuring more important than ever.

headline: PBGC's swelling $62 billion surplus stokes a push to cut pension premiums
summary: A widening surplus at the Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation is fueling pressure from plan sponsors and advocacy groups to reform single-employer premium levels, which critics say no longer match the agency's shrinking risk exposure.

headline: Recordkeeper JULY expands executive bench with two senior hires
summary: JULY Business Services promoted Blake Willis to president of retirement services and hired Josh Bulgin as its first chief commercial officer, part of a leadership build-out to support the firm's next phase of growth.

headline: Samaritan-MultiCare tie-up in the Pacific Northwest edges toward regulatory sign-off
summary: The planned combination of Oregon's Samaritan Health Services and Washington-based MultiCare Health System, which would create an 18-hospital system, is moving through state regulatory review with an August timeline for next steps.

headline: Cincinnati Financial misses earnings as combined ratio worsens to 100.8% in Q2
summary: The insurer's underwriting profitability deteriorated by nearly six points from the prior year, partly due to a rise in catastrophe losses, leaving second-quarter results short of analyst expectations.

headline: AI-focused MGA Mile Auto expands with acquisition of Insurance House
summary: The combined operation now serves more than 55,000 policyholders through roughly 1,600 independent agencies across ten states, adding scale to Mile Auto's technology-driven underwriting model.

headline: Amwins adds occupational-risk specialist MGA Jackson-Lloyd to its portfolio
summary: The wholesale giant continues to build out niche underwriting capabilities through bolt-on acquisitions, this time picking up a specialty MGA focused on occupational loss protection.

headline: LIC installs a new finance chief and risk officer weeks ahead of quarterly results
summary: India's Life Insurance Corporation named Shatmanyu Shrivastava as chief financial officer and Varadarajan Muthuvenkataraman as chief risk officer effective July 28, 2026, rounding out its finance and risk leadership just before its Q1 FY27 earnings.

headline: UK annuity rates climb to their highest in nearly two decades
summary: Standard Life reported that annuity rates for a healthy 65-year-old rose to roughly 7.75% in July 2026, an 18-year high, as insurers keep passing through elevated gilt yields to retirees converting pension pots into guaranteed income.

headline: Insurers start rolling out policies to cover damages caused by AI systems
summary: As businesses adopt AI more aggressively, insurers and MGAs are launching new specialty products designed to cover losses and liability arising specifically from AI system failures and errors, filling a gap left by traditional coverage.

headline: Baylor Scott & White's health plan retreats from Texas Medicaid and ACA markets, cutting 321 jobs
summary: Baylor Scott & White Health Plan is exiting the individual marketplace and Medicaid managed care business in Texas by the end of August, eliminating 321 positions as it refocuses on Medicare Advantage and employer coverage.

headline: Wellstar Health System cuts 761 corporate jobs in one of 2026's largest health-system layoffs
summary: Georgia-based Wellstar Health System eliminated 761 corporate and administrative roles, about 2% of its workforce, while stating frontline clinical staff were not affected.

headline: Kaiser-backed Risant Health loses its founding CEO as Ryu steps aside
summary: Jaewon Ryu is stepping down as CEO of Risant Health, the Kaiser Permanente subsidiary that acquires and operates nonprofit hospital systems, with retired Presbyterian Healthcare Services chief Dale Maxwell taking over on an interim basis during a national search.

headline: Shareholders clear the way for Corebridge and Equitable's $22 billion tie-up
summary: Stockholders of both Corebridge Financial and Equitable Holdings voted overwhelmingly to approve their all-stock merger, moving the combined retirement, life and asset-management platform - projected at roughly $1.5 trillion in AUM - closer to a year-end closing.

headline: Canadian insurer Definity beats earnings estimates even as its combined ratio ticks up
summary: Definity's operating net income rose over 10% year-on-year to C$118 million in Q2, outperforming forecasts despite a modest deterioration in underwriting margin.

headline: CNO Financial raises 2026 profit guidance after a blowout annuity quarter
summary: CNO Financial Group's operating earnings per share jumped 45% year-over-year in Q2 2026 on record annuity premiums and fixed indexed annuity growth, prompting the insurer to lift its full-year earnings outlook by roughly 8% at the midpoint.

headline: Spanish insurer Mapfre buys a 38.9% stake in digital insurance distributor Tuio
summary: Mapfre agreed to take a significant minority stake in Tuio, a specialist digital insurance distribution platform built around advanced AI capabilities, deepening the insurer's push into tech-driven distribution.

headline: Sovereign wealth fund Mubadala takes full control of $27.7B RIA Evoke Advisors via MAI Capital
summary: MAI Capital closed its purchase of Los Angeles-based Evoke Advisors, marking what's reported as the first time a sovereign wealth fund has taken full ownership of a major North American wealth manager, with Mubadala pledging $5 billion in growth capital over three years.

headline: Elevance Health rolls out an AI-driven cancer-care coordination program
summary: Elevance Health launched an enhanced oncology support model that pairs predictive analytics with certified nurse navigators to steer cancer patients toward the right care and cut avoidable hospital stays.

headline: FDA fast-tracks review of a rare-disease drug that could change care for a devastating bone disorder
summary: The FDA granted priority review to garetosmab for fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva after a phase 3 trial showed it significantly cut abnormal bone growth and flare-ups, a decision hospitals treating this ultra-rare condition are watching closely.

headline: Mumbai to host 14th India Wealth Management Forum with focus on succession, AI and cross-border wealth
summary: The August 12 gathering will bring together CEOs, family-office leaders and advisers from India, Singapore and the UAE to discuss next-gen wealth transfer, HNW insurance and AI adoption in advisory practices.

headline: Federal marketplace crackdown set to strip coverage from up to 1.8 million ACA enrollees
summary: A batch of Trump administration ACA marketplace rules takes effect August 25, tightening eligibility verification, ending some special enrollment periods and cutting DACA recipients from subsidized coverage, though litigation could still block parts of it.
source_name: Georgetown Center on Health Insurance Reforms

headline: Pacific Life Re inks a third Japanese block-reinsurance deal with a Tokio Marine unit
summary: Pacific Life Re completed its third asset-intensive block reinsurance transaction with Tokio Marine & Nichido's Anshin Life, absorbing in-force whole-of-life policies to help the Japanese insurer trim long-term interest-rate risk.

headline: Pooled employer plans nearly double as recordkeepers chase small-plan growth
summary: The number of employers using pooled employer plans for 401(k) or 403(b) coverage jumped almost 45% year-over-year to nearly 10,800, per the 2026 PLANSPONSOR Recordkeeping Survey, with many recordkeepers now naming PEPs a top strategic priority.

headline: Global insurance TPA market revenue jumps $32 billion as AI-driven claims automation takes hold
summary: A new market report credits the surge in outsourced claims administration to insurers adopting AI-based automation and scalable TPA platforms, projecting continued double-digit growth through 2030.

headline: Molina raises profit guidance as Medicaid costs steady, but keeps shrinking its ACA book
summary: Molina Healthcare bumped its annual earnings forecast after Medicaid trends stabilized in the second quarter, even as it plans to pull roughly $1 billion of premium out of ACA exchange markets in 2027.

headline: Private capital keeps building stakes in life insurers and annuity platforms
summary: Recent deals such as Avocet Partners' purchase of EMC Life and Aquarian Holdings' acquisition of Brighthouse Financial show private capital sponsors' continued appetite to acquire or partner with life and annuity platforms as the convergence between life insurance and private capital deepens.

headline: Global life and health insurance M&A values surge even as deal count holds flat
summary: Milliman's 2026 review found the number of announced life and health insurance M&A transactions worldwide held steady at 85 deals in 2025, but total deal value jumped roughly 150%, with private capital-backed buyers remaining prominent.

headline: NAIC's life and annuity committee convenes at August summer national meeting
summary: The NAIC's Life Insurance and Annuities (A) Committee is scheduled to meet August 12 at the Summer National Meeting, where regulators are expected to continue work on annuity suitability and disclosure standards.

headline: Industry group pitches a centralized clearinghouse to stop 401(k) plan-hopping losses
summary: Retirement Clearinghouse proposed a centralized system connecting recordkeepers so small retirement balances automatically follow workers who change jobs, aiming to curb the cash-outs and lost accounts common across a typical career's 12-15 job changes.

headline: McKinsey: US retirement industry nears an inflection point as decumulation accelerates
summary: McKinsey analysis finds the defined contribution system is approaching a tipping point as baby boomer withdrawals increasingly outpace younger workers' contributions, pushing recordkeepers and asset managers to rethink decumulation products.

headline: Federal auto-enrollment rules for new retirement plans expected imminently
summary: Treasury and IRS rulemaking on SECURE 2.0's mandatory auto-enrollment requirements for new 401(k) and 403(b) plans is expected soon, guidance plan sponsors have awaited since the mandate took effect.

headline: Plan sponsors face a year-end deadline to true up SECURE 2.0 paperwork
summary: Many employers have operationally adopted SECURE 2.0 provisions through recordkeepers and payroll providers without formally amending plan documents, and the compliance grace period requiring documents to match practice closes December 31, 2026.

headline: Selective Insurance raises investment income guidance after 18% Q2 gain
summary: Selective Insurance Group's after-tax net investment income rose 18% year over year to $119 million in the second quarter, prompting the insurer to raise its full-year net investment income guidance to $480 million from an original $465 million target.

headline: Most insurers plan to raise private-asset allocations over the next year, survey finds
summary: Goldman Sachs Asset Management's 2026 global insurance survey found 62% of insurers plan to increase private-asset allocations, with a net 38% planning to add asset-backed finance exposure within their general accounts.

headline: S&P flags rising, and riskier, private credit exposure inside insurer portfolios
summary: S&P Global Ratings estimates insurers now supply roughly 23% of private credit capital, with some private-equity-affiliated life insurers exceeding 15% of assets in the category even as default rates tick higher.

headline: Altruist targets August for general release of its AI financial-planning agent
summary: Altruist is expanding early access to Hazel, an AI agent that compresses an roughly 18-hour financial-plan build into minutes, ahead of a general launch targeted for August priced from $50 per advisor seat monthly.

headline: Advisor360 debuts an AI-native operating system for wealth advisors
summary: Advisor360 launched a new AI-native platform aimed at consolidating advisor workflows, part of a broader wealthtech push to embed generative AI directly into planning and portfolio tools.

headline: Catastrophe bond issuance hit a record $18 billion in first half of 2026
summary: Artemis.bm reports 83 144A and private catastrophe bond transactions came to market in the first half of 2026, a new half-year notional record, as insurers and reinsurers lean further on capital markets for risk transfer.

headline: Wildfire risk pushes catastrophe bond sales to fresh records
summary: Insurers are issuing catastrophe bonds tied to wildfire exposure at a pace approaching all of 2025's total, transferring more climate risk to capital markets investors as wildfire seasons intensify.

headline: P&C carriers widen adoption of AI vendors for underwriting and claims
summary: A roundup of technology usage across the property and casualty sector highlights insurers increasingly deploying AI-driven underwriting, telematics and claims tools from vendors including Cytora and Nauto.

headline: Cyber insurers say AI-native attacks haven't yet produced a claim, but AI-assisted fraud keeps rising
summary: Resilience's midyear cyber report found human error still drove 85% of incurred losses in the first half of 2026, with no confirmed losses yet from fully autonomous AI attacks, even as AI-enhanced phishing and deepfake fraud attempts continue climbing.

headline: Chubb installs new dual leadership atop its Tempest Re reinsurance arm
summary: Chubb named James Wixtead executive chairman and promoted Michael O'Donnell to president of Chubb Tempest Re effective August 1, with O'Donnell assuming day-to-day operating responsibility for the global reinsurance business.

headline: Westfield Specialty hires AIG veteran to lead Nordic distribution push
summary: Westfield Specialty appointed Nicole Preis, formerly a senior client and broker engagement director at AIG, as Head of Distribution for the Nordics, part of the specialty insurer's continued European expansion.

headline: US insurance agency M&A volume falls to a seven-year low
summary: North American insurance agency acquisitions dropped to 292 deals in the first half of 2026, down 15% year over year, with P&C agencies accounting for 68% of transactions as buyers pulled back.

headline: Marpai targets positive cash flow this month after adding 192,000 TPA and PBM member lives
summary: Health-tech TPA and PBM operator Marpai said it expects to turn cash-flow and EBITDA positive beginning August 2026 after securing commitments for roughly 192,000 new member lives rolling out through January 2027.

headline: Acrisure unifies 13 specialty MGAs under new Asero Insurance Services brand
summary: Fintech-insurance group Acrisure launched Asero Insurance Services to bring six of its 13 US program administrators, which together underwrite more than $1 billion of premium, under one brand spanning commercial auto, property and workers' comp lines.

headline: Visa partners with French insurtech Neat to embed insurance in card experiences
summary: Visa and Neat formed a partnership to embed insurance products directly into Visa card experiences, part of a broader industry push to build protection into the payment moment rather than sell it separately.

headline: Global regulators publish AI governance question bank for insurers
summary: The International Association of Insurance Supervisors released a member-only supervisory question bank on AI governance and risk management, reflecting regulators' growing focus worldwide on responsible AI deployment across insurance and fintech.

headline: Sapiens taps CFO Paul Wheeler as next CEO to lead AI-native push
summary: Insurance software vendor Sapiens announced a planned leadership transition naming CFO Paul Wheeler as CEO Designate, with Executive Chairman Mike Ettling continuing to support the AI-native evolution of the company's platform.

headline: Insurtech funding stays soft, but AI deals keep pushing round sizes higher
summary: Crunchbase reporting finds overall insurtech venture funding remains down from prior peaks, but AI-driven deals are pushing round sizes higher, with the year-to-date median round rising to $30 million from $16.5 million a year earlier.

headline: Sompo backs UK insurtech Zego with $28 million to build Japanese telematics insurance
summary: Japanese insurer Sompo Holdings invested in a $28 million funding round for UK digital motor insurer Zego, partnering to bring usage-based, telematics-rated motor insurance products to the Japanese market.

headline: PBM reform wave forces Caremark and peers to overhaul pricing practices
summary: Federal PBM reform actions in 2026, including an FTC settlement requiring Caremark to adopt changes that lower patients' out-of-pocket costs and improve transparency, mark a structural shift toward cost-plus and pass-through pricing models.

headline: CMS restricts Medicare Advantage plans from reopening approved hospital admissions
summary: Under its 2026 final rule, CMS bars Medicare Advantage plans from rescinding previously approved inpatient hospital admissions except for fraud or clear error, and requires faster turnaround on prior-authorization appeals.

headline: Ambient AI documentation tools cut hours of charting time at major health systems
summary: Intermountain Health cut time spent on visit notes by 27% using Microsoft's Dragon Copilot, while Cooper University Healthcare and a nursing team at Mercy in Missouri each reported saving more than an hour of documentation time per shift.

headline: Vizient projects 8% jump in healthcare IT spending for 2027
summary: A roundup of health IT news notes Vizient forecasts an 8% increase in healthcare information-technology spending next year, as systems continue investing in AI-enabled clinical and administrative tools.

headline: 401(k) elective deferral cap rises to $24500 for 2026
summary: The IRS increased the annual elective deferral limit for 401(k) and similar plans to $24,500 for 2026, requiring recordkeeping platforms and plan sponsors to update contribution systems and participant communications.

headline: Commercial P&C pricing keeps softening as insurer profitability improves
summary: Analysts expect commercial insurance conditions to keep favoring buyers in 2026 as stronger insurer profitability and increased competition slow premium growth, even as catastrophe exposure remains elevated.

headline: US wildfire activity running well above historical average in 2026
summary: More than 42000 fires had burned upward of 4.5 million acres across the US by July 2026, about 130% of the ten-year average, as wildfire's share of insured catastrophe losses keeps climbing.

headline: RIA M&A on pace for busiest year yet as market nears $4 trillion
summary: Cerulli Associates reports RIA consolidation is driving deal activity toward a record pace in 2026 as the independent advisory market approaches $4 trillion in assets.

headline: Chubb names James Wixtead executive chairman of Chubb Tempest Re
summary: Chubb announced leadership changes at its global reinsurance arm, Chubb Tempest Re, naming James Wixtead executive chairman as part of a broader round of executive moves across Chubb, Marsh and Aon.

headline: New CAA and DOL rules expand disclosure duties for TPAs and PBMs
summary: The Consolidated Appropriations Act of 2026 and a proposed DOL rule extend compensation-disclosure requirements to third-party administrators, PBMs and stop-loss insurers servicing self-funded health plans, with plan sponsors on the hook if service providers fail to comply.

headline: UnitedHealthcare to exit some Medicare Advantage PPO plans affecting 600000 members
summary: UnitedHealthcare said it will pull out of certain Medicare Advantage PPO plans as new CMS marketing rules take effect October 1 2026, raising switching risk for affected enrollees amid broader industry benefit pullbacks.

headline: Hospital sector braces for federal funding cuts after a period of financial recovery
summary: Fitch Ratings says the tone across roughly 222 not-for-profit hospitals and health systems has turned more cautious as a multi-year financial recovery meets incoming federal policy cuts and an aging population.

headline: Allianz to buy UOB's asset management arm for about $433M
summary: Allianz Global Investors agreed to acquire United Overseas Bank's asset management unit for roughly S$555 million, part of a push by the German insurer's CEO to expand its footprint across Southeast Asia.

headline: AI is collapsing life insurance underwriting times from days to minutes
summary: Insurers report straight-through processing rates climbing from roughly 10-15% to 70-90% in AI-enabled underwriting operations, with decision times dropping from three days to as little as three minutes in some cases.

headline: Recordkeepers still lag on integrating multiple student-loan repayment match programs
summary: A 2026 PLANSPONSOR survey found only about a fifth of recordkeepers let plan sponsors choose among multiple student-loan repayment match programs, with roughly a third offering none at all.

headline: Equitable Holdings posts strong Q2 organic growth across retirement and wealth
summary: Equitable Holdings reported $1.7 billion of net inflows in its Retirement business and $2.0 billion of advisory net inflows in Wealth Management for the second quarter of 2026, alongside continued inflows at AllianceBernstein.

headline: Majority of insurers plan to grow private credit exposure despite rising defaults
summary: A 2026 survey found more than half of insurers expect to increase private credit allocations over the next one to two years even as a tracked index of private-credit loans showed default rates climbing to 2.73% in Q1 2026.

headline: Wealth Enhancement acquires $592M Chicago-area RIA Miramar Capital
summary: Wealth Enhancement Group announced the acquisition of Northbrook, Illinois-based Miramar Capital, an independent RIA managing more than $592 million in client assets.

headline: Advisors plan more M&A and new services in 2026 survey finds
summary: WealthManagement.com's RIA Outlook survey found firms are planning increased M&A activity and expanded service offerings, including tax and estate planning, through the rest of 2026.

headline: American Family to acquire Bowhead Specialty in $1.2B all-cash deal
summary: American Family Mutual Insurance agreed to buy the remaining shares of specialty casualty and professional liability insurer Bowhead Specialty for about $1.2 billion, or $34 per share, deepening a partnership dating to Bowhead's 2020 founding.

headline: Gallagher's RPS unit acquires Kansas MGA Med James
summary: Arthur J. Gallagher's wholesale brokerage arm, Risk Placement Services, acquired Overland Park, Kansas-based managing general agency Med James, expanding its program and binding-authority footprint.

headline: NatWest partners with Uinsure to launch instant home insurance and a policy tracker
summary: NatWest launched an exclusive partnership with insurtech Uinsure offering home insurance quotes in under 60 seconds plus an in-app tracker that flags better-value cover, after research found roughly half of homeowners hadn't reviewed their policy value in a year.

headline: Banking infrastructure startup Increase launches FDIC-member bank for fintech builders
summary: Increase launched a chartered FDIC-member bank aimed at giving fintech companies more direct and reliable access to core banking infrastructure.

headline: BrokerTech Ventures names 2026 accelerator cohort of nine insurtech startups
summary: BrokerTech Ventures selected nine startups for its 2026 accelerator, each receiving $50000 in seed funding and access to BTV's broker and carrier network to pilot their technology.

headline: India's Bima Sugam digital insurance marketplace targets phased September launch
summary: IRDAI's long-delayed Bima Sugam platform is rolling out in phases, starting with motor insurance in July, health insurance in August and term life products by September 2026, as insurers complete technology integration.

headline: Intermountain Health cuts documentation time 27% with Microsoft's Dragon Copilot
summary: Intermountain Health scaled Microsoft's Dragon Copilot ambient AI to more than 2500 clinicians, who saw a 27% reduction in time spent on notes per appointment based on Epic usage data through December 2025.

headline: Australian MGA Hutch Underwriting Launches AI Tool That Quotes Broker Submissions in Minutes
summary: Hutch Underwriting launched an AI service called Dawn that reads broker submissions in any format, prices the risk, and automatically uploads a bindable quote into the broker's management system, starting with strata and professional-indemnity lines.

headline: Singapore Fintech Funding Jumped 78% in Early 2026 as Investors Chase Bigger Checks
summary: Fintech funding into Singapore-based companies rose 78% year-over-year in the first quarter of 2026 to roughly $160 million across 14 deals, with capital consolidating into fewer, larger rounds such as payments infrastructure firm Tazapay's $36 million extension.

headline: India's IFSC finance hub switches on a formal licensing regime for managing general agents
summary: The International Financial Services Centres Authority's new Managing General Agents Regulations, 2026, which set capital, governance, and binding-authority requirements for MGAs acting on behalf of foreign insurers in India's IFSCs, took effect in early June, giving global carriers a regulated route to delegate underwriting there.

headline: UK holds pension auto-enrolment thresholds steady while a government panel flags a savings gap
summary: The Department for Work and Pensions kept 2026/27 automatic-enrolment earnings thresholds unchanged, even as the Second Pensions Commission's interim report estimates around 15 million working-age Britons are undersaving relative to target retirement income.

headline: India's pension regulator loosens NPS exit and withdrawal rules for subscribers
summary: PFRDA notified amended regulations governing exits and withdrawals under the National Pension System, part of a broader push this year to give NPS subscribers more flexibility, including easier fund transfers and liquidity options against their balances.

headline: Duck Creek Buys Underwriting Startup Send to Build an Agentic Insurance Platform
summary: Insurance software provider Duck Creek Technologies acquired Send Technology Solutions, an AI-native underwriting orchestration engine, to link policy administration with agentic underwriting workflows in what it describes as the industry's first combined offering of its kind.

headline: ACA Marketplace Enrollment Drops Sharply After Enhanced Subsidies Expire
summary: With pandemic-era enhanced ACA subsidies gone as of January 2026, total marketplace enrollment fell roughly 12% year-over-year to about 19.2 million by February, with the steepest drop-off among higher-income enrollees now facing the return of the subsidy 'cliff.'

headline: Jensten Group deepens its Scottish push with a deal for Glasgow broker Kelvin Smith
summary: UK consolidator Jensten Group agreed to buy Glasgow-based Kelvin Smith Insurance, its third Scottish acquisition of the year, continuing a rapid build-out of its presence north of the border pending regulatory sign-off.

headline: UnitedHealth Group Posts Big Earnings Beat, Raises 2026 Profit Outlook
summary: UnitedHealth Group reported second-quarter 2026 results well ahead of analyst expectations, with operating earnings climbing to $8 billion and a materially improved medical-cost ratio, prompting the insurer to raise its full-year adjusted earnings guidance as its margin-recovery strategy takes hold.

headline: US Regulators Miss Their Own Deadline to Finalize Stablecoin Rules Under the GENIUS Act
summary: The one-year statutory deadline for federal agencies to complete detailed rules implementing the GENIUS Act, the US stablecoin framework, passed without finished regulations, even though the OCC, FDIC, Treasury and other regulators had issued proposed rules in a last-minute push.

headline: Aviva writes another large UK pension risk-transfer deal, this time for Aston Martin's scheme
summary: Aviva completed a roughly £180 million bulk purchase annuity buy-in covering around 540 pensioners and 1,050 deferred members of the Aston Martin Lagonda Pension Scheme, continuing its run of UK defined-benefit de-risking transactions.

headline: Chubb posts stronger underwriting profit in the second quarter as its combined ratio improves
summary: Chubb reported second-quarter 2026 net income of $2.85 billion, with property-casualty net premiums written up 3% and its combined ratio improving to 83.8%, underscoring continued underwriting discipline even as broader industry pricing softens.

headline: Empower posts record quarterly earnings as its retirement and wealth business keeps scaling
summary: Empower reported second-quarter 2026 base earnings of $332 million, up 34% year-over-year, with assets under administration surpassing $2.1 trillion and strong net inflows across its workplace retirement and personal wealth units.

headline: Vizient Forecasts Healthcare IT Spending to Jump 8% in 2027
summary: Supply-chain data firm Vizient's summer 2026 outlook projects hospitals will boost spending on IT hardware, software and cybersecurity by roughly 8% in 2027, outpacing overall healthcare inflation as health systems keep investing heavily in technology and AI infrastructure.

headline: Raymond James lures a $5.4 billion Comerica advisory team to its employee channel
summary: Three veteran wealth advisors who together managed about $5.4 billion left Comerica, recently absorbed into Fifth Third Bank, to join Raymond James's employee advisor unit in Newport Beach, California, part of a wave of large team moves reshaping the independent channel this year.

headline: US home insurance claim costs hit an all-time high even as claim frequency falls
summary: A new LexisNexis home insurance trends report finds that average claim severity jumped roughly 26% year-over-year and is up more than 90% since 2019, its highest level in seven years, as rebuilding costs outpace a decline in how often claims are filed.

headline: TPG-Backed Broker Third Wave Adds Five Gulf Coast Firms, Building Out In-House Plan Administration
summary: Third Wave Insurance, backed by private equity firm TPG, agreed to acquire five insurance and benefits-advisory agencies across Louisiana, Mississippi and Florida. Analysts framed the deal as being less about scale and more about giving the roll-up its own employee-benefits plan-administration capability.

headline: Advisor Alternatives Platform CAIS Raises $170M, Tops $2 Billion Valuation
summary: CAIS, which gives independent financial advisors access to alternative investments, closed a $170 million Series D led by Vista Equity Partners with support from Carlyle, Blue Owl and other institutional investors, pushing its valuation above $2 billion and lifetime funding toward $600 million.

headline: Claims-AI Startup Curant.ai Closes $3.1M Seed as Insurers Seek Enterprise-Grade Automation
summary: Utah-based Curant.ai raised a $3.1 million seed round led by Diagram, with participation from Humania Insurance and Element Ventures, to expand a platform that automates claims adjudication and data extraction for insurance carriers.

headline: AIA Singapore Rolls Out Digital-First Benefits for Over a Million Corporate Members
summary: AIA Singapore unveiled upgrades to its group insurance plans, including specialist clinic visits without a GP referral, digital pre-authorization submissions, and round-the-clock teleconsultation, aimed at improving healthcare access for corporate members amid rising medical-inflation concerns.

headline: 401(k) industry keeps building toward alternative-asset investing as DOL rulemaking plays out
summary: Following the White House push to widen retirement-plan access to private equity, private credit and other alternatives, recordkeepers, asset managers and advisers are preparing infrastructure even though plan sponsors remain cautious about fiduciary and litigation exposure.

headline: Florida storm damage tops $1.5 billion as underpaid-claims complaints mount statewide
summary: Recent storms have driven insured losses in Florida past $1.5 billion, with policyholder advocates reporting a surge in disputes over claims they say insurers are settling for less than the actual cost of repairs.

headline: India's Insurance Regulator Moves Toward Permanent Licensing for Health TPAs
summary: IRDAI issued its formal response to industry feedback on proposed amendments to the rules governing health-claims third-party administrators, signaling it will proceed with a shift to perpetual TPA registration subject to annual fees and compliance, while shelving a proposed TPA-listing framework for later.

headline: India's Newgen Software Hands CEO Role to Longtime COO Tarun Nandwani
summary: Newgen Software, an Indian enterprise-software provider widely used by BFSI clients, promoted chief operating officer Tarun Nandwani to CEO for an 18-month term following the departure of longtime chief Virender Jeet, and created a new Chief Growth Officer post for Pramod Kumar.

headline: EU's toughest AI Act rules for high-risk systems officially kick in, with insurers in scope
summary: As of August 2, 2026, the European Union's AI Act provisions covering high-risk AI systems become legally binding, requiring insurers and other financial firms using AI in underwriting or claims decisions to meet new documentation, risk-management, and registration obligations unless a proposed delay is formally adopted in time.

headline: DBS poaches a Standard Chartered veteran to run its India wealth franchise
summary: Singapore's DBS Group has hired former Standard Chartered banker Nitin Chengappa to lead its India wealth management business, betting on rising demand for tailored products from the country's newly rich.

headline: 360 ONE WAM aims to capture a quarter of India's ultra-rich families
summary: India's 360 ONE Wealth, which already serves close to 10% of the country's ultra-high-net-worth market, is targeting a 12-13% share and eventually hopes to reach roughly a quarter of the nation's 40,000-45,000 ultra-wealthy families over the next several years.

headline: Amwins more than doubles its worldwide catastrophe coverage facility for renewable energy risks
summary: Wholesale broker Amwins Global Risks expanded its natural catastrophe facility to $50 million per placement, up from $20 million, broadening the coverage beyond severe convective storms to earthquake, flood, wildfire, and windstorm risks for renewable energy projects globally.

headline: Report Finds Health Insurers Still Struggle to Personalize Wellness Programs
summary: An industry analysis found many health insurers' wellness and prevention programs remain built on broad demographic segments rather than individualized behavioral and health data, leaving a gap between insurers' stated ambitions for personalized member engagement and what they currently deliver.

headline: Data Firm H1 Teams Up With Novo Nordisk to Speed AI-Driven Clinical Trials
summary: Healthcare data company H1 announced a partnership with pharmaceutical giant Novo Nordisk to apply AI tools to clinical development, aiming to accelerate how the drugmaker identifies researchers, trial sites and patient populations.

headline: Brazil Explores Bringing India's Narayana Health Hospital Model Into Its Public System
summary: Brazilian President Lula met with Narayana Health chairman Dr. Devi Shetty to discuss a possible BRICS-backed partnership that would apply India's low-cost, digitally enabled hospital management approach to Brazil's public healthcare system, potentially involving the New Development Bank.

headline: Jackson Financial signals openness to buying a life insurer to diversify beyond annuities
summary: Jackson's incoming CEO Don Cummings indicated the company is open to acquisitions or block deals involving life insurance liabilities as it looks to diversify its business mix beyond its core annuity franchise.

headline: Allianz expands its Asian asset-management footprint by buying UOB's fund unit
summary: Allianz Global Investors agreed to pay roughly $433 million (S$555 million) for United Overseas Bank's asset management arm in Singapore, part of Allianz's push to grow its presence in Asia under its current CEO.

headline: Mubadala-backed RIA giant Corient snaps up $21 billion ultra-wealthy specialist Summit Trail
summary: Miami-based aggregator Corient has agreed to acquire New York's Summit Trail Advisors, a registered investment advisor overseeing roughly $21 billion for ultra-high-net-worth families, with the deal expected to close in the third quarter.

headline: Ascensus Wraps Up Purchase of Retirement-Tech Administrator AmericanTCS
summary: Retirement services giant Ascensus, which administers roughly $930 billion in assets, closed its acquisition of Pittsburgh-based AmericanTCS, adding trust, custody and workflow-automation technology used by third-party administrators, advisers and plan sponsors.

headline: Federated Insurance to Buy Trucking-Focused Insurtech HDVI
summary: Mutual insurer Federated Insurance is acquiring HDVI, a Chicago-based managing general agent that underwrites and services commercial auto coverage for mid-size trucking fleets across roughly 25 states; deal terms were not disclosed.

headline: Indian Insurance Marketplace InsuranceDekho Hires New Group CFO
summary: Online insurance aggregator InsuranceDekho appointed Rohan Mittal, a finance executive with nearly two decades of experience across listed and high-growth companies, as its new Group Chief Financial Officer to oversee capital strategy as it enters its next growth phase.

headline: Gallagher expands into Canadian digital tenant insurance with Apollo Insurance Solutions buy
summary: Arthur J. Gallagher announced the acquisition of Vancouver-based Apollo Insurance Solutions, a digital broker and MGA that uses an AI-driven platform to place tenant insurance across Canada, with terms of the deal undisclosed.

headline: F&G Annuities & Life completes its top-leadership handover with a new CFO on board
summary: F&G's executive transition plan reached its next milestone as Michael Bailey, formerly retail CFO at Corebridge Financial, officially became Executive Vice President and CFO, following Conor Murphy's move up to CEO and President earlier in the year.

headline: AI Workflow Startup Feathery Banks $30M to Expand Into Insurance and Wealth Management
summary: Feathery raised a $30 million Series A led by Portage Ventures and Index Ventures, with backing from Allstate's and Erie's venture arms, to scale its AI system for automating data collection and operational workflows across insurance and wealth-management firms.

headline: French Broker-Software Startup Panora Raises $5M After Landing 40 Clients in Three Months
summary: Panora, which builds AI software for insurance brokers, raised a $5 million seed round to fund expansion beyond its initial France, Belgium and UK rollout after signing 40 broker clients within its first three months on the market.

headline: French Health Insurtech Alan Lands Blockbuster Series G Round
summary: Paris-based digital health insurer Alan closed a financing round of roughly 480 million euros to expand its prevention-focused insurance model across Europe, pushing its valuation to around 5.5 billion euros.

headline: Startup Sixfold Debuts an AI Agent That Can Quote and Bind Policies Autonomously
summary: New York insurtech Sixfold launched an AI underwriting agent built to learn an individual carrier's risk appetite and carry applications straight through to quote-ready or bind-ready status, as part of a raise that pushed its total funding past $50 million.

headline: ACA premium spike pushes more shoppers into high-deductible bronze plans, CMS data show
summary: Healthcare Dive reports new CMS marketplace data show rising 2026 ACA premiums are driving more enrollees toward high-deductible bronze plans as enhanced subsidies shrink.

headline: Consolidation continues to reshape the third-party administrator sector
summary: Employee Benefit News reports private equity and larger benefits players are increasingly acquiring third-party administrators as the TPA market consolidates around scale and technology investment.

headline: Humana to shed more Medicare Advantage plans in 2027 as profits are squeezed
summary: Humana posted Q2 net income of $694 million and reaffirmed its 2026 profit outlook, but said it will exit additional Medicare Advantage markets in 2027 as it works to protect margins amid rising medical costs.

headline: Universal Health Services trims 2026 outlook despite double-digit operating margin
summary: UHS posted an 11.1% operating margin in the second quarter but lowered its full-year 2026 forecast as rising expenses offset revenue growth.

headline: EU AI Act's high-risk rules for insurance underwriting take effect this month
summary: The European Union's AI Act provisions governing high-risk AI use in insurance risk assessment and pricing became fully applicable in August 2026, raising compliance requirements for insurers using automated underwriting.

headline: UK property insurers face one of their toughest operating environments in years
summary: Browne Jacobson analysis finds record claims payouts, climate-driven catastrophe losses and a fragile pricing recovery are squeezing margins and capacity across the UK property insurance market in 2026.

headline: Wealth Enhancement adds three RIAs totaling more than $1.1 billion in assets
summary: The Minneapolis-based aggregator continued its rapid acquisition pace, striking three separate RIA deals that together bring in over $1.1 billion of client assets.

headline: Escalating Medicare Advantage plan exits threaten coverage for thousands of seniors
summary: Forbes reports a wave of insurer exits from Medicare Advantage markets for 2027 could displace large numbers of older adults as carriers retreat from unprofitable counties nationwide.

headline: Guidewire launches agentic AI framework for insurers to build their own claims and underwriting agents
summary: Guidewire's new Qusar release gives P&C carriers an Agentic Framework to build, deploy and govern AI agents across policy, claims, billing and underwriting workflows, aiming to cut decision times from days to minutes.

headline: TWFG expands specialty MGA footprint with APIA acquisition
summary: TWFG Insurance acquired APIA Inc., broadening the insurance distribution holding company's specialty managing general agency capabilities.

headline: Private capital and record demand are reshaping the life insurance and annuity business
summary: Insurance Business America reports insurers are redesigning products and distribution around growing private-capital involvement and sustained consumer demand for annuities as the sector enters a new era.

headline: AMN Healthcare beats guidance as travel-nurse and search revenue rebound
summary: AMN Healthcare's second-quarter revenue and earnings topped guidance, with travel nursing, allied staffing and physician search and locum tenens demand all growing year-over-year.

headline: Federated Mutual acquires trucking-focused MGA HDVI
summary: Federated Mutual Insurance completed its purchase of High Definition Vehicle Insurance, a full-stack managing general agent serving more than 100 trucking agencies, in a deal that closed August 1.

headline: Hospitals deploy AI faster than they can govern it, new report warns
summary: A new industry report finds more than 90% of health systems have deployed third-party AI tools, mainly for documentation and revenue-cycle work, while governance and safety frameworks lag behind adoption.

headline: India's InRisk Labs raises $27 million to expand catastrophe-modeling insurtech
summary: Ahmedabad-based InRisk Labs raised a $27 million Series A co-led by Bessemer Venture Partners and Northpoint Capital to deepen its underwriting, actuarial and catastrophe-modeling AI, and expand into parametric reinsurance products.

headline: Prudential Financial's assets under management climb to $1.64 trillion in Q2
summary: Prudential reported second-quarter net income of $985 million, nearly double a year earlier, as assets under management rose to $1.642 trillion on strong fundraising.

headline: Analysts preview what 2026 holds for life and annuity carriers
summary: InsuranceNewsNet outlines the demographic and product shifts industry watchers expect to shape life and annuity carrier strategy through the rest of 2026, including continued annuity strength alongside slower life growth.

headline: India's private life insurers post double-digit premium growth as Sanlam lifts its Shriram Life stake
summary: Industry coverage shows private insurers grew retail annualized premium equivalent about 15% year-on-year while Sanlam raised its stake in Shriram Life to just over 52%, funding technology and distribution expansion.

headline: European insurers warn wildfire 'protection gap' is widening as claims mount
summary: CNBC reports Zurich, Allianz and Munich Re are flagging a growing gap between wildfire disaster costs and available insurance coverage after a destructive wildfire season swept France, Spain and Greece.

headline: Human Interest launches AI-driven compliance guarantee for 401(k) plans
summary: The digital retirement-plan provider unveiled an AI tool that proactively checks payroll cycles and recordkeeping data against compliance benchmarks, giving plan administrators real-time health indicators.

headline: DOL sets 2026 rulemaking timeline for SECURE 2.0 portability and ESOP provisions
summary: The Department of Labor's regulatory agenda targets a September 2026 final rule on automatic portability transactions and later-year guidance on employee stock ownership plans under SECURE 2.0.

headline: US RIA M&A tops $100 billion in assets moved so far in 2026
summary: Markets Group reporting shows registered investment advisor M&A activity has already pushed more than $100 billion in client assets into new hands this year, extending record 2025 deal volume.

headline: ING taps bolttech to scale embedded insurance across its European markets
summary: ING selected embedded-insurance platform bolttech as a strategic partner to expand protection products across the Netherlands, Italy, Poland and Belgium as part of a broader European subscriptions push.

headline: Broker deal multiples hold up even as AI casts a shadow over the sector
summary: A 2026 broker M&A outlook finds that while AI-driven disruption fears have added scrutiny to deals and pressured some public broker valuations, well-run agencies and niche MGAs are still commanding strong, in some cases mid-to-high-teens, EBITDA multiples. Analysts expect another active year for brokerage consolidation despite the uncertainty.

headline: Australian claims administrator rebuilds its entire operation on an AI claims platform
summary: Quartz Claims, a TPA operating across Australia and New Zealand, has moved its full claims operation onto Five Sigma's AI-powered claims management platform, including its Clive AI system, as core infrastructure. The move is part of a wider regional trend of TPAs replacing legacy claims systems with AI-native platforms.

headline: CMS reopens Medicare Advantage bidding after revising star-rating scores
summary: CMS is recalculating 2026 Medicare Advantage star ratings, restoring some bonus payments to plans and reopening the 2027 bid process as a result. The move comes as average MA-PD star ratings have declined and CMS's finalized CY2027 rules narrow the margin for plans to earn top quality scores.

headline: Global insurtech investment outpaces all of 2025 within just two quarters
summary: Global insurtech funding reached roughly $1.54 billion across 27 disclosed deals through the first half of 2026, already surpassing full-year 2025 totals, with AI-focused startups and later-stage follow-on rounds capturing the bulk of capital. North America led both deal count and dollars raised, while Europe's total was buoyed by a small number of large financings.

headline: Target-Date Fund Assets Swell to $4.8 Trillion as Collective Trusts Overtake Mutual Funds
summary: Morningstar's 2026 target-date landscape report shows industry assets grew more than 20% last year to $4.8 trillion, with the top five providers controlling about 80% of the market and collective investment trusts now the leading vehicle ahead of mutual funds.

headline: Private-Equity-Backed Reinsurers Are Absorbing a Growing Slice of Life and Annuity Risk
summary: S&P Global Market Intelligence finds affiliated, PE-owned reinsurers are taking on an increasing share of ceded life and annuity liabilities, as alternative asset managers keep pursuing stable long-duration liabilities to feed their investment platforms.

headline: State regulators widen their multi-state trial of an AI oversight tool for insurers
summary: The NAIC's pilot of its AI Systems Evaluation Tool, which tests how regulators can assess insurers' AI governance and third-party model risk, has grown to 12 participating states after California joined. The program runs through September 2026 and is expected to inform a broader adoption decision at the NAIC's fall national meeting.

headline: Chubb's underwriting profit climbs nearly 19% as catastrophe losses ease
summary: Chubb reported second-quarter 2026 P&C underwriting income of $1.94 billion, up 18.8% year-over-year, with its combined ratio improving to 83.8% as pre-tax catastrophe losses fell to $475 million from $630 million a year earlier. The results stand out against a broader Q2 earnings season where several peers saw combined ratios worsen on rising cat losses.

headline: Sapiens taps its own CFO to lead next phase of AI-driven overhaul
summary: Core-systems vendor Sapiens named CFO Paul Wheeler as incoming CEO, with Executive Chairman Mike Ettling stepping back after serving as interim chief. Wheeler will formally take the helm around the company's October summit as Sapiens pushes further into becoming an AI-native insurance software provider.

headline: CVS Health taps a UnitedHealthcare veteran to run Aetna
summary: CVS Health named a former UnitedHealthcare executive as the new chief executive of its Aetna insurance unit, part of a broader leadership reset across the company's health-benefits business. The appointment continues a pattern of cross-payer executive movement among the largest national health insurers.

headline: Asia-Pacific Life Insurers Positioned for Multi-Year Run Toward a $1.6 Trillion Market
summary: Analysts expect Asia-Pacific life insurance to grow roughly 7.3% annually, expanding from about $1.2 trillion today to $1.6 trillion by 2029, with India's Shriram Life and HDFC Life pointing to bancassurance expansion and favorable demographics as growth drivers.

headline: UK Regulator Refreshes Superfund Rulebook Ahead of New Pension Schemes Act Regime
summary: The Pensions Regulator issued updated technical guidance for defined-benefit superfunds, including revised funding-level and wind-up-trigger definitions, to bridge the gap before the formal superfund regime created by the Pension Schemes Act 2026 comes into force.

headline: Specialty insurer rolls out coverage built for AI data centers and crypto mining rigs
summary: A unit of Ryan Specialty launched a new managing general underwriter dedicated to insuring computing hardware used in artificial intelligence, high-performance computing, and cryptocurrency mining operations. The move responds to surging demand for specialty property coverage as data-center and AI infrastructure buildouts accelerate.

headline: Broker consolidation cools to its slowest pace in a decade
summary: First-quarter 2026 insurance distribution deal volume fell to its lowest level since 2016, with just three acquirers (BroadStreet Partners, Inszone and ALKEME) responsible for nearly a third of all announced transactions. Higher borrowing costs and a more cautious lending environment are pushing buyers toward smaller, more disciplined tuck-in deals rather than large platform purchases.

headline: Parametric risk startup InRisk Labs lands $27M to expand catastrophe modeling
summary: InRisk Labs, an Indian parametric insurtech, raised a $27 million Series A co-led by Bessemer Venture Partners and Northpoint Capital. The company plans to use the funds to build out underwriting, actuarial and catastrophe-modeling capabilities and expand into natural catastrophe, marine cargo and motor insurance.

headline: Global insurtech funding jumps to a four-year high, almost entirely on AI bets
summary: Worldwide insurtech investment hit roughly $2.44 billion in the second quarter of 2026, the strongest quarter since 2022, with more than 99% of that capital flowing into AI-focused insurance startups. Large mega-rounds, rather than broad deal-count growth, drove most of the increase.

headline: Startup Astraeus Debuts AI Infrastructure Built Specifically for Regulated Advisory Firms
summary: New entrant Astraeus launched an AI-native platform designed to give advisory firms artificial intelligence tools tailored to their own compliance requirements and client context, joining a crowded field of wealthtech vendors racing to bring AI into the front office.

headline: Empower to Swallow Milliman's Retirement Administration Business in $340 Million Deal
summary: Empower agreed to acquire Milliman's retirement and health-plan administration operations for $340 million, adding roughly 400 defined-benefit plans and more than 1,100 defined-contribution plans representing well over $100 billion in combined client assets once the deal closes later in 2026.

headline: Insurance Investment Teams Turn to AI as Tight Credit Spreads Squeeze Returns
summary: With credit spreads historically tight, insurance general-account investment teams are increasingly using artificial intelligence to support portfolio decisions while hunting for new private-market opportunities to keep returns competitive.

headline: India's GIFT City opens the door to a new class of delegated-authority MGAs
summary: The IFSCA's new Managing General Agents Regulations took effect in June 2026, creating a formal registration and operating framework for MGAs to underwrite or settle claims on behalf of foreign insurers inside India's international financial centre. Industry figures are calling it a pivotal 'build-or-broker' moment for how global carriers access the Indian market.

headline: Specialty MGA CFC hands the CEO role to industry veteran Adam Winslow
summary: CFC has named Adam Winslow as group chief executive, taking over from Louise O'Shea as the specialty MGA continues its growth push. Winslow was expected to join the London-based underwriting business in summer 2026.

headline: New entrant Corgi pairs a nationwide adjuster network with instant AI claim triage
summary: Corgi Insurance launched Corgi Claims, describing it as an AI-native third-party administrator that combines more than 5,000 licensed adjusters with AI that reviews every claim immediately, scoring severity and flagging missing documentation or coverage issues. The launch reflects a broader wave of AI-first TPA models aiming to compress claims cycle times.

headline: Insurers propose another round of double-digit ACA rate hikes for 2027
summary: Preliminary 2027 rate filings show ACA marketplace insurers seeking a median premium increase of about 14%, which would mark a second consecutive year of double-digit hikes after enhanced subsidies expired at the end of 2025 and pushed 2026 out-of-pocket premiums up by roughly 58% on average. The subsidy cliff has been pushing healthier enrollees out of the marketplace, leaving a smaller, costlier risk pool behind.

headline: Northwell and Nuvance finalize merger into a $22.6 billion hospital system
summary: Northwell Health and Nuvance Health completed their previously announced merger, creating a combined nonprofit system valued at about $22.6 billion. The deal is one of several large not-for-profit hospital combinations closing in 2026 as systems look to gain scale and negotiating leverage.

headline: Corgi secures $108 million and regulatory approval to launch AI-native carrier for startups
summary: Y Combinator alum Corgi obtained carrier authority and funding to operate what it calls the first AI-native, full-stack insurer built specifically for startup companies, offering D&O, E&O and cyber coverage.

headline: Orion180 lifts reinsurance coverage 36% to $1.15 billion ahead of hurricane season
summary: The Florida-based insurer expanded its 2026 reinsurance tower and broadened the number of catastrophic events covered as it prepares for the Atlantic hurricane season.

headline: Hospital M&A activity accelerates through 2026 as health systems resume dealmaking
summary: Health systems that paused deals in 2025 amid policy uncertainty have resumed mergers, with 40 hospital transactions announced in the first half of 2026, including Community Health Systems' planned sale of its three-hospital Commonwealth Health system.

headline: Curant.ai raises $3.1 million seed round to scale AI-powered claims automation
summary: The Utah-based startup, led by Diagram with participation from Humania Insurance and Element Ventures, builds AI software that extracts data from documents to speed disability claims adjudication for insurers.

headline: RIA dealmaking shatters records, on pace for nearly 500 transactions in 2026
summary: Wealth management M&A hit its busiest first half on record with 262 deals, as repeat private-equity-backed acquirers and a wave of platform capital raises pushed sponsor-backed activity to an all-time high.

headline: Insurance industry sees a fresh wave of senior appointments across wholesale and program business
summary: A round of executive moves this week spanned wholesale E&S, risk advisory, actuarial leadership and insurtech distribution roles at major brokers and carriers.

headline: Shinhan Asset Management's target-date fund series tops 2 trillion won in assets
summary: South Korean retirement savers have poured over 600 billion won into Shinhan's TDF lineup this year alone, pushing total assets past the 2 trillion won mark as investors favor its retirement-timed allocation strategy amid market volatility.

headline: US wealthtech funding halves year-over-year in Q2 2026 as mega-deals dry up
summary: Wealthtech companies raised $557.8 million across 91 deals in the second quarter, down 41% from the prior quarter, as the number of rounds above $100 million shrank sharply.

headline: UK and EU regulators advance Solvency II reporting changes and insurer resolution rules
summary: The PRA published a policy statement amending UK Solvency reporting and own-funds requirements, while the European Commission adopted new technical standards under Solvency II and EIOPA issued final guidance on the Insurance Recovery and Resolution Directive.

headline: UnitedHealth raises 2026 guidance again as cost controls drive a Q2 earnings beat
summary: UnitedHealth posted adjusted earnings of $6.38 per share, well above analyst estimates, and raised full-year guidance as its medical benefit ratio improved on benefit redesigns and updated pricing.

headline: New law expands compensation-disclosure duties to TPAs and stop-loss carriers
summary: The Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026 extends compensation-disclosure requirements beyond brokers to third-party administrators, PBMs, stop-loss carriers and other group-health-plan vendors, requiring disclosure of direct and indirect compensation before contracts take effect, with penalties up to $10,000 per day for noncompliance.

headline: Collective investment trusts keep gaining ground in the target-date fund market
summary: Twenty years after the Pension Protection Act enabled automatic enrollment, collective investment trusts are increasingly displacing mutual funds in target-date lineups as plan sponsors seek lower, more customizable fee structures, with total target-date series reaching a record 164 by year-end 2025.

headline: UnitedHealthcare and Humana retreat from Medicare Advantage counties for 2026
summary: The two largest Medicare Advantage insurers are pulling back for 2026, with UnitedHealthcare exiting 225 counties while entering just 14, and Humana exiting 198 counties while entering five, as CMS's 2026 final rule also tightens prior-authorization and appeals protections.

headline: WellSky expands care-transition dashboards to 2,000 hospitals to curb discharge delays
summary: WellSky expanded its CarePort Care Transitions Dashboard Suite with new intelligence dashboards that give hospital and health-system teams real-time visibility into referral bottlenecks and discharge-performance benchmarks, drawing on a network spanning over 2,000 hospitals and 120,000 post-acute providers.

headline: &Partners recruits $1.8 billion Mississippi team from Wells Fargo
summary: Hybrid RIA &Partners added a four-advisor Meridian, Mississippi team managing $1.8 billion that departed Wells Fargo Advisors to launch as 32 North Wealth, capping a month that brought &Partners to 121 advisor practices and roughly $58 billion in assets.

headline: IRS to issue opinion letters for pre-approved DC plans by August 31
summary: The IRS expects to issue Cycle 4 opinion letters for pre-approved defined contribution plans around August 31, with a formal announcement in its Internal Revenue Bulletin setting the deadline for plan sponsors to adopt updated pre-approved plan documents.

headline: Third-party reinsurance capital projected to grow 6% to $130 billion in 2026
summary: AM Best and Guy Carpenter project alternative and third-party reinsurance capital will grow 6% to $130 billion in 2026, as investors keep channeling capital into insurance-linked securities and collateralized reinsurance vehicles.

headline: Insurance TPA market valued at $592.5 billion in 2026, projected to top $845 billion by 2031
summary: The global insurance third-party administrator market is valued at $592.52 billion in 2026 and forecast to reach $845.30 billion by 2031, a 7.36% CAGR driven by self-funded health plan growth and AI-driven claims automation.

headline: Newgen Software names Tarun Nandwani CEO for 18-month term
summary: Newgen Software, whose BPM and automation platforms serve banks and insurers, appointed 33-year company veteran Tarun Nandwani as CEO for an 18-month term starting August 1, alongside a broader leadership reshuffle naming Pramod Kumar as Chief Growth Officer.

headline: Roche to acquire AI pathology firm PathAI for up to $1.05 billion
summary: Roche agreed to acquire Boston-based digital pathology company PathAI for up to $1.05 billion -- $750 million upfront plus $300 million in milestones -- expanding its AI-assisted pathology portfolio built on the companies' partnership since 2021.

headline: EU AI Act's high-risk obligations become binding for life and health underwriting
summary: The EU AI Act's high-risk system obligations became enforceable on August 2, classifying AI used for underwriting, pricing and risk-scoring in life and health insurance as high-risk and subject to conformity assessments and human oversight, though a late-July political deal pushed some sensitive-use deadlines to December 2027.

headline: AlphaCore expands into New Jersey with $700 million Brave Family Advisors deal
summary: AlphaCore Wealth Advisory acquired Brave Family Advisors, a $700 million New Jersey RIA founded in 1992, adding eight staff including four advisers and opening AlphaCore's first Summit, NJ office as part of a Northeast expansion push.

headline: Pet insurance MGAs fuel rapid, profitable growth as US penetration still trails Europe
summary: AM Best data shows US pet insurance direct premiums rose 16.5% in Q1 2026 toward a projected $6.4 billion for the year, with managing general agents driving distribution even though penetration remains around 4.6%, far below the UK's 25%-plus and Sweden's nearly 40%.

headline: AI governance becomes central theme as insurers move past experimentation
summary: Insurers are shifting from AI experimentation toward structured adoption, with governance, accountability and decision oversight emerging as central themes at industry events like MGAA 2026 as carriers embed AI into core operational workflows.

headline: Carlyle takes minority stake in Prime Capital Financial at $1.8 billion-plus valuation
summary: Carlyle agreed to provide a $600 million hybrid capital solution and take a minority stake in Prime Capital Financial, valuing the nearly $50 billion-AUM RIA at over $1.8 billion, as prior investor Abry Partners exits its position.

headline: Swiss Re's life and health reinsurance profit climbs to $1.05 billion in first half of 2026
summary: Swiss Re reported first-half 2026 net income of $2.8 billion, up 9% year-over-year, with its life and health reinsurance segment posting $1.05 billion in profit versus $839 million a year earlier, aided by disciplined underwriting and a benign catastrophe environment.

headline: Zurich's P&C business posts record first half as capital strength climbs
summary: Zurich Insurance's property and casualty segment delivered its strongest first-half performance on record, with business operating profit rising 16% to $2.8 billion, while the group's Swiss Solvency Test ratio climbed to 266%, well above its 160% minimum target.

headline: Trump executive order pushes 401(k) access to private equity and crypto
summary: President Trump signed an executive order on August 7 directing the Department of Labor, SEC and Treasury to review and revise guidance to make it easier for participant-directed 401(k) plans to include alternative investments such as private equity and cryptocurrency.

headline: Zurich secures $1 billion quota-share reinsurance deal for data-center risk
summary: Zurich arranged a $1 billion quota-share reinsurance placement to support its growing book of underwriting risk tied to data centers, part of a broader trend of insurers building capacity for technology-infrastructure exposures.

headline: Goldman Sachs: insurer portfolios to stay stable in 2026 with deeper private-credit tilt
summary: Goldman Sachs Asset Management's 2026 Global Insurance Survey finds insurer investment portfolios are expected to stay broadly stable in 2026, with solid credit quality and continued reliance on private credit and alternative assets even as AI adoption in investment decisions accelerates.

headline: Arrow Global Insurance acquires Sydney-based M&A insurance MGA Fusion Specialty
summary: Arrow Global Insurance acquired Fusion Specialty, a Sydney-based MGA that has written roughly $388 million in gross premiums for warranty and indemnity, tax liability and contingent-risk insurance, from Australian insurtech conglomerate POP Group Holdings.

headline: Lower middle-market buyers reshape the insurance agency M&A landscape
summary: With AssuredPartners, Risk Strategies and Trucordia now absorbed into larger platforms, a new CT Acquisitions guide finds a fresh generation of private-equity-backed and independent buyers competing for lower middle-market insurance agencies as consolidation among the largest brokers slows.

headline: Global insurtech funding hits $2.44 billion in Q2 2026, the highest since 2022
summary: Gallagher Re's Global InsurTech Report found Q2 2026 funding reached $2.44 billion, the highest quarterly total since Q2 2022, with 99.1% of the capital flowing to AI-focused companies even as early-stage funding fell more than 50% quarter-over-quarter.

headline: ACA marketplace premiums set to jump 26% on average as enhanced subsidies lapse
summary: Newly unveiled 2026 ACA marketplace filings show premiums rising 26% on average -- 30% in states on the federal HealthCare.gov exchange -- as enhanced premium tax credits that expired at the end of 2025 push out-of-pocket costs sharply higher for enrollees.

headline: Insurity names Jatin Atre CEO with $100 million AI commitment
summary: P&C-focused insurance software provider Insurity appointed Jatin Atre as CEO, succeeding Jeff Clarke who becomes executive chairman, alongside a new $100 million commitment over two years to modernize core systems with embedded AI.

headline: Munich Re names AI, cyber and climate as top themes for reinsurers
summary: Munich Re and ERGO's 2026 Tech Trend Radar identified AI, cyber resilience, climate analytics and emerging liability as the defining strategic themes for reinsurers this year, with 63% of surveyed executives wanting cover against AI-related risks.

headline: Health systems report major time savings from AI documentation tools
summary: Intermountain Health cut time spent on visit notes by 27% using Microsoft's Dragon Copilot, while Cooper University Healthcare and Mercy reported clinicians saving over an hour of documentation time per shift using similar ambient AI scribe tools.

headline: Marpai's TPA and PBM platforms add 35,000 member lives in August
summary: Marpai said two major TPA clients representing roughly 35,000 member lives went live August 1, part of a projected 192,000-life expansion the company expects will push it to positive cash flow and EBITDA this quarter.

headline: Rockefeller adds $2.1 billion Merrill team in Columbus expansion
summary: Rockefeller Capital Management's Global Family Office recruited a multigenerational, multibillion-dollar advisory team led by Sidney Jones from Merrill, extending Rockefeller's wealth management footprint into a new Columbus, Ohio office.

headline: Great Eastern's Singapore business outpaces Malaysia recovery in first half
summary: Great Eastern reported first-half 2026 weighted new sales up 15% year over year to S$813.2 million, led by strong Singapore agency growth, while its Malaysia unit posted more modest gains amid softer product demand.

headline: VisionTrack names Richard Lilwall CEO of AI telematics platform
summary: AI video telematics and connected fleet data specialist VisionTrack, part of Markerstudy Group, appointed Richard Lilwall as chief executive, succeeding Ben Pickard who returns to the CFO role.

headline: Insurtech funding hits four-year high as AI captures 99% of capital
summary: Gallagher Re reported global insurtech funding reached $2.44 billion in Q2 2026, the highest quarterly total in four years, with AI-focused companies capturing 99.1% of all investment and mega-rounds over $100 million driving much of the increase.

headline: IRDAI weighs overhaul of insurance distributor commissions
summary: India's insurance regulator is considering replacing large upfront distributor commissions, currently as high as 40% on some life and health products, with payments staggered over a policy's life to curb mis-selling and align with global norms.

headline: Weekly fintech funding falls to $673 million as deal pace slows
summary: Fintech startups raised a combined $673 million across 15 deals in the first week of August 2026, a sharp pullback from the $2.03 billion raised the prior week, reflecting more selective investor appetite.

headline: PIMCO keeps pulling in outside money as Allianz boosts its stake
summary: PIMCO drew €31.7 billion in third-party net inflows in Q2 2026 with further gains in July, even as parent Allianz increased its ownership stake in the fixed-income manager.

headline: Health Affairs proposes overhaul of employer TPA accountability rules
summary: A Health Affairs analysis argues Congress should give self-funded employers a more accountable and transparent option for administering medical benefit plans, citing the market power TPAs hold over the 165.6 million Americans in employer-sponsored coverage.

headline: Gallagher's RPS wholesale unit acquires MGA Med James
summary: Arthur J. Gallagher's wholesale brokerage division Risk Placement Services acquired Overland Park, Kansas-based Med James, a managing general agency and wholesale broker, expanding RPS's capabilities in the north-central region.

headline: BrokerTech Ventures sets September Chicago summit for broker-insurtech dealmaking
summary: BrokerTech Ventures announced its second annual BrokerTech Connect conference for September 1-2, 2026 in Chicago, bringing together C-suite leaders from brokerages, carriers, wholesalers and insurtech startups for dealmaking and innovation dialogue.

headline: CMS strengthens Medicare Advantage prior-authorization protections
summary: CMS's 2026 final rule restricts Medicare Advantage plans from reopening previously approved inpatient admissions except for error or fraud, and requires decisions within 72 hours for expedited requests and seven days for standard requests.

headline: Catastrophe reinsurance prices post steepest annual fall in 25 years
summary: Guy Carpenter's Global Property Catastrophe Rate-on-Line Index fell 16% year-over-year at the June and July renewals, the steepest annual decline in a quarter-century, as record reinsurer capital pressures pricing.

headline: IRDAI grants ProTec General Insurance a license, its fourth approval of 2026
