summary: India's insurance regulator granted a certificate of registration to ProTec General Insurance, the fourth new insurer license IRDAI has issued so far in 2026.

headline: Investcorp makes first wealth-management bet, taking majority stake in $3 billion RIA
summary: Alternative asset manager Investcorp acquired a majority stake in Berger Financial Group, a Minnesota-based RIA managing roughly $3 billion, marking Investcorp's debut investment in the wealth-management sector.

headline: Guidewire appoints AI transformation specialist to its board
summary: Insurance software vendor Guidewire named veteran insurance executive and AI transformation specialist Dr. Alexander Vollert to its board, with his term beginning August 1.

headline: $400 million insurance and benefits brokerage prepares to spin off as standalone company
summary: A roughly $400 million insurance and employee-benefits brokerage business is being spun off from its parent to operate as an independent company.

headline: The Institutes names Gen Re CEO Kara Raiguel to chair its board
summary: Industry education group The Institutes appointed Gen Re President and CEO Kara Raiguel to chair its Board of Trustees, with Selective's John Marchioni and Tokio Marine HCC's Susan Rivera joining as vice chairs.

headline: AI-focused startups captured 99% of Q2 2026 insurtech funding
summary: Nearly every dollar of Q2 2026 insurtech funding, 99.1%, went to AI-focused companies, with every round above $5 million landing at an AI-backed firm.

headline: Human Interest launches AI tool for automated 401(k) compliance monitoring
summary: Retirement plan provider Human Interest introduced a new AI-driven tool designed to automatically flag compliance issues for employers administering 401(k) plans.

headline: Cambridge Investment Research deploys agentic AI to speed account opening
summary: Cambridge Investment Research rolled out an agentic AI tool that automates parts of its direct account-opening process, cutting a task that used to take 17 minutes down to seconds.

headline: Artisan Partners reports $183 billion in preliminary assets under management
summary: Asset manager Artisan Partners disclosed preliminary AUM of roughly $183 billion as of July 31, 2026, in a regulatory filing.

headline: Oscar Health posts record first-half results, raises full-year guidance
summary: Oscar Health reported $362 million in net income and a 75% medical loss ratio for the first half of 2026, prompting the ACA-focused insurer to raise its full-year earnings guidance.

headline: Recordkeepers report strong growth even as fee pressure intensifies
summary: Retirement plan recordkeepers say demand for pooled employer plans and wealth-management add-ons is fueling growth, even as declining fees push them to deliver more services and technology for less revenue per participant.

headline: Private equity firms wage bidding war for $160 billion RIA in deal valued near $7 billion
summary: Multiple private equity firms are reportedly competing to acquire a stake in a mega-RIA with roughly $160 billion in client assets, in a deal that could be valued near $7 billion.

headline: UnitedHealth beats Q2 estimates and raises full-year outlook as medical costs ease
summary: UnitedHealth Group topped second-quarter earnings estimates and raised its 2026 profit outlook as its medical benefit ratio improved to 86.7% from 89.4% a year earlier.

headline: New federal law widens fee-disclosure duties to TPAs and stop-loss insurers
summary: The Consolidated Appropriations Act of 2026 expanded compensation-disclosure obligations beyond pharmacy benefit managers to cover third-party administrators, stop-loss insurers and most other group health plan service providers, with penalties up to $10,000 a day for noncompliance.

headline: EU opens EUR9m fund for large-scale clinical AI imaging pilots
summary: The European Commission's Digital Europe Programme opened a call for proposals worth EUR9 million to fund large-scale pilots of cloud-based AI systems for medical imaging, focused on early detection of cancer and cardiovascular disease in hospitals.

headline: Neal and Wyden introduce bill cracking down on outsized 'mega' retirement accounts
summary: House Ways and Means Ranking Member Richard Neal and Senator Ron Wyden introduced legislation aimed at curbing unusually large IRA and retirement-account balances, part of a broader push on retirement-savings fairness.

headline: Allstate seeks Illinois homeowners rate hikes up to 10.4% as losses mount
summary: Allstate filed for new homeowners rate increases of up to 10.4% affecting more than 200,000 Illinois policyholders, citing severe weather and rising repair costs, reigniting debate over state rate-oversight rules.

headline: Catastrophe bond issuance smashes records as wildfire-exposed deals surge
summary: Cat bond issuance topped $11 billion in the second quarter, the largest quarter on record, with wildfire-exposed issuance for the year climbing past $5 billion as investor appetite for insurance-linked securities keeps growing.

headline: Standard Life to buy Aegon UK for GBP2bn, creating the UK's largest retirement savings business
summary: Standard Life agreed to acquire Aegon's UK pensions and savings arm in a GBP2 billion deal, forming a combined retirement business serving 16 million customers with roughly GBP480 billion in assets under administration.

headline: Travel-insurance fintech Faye raises $50m Series C to build an AI travel wallet
summary: Faye raised a $50 million Series C led by Madrona at an estimated $500 million valuation, and plans to expand its Faye Wallet product so travelers can manage money and get AI-assisted claims support abroad.

headline: Zurich secures $1bn reinsurance backstop for its data-center portfolio
summary: Zurich Insurance entered a new quota-share reinsurance arrangement providing up to $1 billion of capacity to support its fast-growing data-center construction and property book, as AI-driven demand for data-center coverage surges.

headline: LIC's quarterly profit jumps 23% as new-business margins widen sharply
summary: State-run insurer LIC reported a 23% year-on-year rise in first-quarter net profit to roughly Rs 13,492 crore, with value of new business surging 61% and margins expanding nearly 750 basis points.

headline: UC Irvine Health warns hospitals often don't know where every AI tool lives in their systems
summary: UC Irvine Health's chief medical informatics and AI officer, Dr. Deepti Pandita, said provider organizations may not always know where every AI tool exists in their operations, underscoring the need for system-wide AI awareness and governance.

headline: Allianz to buy HSBC Life Singapore for roughly $2bn, locks in 15-year bancassurance tie-up
summary: Allianz agreed to acquire HSBC Life Singapore for about S$2.7 billion and signed a 15-year exclusive distribution partnership with HSBC Singapore, deepening its foothold in one of Asia's wealthiest insurance markets.

headline: Fidelity to add a guaranteed-income option to its target-date fund lineup
summary: Fidelity plans to launch Freedom Lifetime, a suite of target-date collective investment trusts with a built-in guaranteed-income feature backed by insurers including Nationwide and New York Life, available to plan sponsors in early 2027.

headline: Guaranteed-income assets embedded in target-date funds top $100 billion
summary: Assets tied to guaranteed-income features within target-date funds reached about $103 billion, up 25% from year-end 2024, as more insurers and asset managers partner on in-plan lifetime-income products.

headline: Mapfre to acquire Safety Insurance in $1.54bn deal, expanding New England reach
summary: Spanish insurer Mapfre agreed to buy Massachusetts-based Safety Insurance Group in an all-cash $1.54 billion deal at a 44% premium, creating the region's largest homeowners and commercial auto insurer.

headline: AI-native brokerage platform AGI launches with $70 million to buy up agencies
summary: American Growth Insurance launched an AI-enabled brokerage growth platform backed by nearly $70 million in committed equity from Rockbridge Growth Equity and Atomic, and closed its first agency acquisition in Baltimore.

headline: BrokerTech Ventures sets Chicago convening for late August with growing sponsor lineup
summary: BrokerTech Ventures announced BrokerTech Connect: Chicago, running August 31-September 2, bringing together brokers, carriers, investors and insurtech founders for sessions on AI and the next generation of digital-first insurance organizations.

headline: Insurity and ITS partner to close the insurance industry's technology execution gap
summary: Insurity and Insurance Technology Services announced a partnership aimed at reducing delivery risk on insurance technology rollouts, targeting the gap between purchasing new insurance software and actually getting it into production.

headline: UnitedHealth's Q2 profit hits $5.4bn as it pours $1.5bn into AI cost controls
summary: UnitedHealth Group reported Q2 profit of $5.4 billion and raised its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance, as the insurer works to stabilize margins by shrinking membership, exiting unprofitable contracts and investing $1.5 billion in AI to streamline operations.

headline: SoftBank's PayPay to acquire 70% of T&D Financial Life in AI-driven insurance push
summary: PayPay agreed to acquire a 70.2% stake in T&D Financial Life for about JPY134.3 billion ($838 million) as part of a broader alliance with T&D Holdings to distribute insurance through its super-app and develop AI-powered products for Japan's aging population.

headline: French digital insurer Alan raises EUR480 million at EUR5.5 billion valuation
summary: Alan closed a EUR480 million ($550 million) Series G round led by Prosus, with Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan participating for a third straight round, as the profitable French insurer targets Canada as a growth market.

headline: Nevada moves to let home insurers exclude wildfire losses from standard policies
summary: Nevada will permit homeowners insurers to carve wildfire coverage out of standard policies starting in 2026, part of a broader wave of state-level moves on wildfire exposure management following record catastrophe losses.

headline: Zurich clears final EU antitrust hurdle for GBP8.1 billion Beazley takeover
summary: The European Commission approved Zurich Insurance Group's acquisition of Lloyd's insurer Beazley under simplified merger review; the all-cash deal still needs sign-off from UK, Swiss and Lloyd's regulators.

headline: Artisan Partners reports $183 billion in assets under management
summary: Artisan Partners Asset Management disclosed preliminary assets under management of $183.0 billion as of July 31, 2026, giving an early read on mid-year flows for the publicly traded asset manager.

headline: AIA and Manulife post double-digit new-business growth across Asia
summary: AIA's China and Hong Kong operations drove group value of new business up double digits, while Manulife's Asia segment grew core earnings 21% and new business value 13%, both citing strength in Hong Kong, Singapore and mainland China.

headline: Voya extends 401(k) recordkeeping deal with law firm Baker Botts
summary: Voya Financial renewed its role as recordkeeper for international law firm Baker Botts effective August 1, continuing to serve more than 1,800 plan participants and roughly $900 million in retirement assets.

headline: Family-office wealthtech Asset Vantage names Nicole Eberhardt global CEO
summary: Asset Vantage, an AI-led SaaS platform serving more than 400 families across 10 countries, appointed Nicole Eberhardt as global chief executive effective August 1 to lead its next phase of product and international growth.

headline: Reinsurance sidecars and ILS capital step in as traditional reinsurers pull back from MGAs
summary: Broker Gallagher Re says growing use of third-party capital, reinsurance sidecars and insurance-linked-securities investors is helping managing general agents replace underwriting capacity that major reinsurers have scaled back.

headline: Cover Genius buys German insurtech Friendsurance to expand DACH bancassurance push
summary: Embedded-protection platform Cover Genius acquired Berlin-based Friendsurance, combining its embedded insurance technology with Friendsurance's digital bancassurance and regulatory expertise across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

headline: Fisent Technologies raises $4.3 million to scale AI automation for regulated finance firms
summary: Fisent Technologies closed a $4.3 million venture round led by FINTOP, with FINTOP partner John Philpott joining its board, to expand its agentic AI platform for banking, insurance and wealth management workflows.

headline: SUPERAGENT launches 3.0, billed as an AI 'business partner' for insurance agencies
summary: SUPERAGENT released version 3.0 on August 11, replacing traditional agency-software navigation with a conversational AI layer that executes calls, campaigns, renewals and training tasks using live agency data.

headline: India weighs national claims exchange and benchmarked treatment rates to curb medical inflation
summary: India is considering wide-ranging health insurance reforms, including standardized treatment-rate benchmarks and a nationwide claims exchange, as it seeks to improve transparency amid some of Asia's highest medical inflation.

headline: Auto insurance rates resume climbing across more than half of US states
summary: After easing in 2025, car insurance premiums are rising again in over half the country, with Connecticut drivers facing the steepest year-over-year increase at 15%, driven by higher repair costs and inflation, per Insurify data.

headline: Carlyle takes minority stake in Prime Capital Financial at $1.8 billion valuation
summary: Carlyle's Global Credit platform agreed to roughly a $600 million hybrid capital investment in Prime Capital Financial, valuing the RIA at more than $1.8 billion and letting prior backer Abry Partners exit after three years.

headline: AI shifts from insurtech pitch to embedded infrastructure, VCs say
summary: Roughly 71% of applicants to the 2026 Global InsurTech Competition referenced AI or automation, but investors say the technology is increasingly treated as infrastructure embedded in underwriting and claims workflows rather than a standalone selling point.

headline: Hospital M&A activity rebounds sharply in first half of 2026
summary: US hospital and health system mergers rebounded to roughly 40 deals in the first half of 2026, including 18 in the second quarter alone, more than double the same period a year earlier, as systems adjust to new federal and state policy pressures.

headline: IRS confirms higher 2026 contribution ceilings for 401(k) and IRA savers
summary: The IRS raised the 2026 401(k) elective-deferral limit to $24,500 and the IRA contribution limit to $7,500, giving workers more room to shelter retirement savings as inflation adjustments continue.

headline: Global catastrophe reinsurance pricing posts its steepest annual drop in 25 years
summary: Guy Carpenter's property-catastrophe rate-on-line index fell 16% year-over-year at the June/July renewals as record capital levels pressured pricing, even as a summer of frequent catastrophe events complicates the outlook for later renewals.

headline: Specialty carrier Everspan adds three senior leaders across reinsurance and underwriting
summary: Everspan Group named David Kenyon (ex-Zurich) head of reinsurance, Bevan Greibesland (ex-HDI Global) chief underwriting officer, and Forest Clay Stewart (ex-Chubb) chief operating officer, splitting out roles that had previously been combined.

headline: India's government raises $3.3 billion selling down its stake in state insurer LIC
summary: New Delhi upsized an offer-for-sale of Life Insurance Corporation of India shares to 6.5% after strong demand, raising roughly $3.3 billion at a discounted price to trim the government's holding toward 90% and meet public-float rules.

headline: InsuranceDekho elevates chief revenue officer Abhishek Bansal to CEO
summary: Indian insurance marketplace InsuranceDekho promoted Chief Revenue Officer Abhishek Bansal to chief executive of its insurance business as part of a broader senior-leadership restructuring.

headline: everyoneINVESTED and Prometeia pair up on behavioral-finance wealthtech
summary: The two wealthtech vendors partnered to embed everyoneINVESTED's behavioral-finance profiling tools into Prometeia's investment-advisory and portfolio-management platform.

headline: United Fire Group posts its best catastrophe loss ratio in a decade
summary: United Fire Group reported a second-quarter catastrophe loss ratio of 2.7%, a 2.8-point improvement from a year earlier and well below its ten-year average, reflecting a comparatively quiet severe-weather season for the specialty carrier.

headline: French insurers shift AI from pilot projects to front-line operations
summary: Insurers in France are moving past the decision of whether to use AI and are now focused on how to deploy it across underwriting and claims while keeping human decision-makers in control.

headline: Insurers sit on an underused distribution-data goldmine, industry analysis finds
summary: Carriers, MGAs and agencies have modernized their distribution technology in recent years but are still leaving significant value on the table from the data those systems generate, according to industry analysis.

headline: AI is reshaping wealth advisors' role rather than replacing them, analysts say
summary: LSEG Data & Analytics finds AI is shifting financial advisors away from manual information-gathering toward insight orchestration and client judgment, rather than displacing the advisor relationship.

headline: Private equity firms step up their courtship of 401(k) plan sponsors
summary: With roughly $30 trillion sitting in US retirement accounts, private-equity firms are increasingly pitching plan sponsors and recordkeepers on giving savers access to alternative-asset strategies inside 401(k) menus.

headline: Specialty reinsurer Pelagos misses Q2 estimates on Middle East and Qatar catastrophe losses
summary: Pelagos reported second-quarter operating earnings well below analyst consensus after $162 million in catastrophe and large losses, including charges tied to the Middle East conflict and a Qatar gas-plant explosion, weighed on underwriting results.

headline: FE fundinfo accelerates rollout of its Nexus adviser platform
summary: FE fundinfo is stepping up investment in Nexus for Financial Advisers, its AI-powered workflow platform, with plans to add more than 25 new capabilities before the end of 2026.

headline: CVS Caremark survey finds employers leaning harder on PBMs to fight drug costs
summary: A CVS Caremark and Employee Benefit News survey found 88% of employers see PBMs as well-positioned to curb prescription drug costs, with GLP-1 access and biosimilar adoption among employers' top concerns.

headline: NAIC's property and casualty panel wraps summer session in Columbus
summary: The NAIC's Property and Casualty Insurance (C) Committee held its summer national meeting session on August 14 in Columbus, continuing regulatory work on catastrophe risk mitigation and market-conduct oversight.

headline: Fixed annuity rates hold near multi-year highs heading into fall
summary: Non-A-rated carriers are advertising fixed annuity rates as high as 7.50% this week, with top A-rated insurers capping out near 5.50%, as carriers keep competing hard for retirement savers' assets.

headline: Travelers profit jumps 46% in Q2 as catastrophe losses ease
summary: Travelers reported second-quarter net income of $2.21 billion, up 46% year-over-year, as pre-tax catastrophe losses dropped to $518 million from $927 million a year earlier.

headline: bolt launches AI-powered insurance distribution platform
summary: Distribution technology provider bolt launched a new AI-driven platform combining three core distribution capabilities into a single insurance-focused system for carriers and agencies.

headline: AI underwriting startup Sixfold teams up with Sollers Consulting
summary: Sixfold partnered with Sollers Consulting to help insurance carriers accelerate underwriting transformation, pairing Sixfold's AI-driven risk assessment with Sollers' implementation and consulting support.

headline: FTC settlement forces Caremark to overhaul rebate and formulary practices
summary: The FTC reached a settlement with CVS Health's Caremark Rx and Zinc Health Services requiring changes to formulary design, rebate transparency and pharmacy-network contracting, with the agency estimating up to $13 billion in consumer savings over a decade.

headline: Asia's private health insurers warned of looming medical-cost "crisis"
summary: The Global Alliance for Insurance Pools warned that Asia's private health insurance sector could face a full-on sustainability crisis within two to three years without action on medical cost inflation, which is running near 14% regionally and higher in markets like Singapore.

headline: Horace Mann to acquire two Medical Mutual of Ohio benefits businesses for $240 million
summary: Horace Mann Educators agreed to acquire an employee assistance provider and a supplemental insurer from Medical Mutual of Ohio for about $240 million, adding roughly $200 million in annual revenue and over one million covered lives.

headline: U.S. MGA market swells to roughly $128 billion as specialization reshapes distribution
summary: The U.S. managing general agent market grew to about $128 billion in total premium flow in 2025, with MGA-written direct premium up 12% from 2024 as carriers and private equity firms extend their reach into specialty distribution.

headline: Prior authorization denial rates vary wildly across major health insurers, new data shows
summary: First-of-its-kind data shows prior authorization denial rates ranging from 2% to 25% among major insurers, with at least one in eight standard requests denied across Medicare Advantage, Medicaid managed care and ACA marketplace plans.

headline: UnitedHealthcare, Humana and Aetna scale back Medicare Advantage offerings for 2026
summary: Major payers UnitedHealthcare, Humana and Aetna are trimming their Medicare Advantage plan footprints for 2026, part of an industry-wide pullback as insurers manage rising medical costs and tighter margins in the program.

headline: Global insurtech funding hits $2.44 billion in strongest quarter since 2022
summary: Insurtech venture funding surged to $2.44 billion across 95 deals in the second quarter of 2026, the highest quarterly total in four years, though investors are increasingly favoring mature, AI-ready companies over early-stage startups.

headline: Asia commercial insurance rates keep falling, with Vietnam property the outlier
summary: Marsh's latest index shows Asia commercial insurance rates fell about 5% in the second quarter, matching the prior quarter's pace, while Vietnam property rates rose 13% on regulatory pricing tariffs even as Taiwan and Korea saw steep declines.

headline: Majority of home and community-based care providers now testing AI tools, survey finds
summary: An HHAeXchange survey found more than 57% of home- and community-based service providers are actively using, testing or evaluating AI tools, part of a broader wave of clinical and administrative AI adoption across care settings.

headline: Insurance data startup Axle raises $17.5 million Series A
summary: Axle, a startup building data infrastructure for the insurance industry, raised $17.5 million in a Series A round led by Base10 Partners, part of continued investor interest in vertical software for complex industries.

headline: Fisent Technologies raises $4.3 million as it lands its first Fortune 50 customer
summary: Insurance fintech Fisent Technologies secured $4.3 million in new funding, citing growth across its enterprise business including its first Fortune 50 customer win in 2026.

headline: Weekly fintech funding climbs to $808 million as summer deal flow holds up
summary: Fintech venture funding rose to roughly $808 million across a dozen deals in the second week of August, up from about $673 million the prior week, as investor appetite for vertical fintech continues into late summer.

headline: Etiqa Insurance Singapore names Claudia Soh as permanent CEO
summary: Etiqa Insurance Singapore confirmed Claudia Soh as chief executive effective mid-August, after she spent six months serving as acting CEO while continuing as the insurer's chief financial officer.

headline: AGI raises $70 million to scale its AI-native insurance brokerage model
summary: AI-enabled brokerage platform AGI secured $70 million in private equity backing to accelerate growth, part of a broader push by investors to fund AI-native distribution models in insurance brokerage.

headline: Aon reshuffles Asia-Pacific broking leadership as regional expansion continues
summary: Aon named Helen Lockwood as Australian COO starting in January and expanded Ben Rolfe's remit to chief broking officer for the Pacific, part of a broader wave of senior broker moves across the region this month.

headline: Intermountain Health cuts clinician charting time 27% with Microsoft's Dragon Copilot
summary: Intermountain Health's system-wide rollout of Microsoft's Dragon Copilot ambient AI scribe has reduced time spent on clinical notes per appointment by 27% among clinicians with heavy usage, based on the health system's internal Epic data.

headline: Target-date funds approach $5 trillion as five firms control 80% of the market
summary: Target-date fund assets have grown to roughly $4.8 trillion, up over 20% year over year, with Vanguard alone holding about 37% of industry assets as adoption in workplace retirement plans becomes near-universal.

headline: LIMRA expects U.S. annuity sales to extend record streak through 2026
summary: LIMRA projects annuity sales will keep topping $100 billion per quarter as roughly four million Americans turn 65 each year and increasingly lack pension access, driving demand for guaranteed lifetime income products.

headline: Old Republic spins its third-party administrator business out as standalone brand Lodestar
summary: Old Republic International launched Lodestar Claims & Risk Services as an independent brand and standalone operating company, the first time in more than 30 years its TPA business has carried its own distinct market identity.

headline: European regulators push private equity owners of insurers toward longer-term capital commitments
summary: EU insurance regulators are pressing private-equity owners of European insurers to commit to patient, long-term capital strategies rather than short-hold return targets, as PE ownership of insurers keeps growing.

headline: CNBC names One Inc among top 500 global fintech companies for third straight year
summary: One Inc, a digital payments network built for the insurance industry's premium and claims disbursement workflows, was recognized in the Payments category of CNBC's World's Top Fintech Companies 2026 list, developed with Statista.

headline: TWFG's Q1 filing details $22.5 million acquisition of Texas MGA Asset Protection Insurance Associates
summary: TWFG's SEC filing shows the insurance distributor acquired APIA, a Texas-based MGA focused on property owners and real estate investors, for $22.5 million cash plus up to $7 million in earnout payments.

headline: Private equity-backed buyers drove roughly 76% of insurance agency acquisitions in first-half 2026
summary: BroadStreet Partners and Inszone Insurance Services led first-half 2026 insurance distribution M&A with 37 and 33 deals respectively, as PE-backed and hybrid buyers accounted for about three-quarters of all agency acquisitions even as overall deal pace slowed.

headline: Insurer general account assets approach $8.7 trillion as carriers keep migrating into private credit
summary: Combined life and P&C insurer invested assets reached roughly $8.68 trillion at year-end 2025, with the 2026 Insurance Investment Outsourcing Report tracking a continued multiyear migration into private credit and alternatives amid new regulatory reporting rules.

headline: CMS finalizes FY2027 hospital inpatient payment rule
summary: CMS's FY2027 Inpatient Prospective Payment System and Long-Term Care Hospital final rule, published in the Federal Register on August 4, 2026, updates Medicare hospital payment rates, revises graduate medical education policy and expands quality reporting requirements ahead of an October 2026 effective date.

headline: F&G Annuities & Life posts GAAP loss on mark-to-market swings despite strong retail annuity demand
summary: F&G reported an $81 million net loss for the second quarter of 2026 driven by mark-to-market effects, even as core retail annuity sales of $1.8 billion outperformed a contracting fixed indexed annuity market.

headline: PCMA launches public campaign defending PBMs against further regulation
summary: The Pharmaceutical Care Management Association launched a "What's Your PBM IQ?" public campaign on August 10, 2026, arguing pharmacy benefit managers already deliver savings as Congress weighs additional PBM reform following the Consolidated Appropriations Act's new rules.

headline: Jackson Financial posts record Q2 profit as annuity sales jump 34%
summary: Jackson Financial reported record second-quarter 2026 net income of $644 million and retail annuity sales of $5.9 billion, up 34% year-over-year, driven by record registered index-linked annuity volume.

headline: Edelman Financial Engines names first retirement advisory chief as wealth managers deepen leadership benches
summary: Edelman Financial Engines hired Christian Mango to lead a new retirement advisory practice, part of a wave of senior wealth-management hires this month that also saw Perigon Wealth Management add a chief people officer role.

headline: Shinhan Asset Management's target-date funds near $15 billion as Korean investors favor long-horizon strategies
summary: Shinhan Asset Management's two qualified target-date fund series held a combined 2.02 trillion won (about $14.6 billion) as of mid-August, with the firm's investment head urging long-term TDF investing over market timing.

headline: CMS Medicare Advantage star-rating recalculation to drive over $13 billion in 2027 quality bonus spending
summary: A KFF analysis updated August 12, 2026 found CMS's recalculation of Medicare Advantage star ratings will push 2027 quality bonus program spending above $13 billion, with the bonus program continuing to boost payments to highly rated plans.

headline: Hospitals report AI documentation tools are cutting nursing and physician charting time significantly
summary: Multiple health systems are reporting measurable time savings from ambient AI scribes and documentation tools, including a Mercy nurse in Missouri saving roughly two hours of charting per 12-hour shift, as governance concerns shift toward EHR integration.

headline: Motilal Oswal AMC crosses ₹2 lakh crore in total assets under management
summary: Motilal Oswal Asset Management Company surpassed ₹2 lakh crore in combined mutual fund, AIF and PMS assets as of August 7, 2026, after adding more than 56 lakh new SIP accounts during the fiscal year.

headline: Roper Technologies to shift 401(k) recordkeeping from Vanguard to Fidelity, triggering blackout period
summary: Roper Technologies disclosed a participant blackout period beginning in late September as its two 401(k) plans transition recordkeeping services from Vanguard to Fidelity Investments, effective October 2026.

headline: ACA marketplace young-adult enrollment drops 8% as enhanced subsidies lapse
summary: KFF found ACA marketplace sign-ups among adults 18-34 fell by 542,000, or 8%, year-over-year after enhanced premium tax credits expired, accounting for nearly half of the total marketplace enrollment decline.

headline: Community Health Systems moves to sell Pennsylvania hospital network to nonprofit after prior deal collapsed
summary: Community Health Systems signed a letter of intent to sell its three-hospital Commonwealth Health system in Pennsylvania to Tenor Health Foundation, after an earlier $120 million deal with WoodBridge Healthcare fell through.

headline: Rockefeller Poaches 14-Person, $2 Billion Merrill Lynch Team in Ohio
summary: Rockefeller Capital Management's Global Family Office unit recruited Jones Wealth Partners, a Merrill Lynch team managing about $2 billion in assets led by 43-year Merrill veteran Sidney Jones, expanding Rockefeller's Ohio footprint with a new Columbus office.

headline: Vanguard Taps Vestmark to Power New Customizable Model Portfolios for RIAs
summary: Vanguard launched Vanguard Custom Model Portfolios that let advisors tailor multi-asset models to client tax and values preferences, with Vestmark selected as one of three technology partners supplying trading and tax-management infrastructure.

headline: AI-Focused RIA Arca Raises $64M Backed by General Catalyst and an Anthropic Partnership
summary: Arca, a registered investment advisor built around AI-assisted advisory workflows, launched with $64 million in funding from investors including General Catalyst, Index Ventures and Venrock, and already manages over $1 billion in client assets.

headline: India's Wealth Management Market Barrels Toward $287 Billion by 2030 as AI Reshapes Advice
summary: India's wealth management industry, projected to grow from about $154 billion in 2024 to nearly $287 billion by 2030, is being reshaped by fast-growing AI-driven robo-advisory platforms even as the country faces a shortage of experienced advisors for its wealthy clients.

headline: Global Property Catastrophe Reinsurance Rates Post Steepest Drop Since 2014
summary: Risk-adjusted global property catastrophe reinsurance rates fell an average of 14.7% at the January 2026 renewals, the sharpest year-on-year decline since 2014, as record capital inflows and strong ILS issuance pushed the market into a buyer-favorable cycle.

headline: Auto Insurance Premiums Set to Climb in 32 States Through Year-End 2026
summary: Rising repair costs, vehicle technology expenses and severe weather claims are projected to push average auto insurance premiums higher in 32 U.S. states by the end of 2026, extending increases already seen in 27 states during the first half of the year.

headline: Acrisure Folds Tech-First Property MGA Vave Into Its Underwriting Platform
summary: Acrisure completed its acquisition of Vave, a data-driven excess-and-surplus property MGA that issues over 10,000 automated quotes daily, from Canopius Group, adding it to Acrisure Underwriting's roster of a dozen MGAs.

headline: NAIC Advances AI Risk Evaluation Tool for Insurer Market Conduct Exams
summary: The NAIC's Big Data and Artificial Intelligence Working Group is briefing regulators on its AI Systems Evaluation Tool, currently piloted by a dozen states through a market-conduct-exam program running January through September 2026, with statehouse adoption expected at the Fall National Meeting.

headline: Specialty Carrier Everspan Adds Three Senior Underwriting and Operations Executives
summary: Everspan Group named a new head of reinsurance, chief underwriting officer and chief operating officer in quick succession during late July and August 2026 as part of a broader growth push in the program and specialty insurance business.

headline: Insurers Lean on AI-Driven Underwriting as Catastrophe Claim Severity Hits Records
summary: Conning and other analysts flagged that catastrophe losses remain the top challenge for P&C carriers in 2026, with home-insurance claim severity at record levels, pushing insurers toward AI-assisted risk modeling even as reinsurance capital eases pricing pressure.

headline: UK Broker Consolidators Keep Buying as Independent Mid-Market Firms Shrink
summary: Private-equity-backed UK broker groups continue snapping up smaller firms, with Clear's purchase of Pangea Insurance Brokers and Pangea Life and Seventeen Group's acquisition of 1st Choice Insurance among recent deals, as nearly a third of once mid-sized independents have now sold.

headline: Cyber-Focused MGA Trivora Lands Growth Investment From Carroll Street Capital
summary: Specialty cyber MGA Trivora secured a growth capital investment led by private equity firm Carroll Street Capital, giving it fresh funding to expand into additional specialty insurance lines.

headline: APAC Warranty & Indemnity Insurance Claims Surge as Rates Hit Record Lows
summary: Data from Aon, Marsh and Gallagher show APAC transactional-risk insurance claim notifications jumped 76% year-on-year in 2025, with Marsh clients alone collecting over $80 million in payouts even as W&I and tax liability premium rates sank to record lows.

headline: Allianz to buy HSBC Life Singapore in €2 billion bancassurance push
summary: Allianz agreed to acquire HSBC's Singapore composite insurer and pair the deal with a 15-year exclusive bancassurance distribution partnership with HSBC Singapore, valuing the combined arrangement near S$2.9 billion.

headline: ICICI Prudential Life moves to drop 'Prudential' as UK parent pivots to Bharti Life stake
summary: ICICI Prudential Life's board approved renaming the insurer ICICI Life Insurance and reclassifying Prudential Corporation Holdings as an investor rather than a promoter, tied to Prudential's plan to buy 75% of Bharti Life Insurance from Bharti Enterprises.

headline: US annuity sales set new quarterly record as rate and market jitters spur demand
summary: LIMRA reported total US annuity sales climbed 4% year-over-year to a record $123.9 billion in Q2 2026, marking the eleventh straight quarter above $100 billion, with registered index-linked annuities leading growth.

headline: Pacific Life Re strikes third asset-intensive reinsurance deal with Japan's Anshin Life
summary: Pacific Life Re completed its third block reinsurance transaction with Tokio Marine & Nichido Life's Anshin Life unit, covering in-force whole-of-life policies to help the Japanese insurer offload long-term interest rate risk.

headline: India's insurance regulator finalizes 100% foreign ownership rules and tougher enforcement powers
summary: IRDAI's board approved a reform package implementing 100% FDI under the automatic route alongside liberalized investment norms, simplified restructuring, and expanded powers to penalize insurers and fund a new policyholder protection fund.

headline: US pension buyout volume cools sharply after blockbuster 2025 finish
summary: LIMRA data show US pension risk transfer sales fell 47% year-over-year to roughly $3.8 billion in Q1 2026, with single-premium buyout sales down 57%, a pullback attributed to deal timing that front-loaded activity into late 2025.

headline: Royal London lands twin bulk annuity deals from UK charitable pension schemes
summary: The Royal Horticultural Society and Royal Society of Chemistry each secured buy-in transactions with Royal London this week, transferring the benefits of more than 700 defined-benefit scheme members combined ahead of the insurer's first individual buyout conversions later in 2026.

headline: DOL retirement-advice fiduciary rule officially vacated for a second time
summary: The Department of Labor's 2024 Retirement Security Rule defining an investment advice fiduciary was formally removed effective April 20, 2026, reverting to the 1975 five-part test, with a Trump-era replacement rule possibly coming as soon as May 2026.

headline: India's pension regulator sets goal to grow NPS subscribers more than 30-fold
summary: PFRDA chairman Sivasubramanian Ramann outlined a target to expand non-government NPS subscribers from about 9 million to 350-400 million within five years, leaning on the StAR NPS digital platform, expanded distribution, and four newly approved pension funds.

headline: Pooled employer plan adoption jumps nearly 45% as recordkeepers chase DC growth
summary: The 2026 PLANSPONSOR Recordkeeping Survey found 10,797 employers had adopted pooled employer plans for 401(k)/403(b) participants, up from 7,454 a year earlier, as almost 60% of recordkeepers now service PEPs.

headline: Target-date fund assets near $5 trillion as low-cost trusts overtake mutual funds
summary: Target-date strategy assets grew 20.3% in 2025 to $4.8 trillion, with collective investment trusts now holding the majority share as plan sponsors chase lower fees, even as scrutiny grows over whether traditional glide paths manage risk adequately.

headline: Indian mutual fund assets hit record ₹85.76 lakh crore on SIP boom
summary: India's mutual fund industry AUM reached ₹85,75,657 crore as of July 31, 2026, roughly a six-fold rise over a decade, driven by record monthly SIP inflows above ₹32,000 crore and mutual fund folios surpassing 27 crore.

headline: Insurers keep squeezing higher yields from reinvested portfolios in Q2 earnings
summary: AIG reported its annualized investment yield rose 30 basis points to 4.72% with new-money yields running about 60 basis points above sales and maturities, while Selective Insurance's after-tax net investment income jumped 18% year-over-year to $119 million.

headline: Medi Assist Completes Takeover of Paramount's TPA Business in India
summary: Medi Assist Insurance TPA finished absorbing rival Paramount Health Services' licensed third-party administrator operations via a slump-sale transfer, cementing its position as India's largest TPA and unifying claims servicing across both books.

headline: Texas TPA Proficient Benefit Solutions Adds AI Layer via Elevate Tie-Up
summary: Consumer-directed benefits platform Elevate is partnering with Texas-based TPA Proficient Benefit Solutions to automate HSA, FSA and HRA administration for its employer clients, aiming to cut manual processing and speed account servicing.

headline: Old Republic Spins Off Claims Unit as Standalone Brand Lodestar
summary: After more than three decades operating inside Old Republic, the insurer's third-party administration business has been relaunched as an independent company, Lodestar Claims & Risk Services, giving the national claims provider its own market identity.

headline: Bolt Debuts AI Distribution Engine as Embedded Insurance Financing Expands
summary: Distribution-tech insurtech Bolt rolled out what it calls the industry's first AI-powered insurance distribution platform, arriving as embedded finance products bundling insurance, credit and payments keep expanding across non-financial apps.

headline: Acrisure Bolts On Four UK Brokers and an MGA in Specialist Push
summary: Acrisure's UK broking arm acquired retail brokers Heathwoods, Marrs and Smith Greenfield along with London MGA Confidas, broadening its commercial, property, high-net-worth and heritage-risk capabilities amid continued UK broker consolidation.

headline: AI Broker Startup Rosella Raises Early Funding From Peak XV, Intact
summary: Indian AI-powered commercial insurance broker Rosella closed a $2.6 million round led by Peak XV Partners and Intact Private Capital to automate policy comparison and quoting workflows for construction, manufacturing and logistics SMEs.

headline: Ledgebrook Wins A- Ratings, Completes Full-Stack Carrier Build Early
summary: AM Best awarded A- financial strength ratings to Ledgebrook's two newly formed carrier entities, marking the E&S insurtech's completion of its shift to a full-stack model ahead of the 2027 timeline its founder had set out.

headline: Banyan Risk Opens New MGA Line for Digital Asset and Crypto Risk
summary: Bermuda-based insurtech Banyan Risk launched a Digital Assets & Emerging Risks product backed by QBE's Lloyd's Syndicate 1886, offering D&O, professional liability and crime coverage tailored to crypto exchanges, custodians and fintech platforms in fast-evolving markets.

headline: Insurers file for a second straight year of double-digit ACA marketplace price hikes
summary: New preliminary filings across all 50 states show insurers proposing a median 15% premium increase for 2027 plans, following a roughly 20% jump in 2026, with insurers citing hospital and drug cost growth, GLP-1 spending, and continued uncertainty over expired enhanced subsidies.

headline: States race to prepare enrollees as Medicaid work-requirement deadline nears
summary: State Medicaid agencies are in a mandated outreach window through August 31 to notify expansion-population members that they must soon document 80 hours a month of work, school or other qualifying activity, with Nebraska already live and national enforcement starting for new applicants in January 2027.

headline: CVS Health refreshes its board, adding a JPMorgan data chief as a director departs
summary: CVS Health said it will add JPMorgan Chase's chief data and analytics officer, Teresa Heitsenrether, to its board this fall, shortly after another director resigned from the board without citing any disagreement with the company.

headline: Federal regulators close out settlements with all three major drug middlemen
summary: Following settlements with Express Scripts and CVS Caremark earlier in 2026, the FTC reached a proposed settlement with Optum Rx over alleged anticompetitive insulin-pricing practices, completing a sweep of the three dominant PBMs alongside new federal transparency and rebate-reform laws taking effect through 2029.

headline: India's insurance regulator rolls out a wave of policyholder-friendly health rules
summary: IRDAI is implementing reforms tied to the Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha Act, including shorter pre-existing-condition waiting periods, removal of age caps on buying cover, and new insurer/hospital performance scorecards, as health premiums in India grew more than 27% year-on-year.

headline: Private equity's buying spree of doctor practices cools sharply
summary: PitchBook data show private-equity acquisitions of physician practices on pace to roughly halve in 2026 versus 2025, down from a 2021 peak of 851 deals to about 105 in the first half of the year, as more than a dozen states tighten oversight of such transactions.

headline: Epic pushes into the AI documentation market, challenging scribe startups
summary: Epic's new AI Charting tool listens in on patient visits, drafts clinical notes and suggests orders, leveraging the EHR giant's roughly 42% share of the acute-care hospital market to compete directly with well-funded ambient-scribe startups like Abridge and Ambience.

headline: FDA advances plan to stream clinical trial data to regulators in real time
summary: The FDA is finalizing selection criteria and completing pilot site selections in August for its real-time clinical trials initiative, building on two proof-of-concept studies that already report endpoints and safety signals to the agency as they happen.

headline: Mayo Clinic's longtime president and CEO plans to depart by year-end
summary: Gianrico Farrugia, who has led Mayo Clinic as president and CEO, has said he intends to step down at the end of 2026, setting up a leadership transition at one of the country's most prominent academic health systems.

headline: NHS speeds up AI deployment to tackle waiting lists across England
summary: NHS England is accelerating rollout of AI tools including an app-based triage assistant, ambient note-taking for outpatient visits, and expanded AI-assisted chest X-ray screening now used in about half of trusts, backed by roughly £10 billion in funding over three years.

headline: Record summer A&E crowding exposes NHS hospital capacity and heat strain
summary: NHS emergency departments logged a record 2.5 million attendances in July amid back-to-back heatwaves, while nearly half of trusts reported ward temperatures above 33C, underscoring capacity and infrastructure pressure on the health service.

headline: WHO's global health funding gap widens after US pulls Gavi channel funding
summary: The Trump administration moved to cut off WHO's access to Gavi vaccine-alliance funding, deepening an agency budget shortfall now estimated near $1.9 billion of a planned $4.2 billion 2026-27 budget and adding to strain on global immunization and health-system programs.

headline: Global TPA Market Value Jumps by $32 Billion as AI Claims Tools Spread
summary: A new market report pegs the worldwide insurance TPA industry at roughly $404 billion for 2026, crediting AI-driven claims automation, rising claims volumes and continued outsourcing of benefits administration, with growth projected to continue through 2030.

headline: India's Centricity Banks $33M to Scale Wealth Distribution Platform
summary: Wealth-management fintech Centricity raised a $33 million round led by SMBC's Asia Rising Fund, pushing its valuation to about $216 million as it expands its B2B2C wealth distribution business, private wealth arm and NRI-focused offerings.

headline: Insurity Elevates Jatin Atre to CEO, Commits $100M to AI Core Systems
summary: MGA and broker technology vendor Insurity promoted President Jatin Atre to chief executive, with predecessor Jeff Clarke moving to executive chairman, alongside a fresh $100 million pledge over two years toward AI-embedded core-system modernization.

headline: India hospital stocks slide after lawmakers float room-rate price caps
summary: Shares of Apollo Hospitals, Max Healthcare and Fortis Healthcare fell as much as 7% after a Parliamentary Standing Committee recommended that private hospital room charges be benchmarked to prevailing three-star hotel tariffs.

headline: SimplyGo and EFGH explore embedded micro-insurance partnership for gig and mobility platforms
summary: Mobility platform SimplyGo and EFGH entered a strategic partnership to explore embedded micro-insurance services, the latest example of fintech and mobility platforms bundling coverage directly into digital products.

headline: Target-date fund assets climb to $5.3 trillion as income-focused series from Vanguard and Transamerica prepare to launch
summary: US target-date fund assets across mutual funds and collective investment trusts grew 11% in the first half of 2026 to $5.3 trillion, with new retirement-income-focused TDF series from Vanguard and Transamerica set to launch later this year.

headline: LIMRA holds $450 billion-plus annuity sales forecast for 2026 despite expected Fed rate cuts
summary: Despite anticipated Federal Reserve rate cuts through the rest of 2026, LIMRA is maintaining its forecast that annuity sales will stay above $450 billion, with registered index-linked annuities on pace to exceed $75 billion as the category keeps growing.

headline: 401(k) recordkeepers navigate fee pressure as 2026 elective deferral cap rises to $24,500
summary: Retirement plan recordkeepers are contending with declining fee revenue even as plan sponsors demand more technology and participant services, while the IRS's 2026 401(k) elective deferral limit climbed to $24,500.

headline: Thoma Bravo to acquire broker platform Accelerant Holdings in $4 billion-plus buyout
summary: Private equity firm Thoma Bravo agreed to acquire Accelerant Holdings at a 49% premium to its prior closing price, an enterprise value topping $4 billion, in one of the largest insurance distribution buyouts announced this year.

headline: Only 7% of health systems have dedicated software to manage prior authorizations, survey finds
summary: A survey highlighted in Healthcare IT Today found just 7% of provider organizations have dedicated software for managing prior authorizations, even as AI tools like Microsoft's Dragon Copilot cut clinical documentation time by double digits at systems including Intermountain Health.

headline: Bolt launches industry's first AI-powered insurance distribution platform spanning admitted, E&S and wholesale
summary: Insurtech Bolt introduced Connected Distribution, an AI-driven platform unifying customer data, quoting, binding and servicing workflows for agencies, brokerages and carriers across all distribution channels.

headline: Munich Re to acquire cyber insurtech At-Bay for $575 million, folding it into HSB
summary: Munich Re agreed to buy US cyber insurtech At-Bay, the largest wholesale-channel writer of cyber insurance, for $575 million, placing it within its Hartford Steam Boiler specialty subsidiary to strengthen its cyber risk and proactive-security offering.

headline: Specialist MGAs plug capacity gaps as broker confidence in placing complex risks climbs
summary: Nearly four in ten brokers surveyed say their confidence in placing specialist commercial motor risks with MGAs is much higher than a year ago, as managing general agents step in to fill capacity gaps left by traditional carriers.

headline: Cigna raises 2026 earnings outlook after Q2 beat driven by higher employer-plan premiums
summary: Cigna followed UnitedHealth, Elevance, Molina and Centene in posting a beat-and-raise second quarter, with stronger employer-sponsored plan profits after premium hikes prompting the insurer to lift its full-year 2026 earnings guidance.

headline: IRDAI grants ProTec General Insurance its license, the fourth new insurer approved in India in 2026
summary: India's insurance regulator issued a Certificate of Registration to ProTec General Insurance, the fourth new carrier IRDAI has approved this year, comprising two general insurers, one health insurer and one reinsurer.

headline: Edelman Financial Engines names its first retirement advisory chief to grow workplace plan services
summary: Edelman Financial Engines hired a OneTrust alum as its first dedicated retirement advisory chief, part of a broader push among RIA platforms to expand into workplace retirement plan advisory services.

headline: Cambridge Investment Research rolls out agentic AI that cuts account-opening from 17 minutes to seconds
summary: Broker-dealer Cambridge Investment Research deployed an agentic AI tool that automates parts of its direct account-opening workflow, compressing a process that used to take advisors roughly 17 minutes down to seconds.

headline: NAIC's life and annuities regulators convene at 2026 summer national meeting in Columbus
summary: State insurance regulators on the NAIC's Life Insurance and Annuities Committee met in Columbus on August 12 as part of the NAIC's 2026 Summer National Meeting, continuing the panel's ongoing life and annuity policy agenda.

headline: Insurers deepen pivot into private assets as credit spreads stay historically tight, Mercer finds
summary: With traditional credit spreads compressed, insurers are increasingly turning to private markets, with asset-backed finance and investment-grade private placements drawing the greatest interest as carriers look to preserve investment income, according to Mercer.

headline: US P&C insurers' 2025 profitability peak gives way to slowing growth in 2026
summary: US property and casualty insurers' returns appear to have peaked in 2025, with 2026 growth cooling as competition intensifies, capital remains plentiful and pricing softens across most commercial lines.

headline: Fiduciary Services Group completes its third TPA acquisition of 2026 with RetireWell Administrators deal
summary: Fiduciary Services Group, parent of DWC - The 401(k) Experts, acquired New Jersey retirement-plan TPA RetireWell Administrators, its third such deal this year as consolidation continues among firms serving small and mid-size retirement plans.

headline: TPA and claims-services consolidation accelerates as larger platforms roll up regional firms
summary: Consolidation in the third-party administration and claims services market is picking up pace, with regional and specialty TPAs being acquired by larger platforms seeking broader geographic reach and service offerings.

headline: Bank-fintech embedded finance partnerships draw closer regulatory scrutiny as the model matures
summary: A growing share of FDIC and OCC enforcement actions have targeted sponsor banks in embedded finance partnerships, even as the Acting Comptroller signals continued support for bank-fintech tie-ups going forward.

headline: ACA marketplace premiums jump for 2026 as enhanced subsidies expire
summary: ACA marketplace premiums are rising sharply heading into 2026 as enhanced federal subsidies wind down, with insurers citing both the subsidy cliff and underlying medical cost trend as drivers of the increase.

headline: F&G Annuities & Life swings to $81 million Q2 loss as alternative investment income lags
summary: F&G Annuities & Life reported a second-quarter 2026 net loss of $81 million, reversing a year-earlier profit, as softer opportunistic sales margins and underperforming alternative investments weighed on adjusted earnings despite continued strong annuity demand.

headline: Brighthouse Financial's annuities segment earnings climb to $349 million in Q2
summary: Brighthouse Financial's second-quarter 2026 annuities segment adjusted earnings rose to $349 million from $332 million a year earlier, per the insurer's SEC filing, as annuity sales continue to anchor results amid a broader strategic review.

headline: LIC of India's profit jumps 24% on strong new-business premium growth
summary: Life Insurance Corporation of India's consolidated net profit rose nearly 24% to roughly Rs 13,584 crore for the quarter ended June 2026, with new-business premium up almost 7%, even as the state-run insurer proceeds with an August offer-for-sale of shares.

headline: Empower to acquire Milliman's retirement administration business for $340 million
summary: Empower agreed to acquire Milliman's retirement plan administration unit for $340 million, a deal expected to close in the second half of 2026 and add roughly 400 defined-benefit plans and about 790,000 plan participants to Empower's recordkeeping platform.

headline: Industry submits final comments as DOL's alternative-assets 401(k) rule nears finish line
summary: Retirement-industry groups filed final comments on the Department of Labor's proposed rule clarifying fiduciary duties for selecting alternative investments in 401(k) plans, after the public comment period drew nearly 45,000 responses ahead of its June 1 close.

headline: 401(k) recordkeeper consolidation stalls on valuation gaps and shifting business models
summary: A wave of expected recordkeeper M&A has cooled in 2026, with advisors and dealmakers pointing to mismatched valuation expectations and recordkeepers' pivot toward broader financial-wellness services as reasons deals are taking longer to close.

headline: American Financial Group's P&C investment income jumps 23% on alternative portfolio gains
summary: American Financial Group reported second-quarter 2026 net investment income of $221 million in its property and casualty operations, up 23% year over year, driven by stronger returns from its alternative investments including managed CLOs.

headline: Enact's net investment income rises 11% in Q2 as new-money yields top 5%
summary: Mortgage insurer Enact Holdings reported second-quarter 2026 net investment income of $73 million, an 11% increase from a year earlier, as higher portfolio book yields and new-money investment rates above 5% lifted returns.

headline: Private credit consolidation gathers pace as asset managers race to scale platforms
summary: Dealmaking among private credit managers has accelerated through 2026, with firms pursuing mergers to build scale and breadth even as skeptics raise concerns about underwriting standards across the fast-growing asset class.

headline: Corient buys $21 billion Summit Trail Advisors in its largest deal yet
summary: Corient, the world's largest multi-family office and non-bank wealth manager with roughly $556 billion in AUM, agreed to acquire ultra-high-net-worth-focused RIA Summit Trail Advisors, deepening its push into the wealthiest client segment.

headline: SEC forms Retail Fraud Working Group to sharpen focus on advisor and broker misconduct
summary: The SEC's Division of Enforcement launched a new Retail Fraud Working Group to coordinate the agency's response to fraud targeting individual investors, including breaches of duty by investment advisers and broker-dealers.

headline: US commercial P&C premiums post first quarterly decline in nearly nine years
summary: Average commercial property-casualty premiums fell in the first quarter of 2026, ending a 33-quarter streak of increases, as ample capital and intensifying competition push property rates down even while casualty lines keep hardening.

headline: Guy Carpenter names global property and casualty leaders in newly created roles
summary: Guy Carpenter appointed David Duffy as global property leader and Chris Ross as global casualty leader, two newly created roles meant to mobilize the reinsurance broker's best practices for clients across the property-casualty market.

headline: Aon launches $200 million 'Sidecar X' facility to streamline transactional risk insurance
summary: Aon debuted Sidecar X, a facility offering up to $200 million in dedicated capacity for representations-and-warranties and tax insurance, using pre-agreed underwriting frameworks to give clients faster placement and a 10% premium discount.

headline: IRDAI unveils reforms streamlining capital rules and boosting policyholder protections
summary: India's insurance regulator adopted a package of reforms easing capital infusion and corporate restructuring rules for insurers while operationalizing a new Policyholders' Education and Protection Fund, part of its implementation of the 2025 insurance law amendments.

headline: Mile Auto acquires Georgia's Insurance House to expand Southeast MGA platform
summary: AI-driven MGA Mile Auto acquired Atlanta-based Insurance House, combining to serve more than 55,000 policyholders and 1,600 independent agencies across 10 states under a platform generating nearly $100 million in annual premium.

headline: Gallagher's wholesale unit RPS buys Kansas MGA Med James to extend reach across six states
summary: Arthur J. Gallagher's wholesale brokerage arm Risk Placement Services acquired Med James, an Overland Park, Kansas-based MGA focused on property-casualty and transportation risks, continuing a string of wholesale tuck-in deals.

headline: AI-native brokerage network American Growth Insurance makes first agency acquisition
summary: American Growth Insurance, an AI-native insurance brokerage network, acquired Baltimore-based Heller-Kowitz Insurance Advisors as its first deal in a planned build-out of operator-led agencies starting in the Mid-Atlantic.

headline: Old Republic spins off Lodestar as independent brand for its TPA business
summary: Old Republic International launched Lodestar Claims & Risk Services as a standalone brand for its third-party administrator operations, the first time in more than 30 years the unit has operated under its own identity while keeping the same claims teams.

headline: Global insurance TPA market forecast to reach $845 billion by 2031 on AI-driven claims growth
summary: A new market report values the global insurance third-party-administrator sector at roughly $592.5 billion in 2026, projecting growth to $845.3 billion by 2031 as insurers increasingly outsource claims processing to tech-enabled TPAs.

headline: Axle raises $17.5 million to scale AI-native insurance clearinghouse
summary: Axle, which builds a programmable clearinghouse connecting insurance carriers to underlying transactions, raised a $17.5 million Series A led by Base10 Partners to expand from five to more than 50 insurance segments.

headline: Increase launches FDIC-member bank charter for fintech builders
summary: Banking infrastructure provider Increase launched an FDIC-member bank aimed at giving fintech and insurtech builders more direct, compliant access to core banking rails.

headline: Munich Re to acquire cyber insurtech At-Bay for $575 million
summary: Munich Re agreed to acquire At-Bay, a top-10 U.S. cyber insurer with $278 million in gross written premium, in a $575 million deal expected to close in early 2027 and strengthen Munich Re's integrated cyber risk-mitigation platform.

headline: FCA fast-tracks insurtech Urban Jungle after its IKEA embedded-insurance launch
summary: The UK's FCA selected home-insurance insurtech Urban Jungle for its Scale-up Unit, the only insurtech among five firms chosen, days after Urban Jungle launched an embedded home-insurance partnership with IKEA's UK stores.

headline: CMS's 2026 Medicare Advantage rule bars retroactive denials, tightens prior-authorization timelines
summary: CMS finalized 2026 Medicare Advantage rules requiring plans to honor prior-authorization decisions, barring retroactive denial of approved services absent fraud, and setting 72-hour and seven-day response deadlines for expedited and standard requests.

headline: Cigna's Brian Evanko formally succeeds David Cordani as CEO
summary: The Cigna Group's planned leadership transition took effect, with Brian Evanko becoming CEO while David Cordani moved into the role of executive chair after leading the health insurer for more than a decade.

headline: Ascension closes $3.9 billion AmSurg deal after FTC-mandated divestitures
summary: Nonprofit health system Ascension closed its $3.9 billion acquisition of ambulatory surgery center operator AmSurg after agreeing to divest seven surgery centers to satisfy FTC competition concerns, becoming the country's third-largest ASC platform.

headline: Roche to acquire digital pathology AI firm PathAI for up to $1.05 billion
summary: Roche agreed to acquire PathAI, whose AISight platform helps pathology labs move from manual slide review to AI-augmented digital workflows, in a deal worth up to $1.05 billion including milestone payments.

headline: Massachusetts orders $8.4 million in dental insurance rebates under first-in-nation law
summary: Massachusetts became the first state to enforce dental-insurer rebates, ordering six carriers including Blue Cross Blue Shield and Guardian to return $8.4 million to policyholders after missing the state's 83% dental loss-ratio threshold.

headline: AI-decisioning startup Taktile raises $110 million Series C led by Goldman Sachs
summary: Taktile, which helps banks and insurers automate underwriting, claims and other high-stakes decisions with AI, closed a $110 million round led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives, with Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, Tiger Global and Y Combinator also participating.

headline: Chubb Tempest Re names new Executive Chairman and President in reinsurance leadership shakeup
summary: Chubb elevated James Wixtead to Executive Chairman of its Tempest Re reinsurance business and named Michael O'Donnell President, effective August 1, as part of a broader realignment of Chubb's global reinsurance leadership.

headline: India proposes first overhaul of insurance rules in nearly 90 years
summary: The Finance Ministry released draft Insurance Rules, 2026 to replace regulations dating to 1939, adding stricter agent requirements, clearer shareholding rules and greater product-disclosure transparency; a 30-day public comment period is open.

headline: IRDAI approves new policyholder-protection and penalty regulations at its 137th Authority meeting
summary: India's insurance regulator approved a raft of reforms — including new policyholder education and protection fund rules, a revised penalty framework, and amendments affecting third-party administrators — to align with the Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha Act and simplify compliance.

headline: Commercial P&C market conditions turn more favorable for buyers in midyear 2026 update
summary: Alera Group's midyear market update finds commercial insurance conditions easing for many businesses, even as RBC Capital Markets warns that softer primary property pricing and elevated catastrophe losses could pressure insurer earnings.

headline: Global wealth-insurance sales jump 46% over two years as high-net-worth planning needs evolve
summary: International wealth insurance sales rose from £36.4 billion to £53 billion between 2023 and 2025, a roughly 21% compound annual growth rate, as affluent clients increasingly use insurance wrappers for cross-border wealth planning.

headline: More insurers retreat from ACA marketplaces for 2027, including Medica and Elevance
summary: Medica will stop offering individual ACA marketplace plans in Iowa, Kansas and Oklahoma, while Elevance is exiting Ohio's small-group exchange, part of a wave of at least 11 insurers scaling back ACA participation amid falling enrollment and the expiration of enhanced premium tax credits.

headline: Insurers keep raising private credit exposure despite market jitters, survey finds
summary: More than half of insurers surveyed plan to increase private credit exposure over the next two years, according to Goldman Sachs Asset Management's 2026 Global Insurance Survey, even as investor anxiety over loan defaults and credit quality has grown.

headline: Outdated recordkeeping technology could be costing the U.S. retirement industry billions, study finds
summary: A new study finds legacy recordkeeping infrastructure is straining under demand for better participant tools, with consulting estimates suggesting AI-driven modernization could save the retirement and pension industry $16 billion to $20 billion in operating costs.

headline: AI cuts underwriting cycle times but widens gap between insurers and disrupted agents
summary: Panelists report AI-driven underwriting platforms now pull data from electronic health records, prescription histories and wearables to render near-instant decisions, cutting underwriting and claims processing times by up to 40% — even as the same tools reshape, and in some cases threaten, the traditional agent's role.

headline: Providence Health Plan to shut down entirely after Medicare Advantage sale collapses
summary: The Renton, Washington-based nonprofit's roughly 440,000-member health plan will wind down after talks with an unnamed carrier to keep its Medicare Advantage book alive fell apart; coverage continues without interruption through the end of 2026.

headline: AdvisorFinder launches tool to show advisors how AI search engines portray them online
summary: AdvisorFinder Intelligence gives financial advisors a Digital Presence Report grading their search visibility, website health and online credibility, alongside a prioritized plan to improve how AI tools recommend them.

headline: Retirement income tools set to move from pilot to mainstream adoption in 2026, IRIC forecasts
summary: The Institutional Retirement Income Council projects plan sponsors will shift from exploring in-plan retirement income solutions to actually rolling them out this year, alongside expanded financial wellness offerings.

headline: APAC insurers navigate geopolitics, catastrophe losses and AI disruption heading into 2026
summary: Industry outlooks point to double-digit new-business growth for Asia-Pacific life insurers in China, Hong Kong and Singapore, while P&C insurers in the region face rising per-claim costs tied to trade tensions and climate-driven disasters.

headline: Marsh McLennan Agency to acquire Iowa's Accel Holdings, expanding Midwest footprint
summary: MMA agreed to acquire the 90-year-old, employee-owned Accel Group, adding agribusiness, wealth management and retirement advisory capabilities across seven offices in Iowa, Illinois, Missouri and Kansas.

headline: Munich Re to acquire cyber insurtech At-Bay for $575 million
summary: Munich Re's Hartford Steam Boiler unit will absorb At-Bay, a top-10 US cyber insurer, in a deal valuing the company at roughly 2x gross written premium — a material step down from its 2021 venture valuation.

headline: Willis Re to acquire BMS Group's U.S. reinsurance division
summary: Willis Re agreed to buy BMS Re US, including its reinsurance broking and capital advisory teams, giving the WTW/Bain Capital-backed reinsurance broker an operational presence in the world's largest insurance market.

headline: Bolt debuts what it calls an industry-first AI insurance platform
summary: Bolt launched a new AI-driven platform aimed at reshaping how insurance products are built and distributed, part of a broader wave of insurtechs racing to embed generative AI across the policy lifecycle.

headline: Delaware Life and Clear Spring probed over $17 billion in reclassified related-party investments
summary: Federal prosecutors and the SEC are examining whether the two Group 1001 insurers, controlled by Dodgers/Lakers owner Mark Walter, properly disclosed that roughly 39% of their invested assets -- about $17 billion -- were tied to Walter-affiliated companies rather than the 3% originally reported to regulators.

headline: MassMutual Ascend's advisory annuity business crosses $2 billion in lifetime sales
summary: MassMutual Ascend said its fee-based annuity lineup, distributed through more than 1,700 advisor reps at nearly 1,000 RIAs, has now generated over $2 billion in cumulative sales, with almost half of that volume coming in just the past two years.

headline: Nitrogen launches AI scoring tool to flag life, long-term-care and annuity coverage gaps
summary: Wealth-tech platform Nitrogen rolled out an 'Insurance Center' module built around a Coverage Number score that compares a client's existing life, long-term-care and annuity protection against calculated need, giving advisors a fast way to spot under- or over-insured clients.

headline: M&G completes another UK bulk annuity deal as pension buy-in demand stays strong
summary: M&G finalized an £85 million bulk purchase annuity transaction covering roughly 740 members of the Altro Pension Scheme, part of a busy year of UK buy-in activity fueled by elevated annuity pricing rates and improved defined-benefit funding levels.

headline: India's life insurers see brighter FY27 outlook after GST relief on retail policies
summary: Industry commentary citing HDFC Life's chairman points to healthy life insurance demand ahead, aided by India's favorable demographics and the recent removal of GST on retail life insurance products, which has improved affordability for buyers.

headline: ManhattanLife extends its buyout streak with Union Security Life acquisition
summary: The Manhattan Life Insurance Company completed its purchase of Union Security Life Insurance Company of New York from Assurant, adding a New York life, annuity and accident-and-health block to a growth strategy built on more than 100 prior company and block acquisitions.

headline: Protective Life lines up CEO succession as Bielen prepares to retire
summary: Protective Life Corporation announced that longtime chief executive Rich Bielen will retire at the end of 2026, with current president and CFO Paul Wells named to take over as president and CEO starting January 1, 2027.

headline: DOL maps out 2026 retirement rulemaking, from e-delivery rules to benchmarking guidance
summary: The Department of Labor's latest regulatory agenda includes a proposed SECURE 2.0 rule on paper benefit statements and e-disclosure starting with the 2026 plan year, plus a target of October 2026 for guidance letting blended-asset investments be benchmarked against a mix of market indices.

headline: UK's Pension Schemes Act 2026 becomes law, reshaping DC pensions for 20 million-plus savers
summary: The newly enacted Pension Schemes Act 2026 requires UK pension schemes to prove they deliver value for money, enables automatic consolidation of small deferred pension pots, and pushes the market toward larger, better-performing default funds -- reforms the government says could add up to £29,000 to a typical saver's pot.

headline: Ascensus to buy AmericanTCS, adding trust, custody and ERISA tech to its retirement platform
summary: Retirement services provider Ascensus agreed to acquire AmericanTCS, gaining trust, custody and ERISA technology tools -- including PensionPro and ERISApedia -- that expand its pooled employer plan and fiduciary services for recordkeepers, banks, insurers and asset managers; the deal is expected to close in the third quarter of 2026.

headline: Australian Retirement Trust eyes Southeast Asia for its next wave of long-term investment
summary: Executives from Australian Retirement Trust said at a Hanoi investor roundtable that Southeast Asia is becoming an increasingly attractive destination for large pension funds looking to diversify their portfolios beyond the US market.

headline: In-plan retirement-income annuities keep growing but still cover only a sliver of 401(k)s
summary: A Plan Sponsor Council of America survey found only about 5% of 401(k) plans currently offer a target-date fund with a built-in annuity and roughly 15% are considering it, showing that despite years of provider investment, guaranteed-income options remain niche due to limited employee understanding.

headline: Retirement plan providers push deeper into AI for personalized participant guidance
summary: Recordkeepers and advisory firms are rolling out AI tools that combine participant data with large language models to deliver real-time, personalized retirement guidance and forecast income shortfalls, even as fiduciary oversight of these new tools becomes a bigger governance concern.

headline: PGIM's assets climb to $1.49 trillion as Prudential's Q2 results beat estimates
summary: Prudential Financial's second-quarter 2026 results topped analyst expectations, helped by PGIM's asset management fee income rising on market gains and PGIM's assets under management climbing to $1.49 trillion, up from $1.43 trillion the prior quarter.

headline: CVC completes takeover of US credit manager Marathon Asset Management
summary: European private equity firm CVC Capital Partners closed its roughly $1.2-1.6 billion acquisition of Marathon Asset Management, rebranding the $24 billion credit specialist as CVC Marathon with a goal of growing the combined credit platform toward EUR200 billion in fee-paying assets by 2028.

headline: RGA's investment income strengthens as new-money yields climb past 6%
summary: Reinsurance Group of America's second-quarter 2026 earnings showed new money yields of about 6.02% and variable investment income returns of roughly 15%, underscoring how persistently higher interest rates continue to lift reinsurer and insurer portfolio income.

headline: Private credit managers pivot away from direct lending as fundraising cools sharply
summary: Bloomberg reports that direct-lending fundraising has slumped -- non-traded business development company fundraising fell about 82% year over year in the second quarter -- pushing asset managers toward asset-based finance and credit-secondaries strategies instead.

headline: Playbook rolls out AI workflow-orchestration platform for advisory firms
summary: Formerly known as Powder, Playbook launched an AI orchestration platform that lets RIAs, family offices and wealth firms automate complex operational workflows and continuously refine them.

headline: Motilal Oswal's asset management arm tops ₹2 trillion in assets
summary: Motilal Oswal AMC said its combined mutual fund, alternatives and portfolio-management assets crossed ₹2 trillion in August 2026, helped by new product launches and steady SIP inflows through the fiscal year.

headline: Sun Life debuts global private-wealth platform to chase Asia's HNWI boom
summary: Sun Life launched a new global private wealth platform aimed at Asia's fast-growing high-net-worth population, betting on the region's expanding pool of affluent clients.

headline: FCA moves to simplify pay rules and reporting for UK investment advisers
