summary: Guy Carpenter data show reinsurer capacity and abundant risk appetite pushed cat bond issuance to an all-time first-half high of $17.3 billion, while property catastrophe rates fell the most since the late 1990s at mid-year renewals.

headline: CMS finalizes FY2027 hospital payment rule with 2.3% rate increase
summary: The final inpatient prospective payment system rule raises Medicare hospital payments by about $2.1 billion in fiscal 2027 for facilities meeting quality-reporting and EHR requirements, while trimming disproportionate-share hospital payments by $200 million.

headline: Savvy adds Blue Barn Wealth and Paragon Private Wealth, crossing $8 billion in AUM
summary: The two independent firms bring roughly $550 million in combined assets to Savvy's network, part of a run that has brought in over $4 billion in recruited assets in 2026 and quadrupled the platform's total AUM year over year.

headline: Hong Kong curbs first-year insurance commissions amid soaring mainland demand
summary: The city's insurance authority tightened first-year commission structures for its more than 800 licensed broker companies as mainland Chinese buyers continue to drive a surge in long-term policy sales.

headline: York Hospital-MaineHealth merger clears state approval, set to close October 1
summary: Maine regulators approved the merger after York Hospital said it could no longer operate independently amid rising labor and supply costs, with conditions barring service cuts in southern York County for three years without state notice.

headline: EIOPA elects Bank of Greece supervisor Stavros Konstantas to its Management Board
summary: Konstantas, director of occupational and private insurance supervision at the Bank of Greece, begins a two-and-a-half-year term on the EU insurance and pensions regulator's board, succeeding Ante Zigman after his move to lead Croatia's central bank.

headline: Hong Kong's new crypto rules could open an $82 billion insurance opportunity
summary: New digital-asset regulation in Hong Kong is creating a potential market for insurers to cover crypto custody, exchange and institutional-holding risk, as the territory positions itself as a digital-asset hub.

headline: Retirement income council calls decumulation the next frontier for defined-contribution plans
summary: The Institutional Retirement Income Council outlined five moves plan sponsors should make now to help participants convert savings into retirement income, as the industry's attention shifts from asset accumulation to drawdown.

headline: Corebridge Financial and Equitable Holdings name leadership team as $22 billion merger advances
summary: The two insurers announced the executive team that will run the combined retirement, life, wealth and asset management company after shareholders of both firms approved the all-stock deal in late July.

headline: MAI Capital enters Atlanta market with $490 million Waypoint Wealth Counsel acquisition
summary: The Cleveland-based RIA, backed by a recent Carlyle investment, added the fee-only Atlanta firm and its more than 100 households, giving Waypoint's founders access to MAI's family-office platform, lending and alternative-investment sourcing.

headline: Thoma Bravo to take specialty insurer Accelerant private in $4 billion-plus deal
summary: The software-focused investment firm agreed to buy the Accelerant Risk Exchange platform for $20.25 a share in cash, a 49% premium, with Accelerant's largest investor and founders keeping equity alongside Thoma Bravo.

headline: Wawanesa Insurance rebrands as W Insurance in its California personal-lines business
summary: The San Diego-based carrier, acquired by the Automobile Club of Southern California's affiliated insurer in 2024, shortened its name for its roughly 300,000 auto, home, condo and renters policies, with no change to coverage, claims or servicing.

headline: Kestra Financial names ex-BlackRock executive Kelly Apple as head of wealth management
summary: Apple, who spent more than 13 years at BlackRock and previously held senior roles at DWS and Van Kampen, will lead Kestra's investment management, high-net-worth, retirement and insurance, and alternative-investment teams.

headline: Calaveras County wildfire burns over 10,000 acres, affecting more than 64,000 policyholders
summary: A California wildfire that broke out earlier in the month has scorched over 10,000 acres and touched more than 64,000 policyholders, as the NAIC's summer national meeting took up property-casualty issues the same week.

headline: Healthcare Management Administrators names Diane Zalewski CEO
summary: The third-party administrator serving self-funded employers hired Zalewski, formerly president of Payer Solutions at Evernorth, where she ran a business serving health plans, TPAs and employer clients.

headline: Higginbotham joins forces with Two West Capital Advisors to grow retirement plan business
summary: The Fort Worth-based brokerage, ranked 16th-largest in the US, is bringing the Kansas City retirement-plan consulting and wealth management firm's team into its retirement and wealth division, with Two West staying in Kansas City as employee-owners of Higginbotham.

headline: Clinician AI use triples as 74% of doctors and 70% of nurses adopt weekly
summary: A new report finds daily multiple-times-per-day AI use has tripled among doctors and doubled among nurses since 2025, driven by generative AI breakthroughs, near-universal EHR adoption and surging institutional investment in cognitive-computing infrastructure.

headline: NewYork-Presbyterian and UnitedHealthcare Medicare Advantage contract set to lapse August 31
summary: After repeated extensions since a January deadline, the hospital system and insurer face an August 31 cutoff that would push most UnitedHealthcare Medicare Advantage members out of network, part of a wider pattern of health-system/payer contract breaks in 2026.

headline: DC plan sponsors show rising appetite for alternative investments as DOL rule advances
summary: New research finds 44% of defined-contribution plan sponsors want to learn more about adding alternatives to 401(k) lineups, with large and mega plans most interested, as the Department of Labor works through a proposed fiduciary safe harbor for the asset class.

headline: Swiss Re posts 9% rise in first-half profit to $2.8 billion, on pace for full-year target
summary: The reinsurer beat analyst expectations with a 22.7% return on equity in the first half, putting it ahead of pace toward its goal of at least $4.5 billion in full-year net income, and it raised its 2028 cost-reduction target to $500 million.

headline: Bolt launches industry's first AI-powered insurance distribution platform
summary: The insurtech's new Connected Distribution platform uses conversational and workflow AI to handle quoting, binding, servicing and renewals for agencies, brokerages and carriers across admitted, E&S and wholesale markets.

headline: FTC settlement forces Caremark to overhaul drug-pricing practices, unlocking up to $13 billion in savings
summary: The commission's settlement with CVS Health's Caremark and Zinc Health Services requires the PBM to pass negotiated discounts to patients, cap insulin out-of-pocket costs and stop blocking third-party pharmacy assistance, with an independent monitor overseeing compliance for three years.

headline: WTW completes $1.3 billion acquisition of tech-enabled broker Newfront
summary: Willis Towers Watson finalized its purchase of Newfront Insurance Holdings for $1.3 billion, adding the San Francisco-based broker's technology-driven middle-market and specialty business to its Risk & Broking and Health, Wealth & Career units.

headline: DOL proposes first federal fee-disclosure rule targeting PBMs and TPAs
summary: The US Department of Labor proposed a rule that would require pharmacy benefit managers and third-party administrators to give employer-sponsored ERISA health plans detailed advance disclosure of the fees they charge.

headline: Singapore refreshes AI-in-healthcare guidelines with bias and performance monitoring rules
summary: Singapore's Ministry of Health and Health Sciences Authority published updated AI in Healthcare Guidelines requiring ongoing validation, performance monitoring and bias detection for clinical AI tools deployed in the city-state.

headline: TWFG expands agency footprint with Iowa-based Fortress Insurance Services deal
summary: TWFG completed its acquisition of Fortress Insurance Services, an independent Iowa agency, effective May 1, 2026, continuing a string of tuck-in agency and MGA purchases this year.

headline: Satellite radar startup ICEYE raises over €1 billion, valuation tops €10 billion
summary: Finnish satellite-imaging company ICEYE raised more than €1 billion in a General Atlantic-led Series F round, pushing its valuation above €10 billion as it doubles annual satellite production for sovereign and insurance risk clients.

headline: Cyber insurance pricing keeps softening even as third-party claims climb 30%
summary: The US cyber insurance market logged an eighth straight quarter of pricing cuts even as third-party claims rose roughly 30%, a trend likely to pressure loss ratios given the longer tail on such claims.

headline: AIG names Nancy Bewlay global chief underwriting officer
summary: AIG appointed Nancy Bewlay, formerly AXA's group chief underwriting and pricing officer, as executive vice president and global chief underwriting officer effective September 8, 2026, reporting to CEO Eric Andersen.

headline: Bank of England's new insurer liquidity reporting rules take effect September 30
summary: New Bank of England liquidity reporting requirements for large UK Solvency II insurers with significant derivatives or securities-lending exposure come into force on September 30, 2026, closing a gap flagged in an earlier PRA consultation.

headline: CVS Health tops Q2 estimates and lifts guidance as Aetna shows signs of recovery
summary: CVS Health beat second-quarter earnings and revenue estimates and raised its 2026 guidance as its Aetna insurance unit continued to recover, though shares slipped after the company flagged expected membership declines at Caremark.

headline: Assurant's net investment income jumps 19% in first half of 2026
summary: Assurant reported net investment income of $302.0 million for the first six months of 2026, up from $253.5 million a year earlier, driven by higher yields and larger fixed-maturity holdings.

headline: AI-native advisor platform Jump raises $80 million Series B
summary: Jump, an AI platform for financial advisors, raised an $80 million Series B led by Insight Partners with participation from F-Prime Capital and Allianz Life Ventures, four times the size of its Series A.

headline: Willis Re to acquire BMS Group's US reinsurance division
summary: Willis Re agreed to buy the US reinsurance broking and capital-advisory business of BMS Group, including its catastrophe bond and ILS team, marking Willis Re's first major deal since its relaunch.

headline: Catastrophe bond issuance hits record $24.9 billion as alternative capital tops $144 billion
summary: Aon's latest Insurance-Linked Securities report shows catastrophe bond issuance reached an all-time high of $24.9 billion over the year to June 30, 2026, pushing total alternative reinsurance capital to a record $144.5 billion.

headline: AI-labeled insurtechs capture 99% of second-quarter funding as early-stage deals cool
summary: AI-focused insurtechs absorbed 99.1% of all Q2 2026 insurtech funding, or $2.42 billion, even as early-stage deal activity slowed, extending a run in which AI has dominated investor interest in the sector.

headline: MGA deal-making accelerates as carriers and private equity chase scale
summary: Mergers and acquisitions among managing general agencies have picked up in both number and size, with carriers and private-equity investors increasingly pursuing MGA platforms as specialty and E&S business keeps growing.

headline: CMS finalizes 2027 Medicare Advantage rate hike alongside tighter prior-authorization rules
summary: CMS finalized a 2.48% increase to 2027 Medicare Advantage payments, worth more than $13 billion, while its 2026 final rule requires MA and Part D plans to decide expedited prior-authorization requests within 72 hours.

headline: India's health insurance premiums jump 27% on digital distribution and NRI demand
summary: Indian health insurance premiums grew 27.2% year-on-year in January 2026, with standalone health insurers up 32.3%, as digital distribution and a 126% surge in NRI purchases of Indian health cover fueled growth.

headline: Jackson National reportedly weighing acquisition of a life insurer
summary: Jackson Financial is said to be exploring the purchase of a life insurance carrier as it looks to broaden its product lineup beyond its core variable-annuity business.

headline: US employer retirement plan assets climb to $13.8 trillion
summary: Investment Company Institute data show Americans held $13.8 trillion across employer-sponsored defined contribution plans as of March 31, 2026, with $9.9 trillion of that in 401(k) accounts alone.

headline: F&G Annuities & Life completes CEO handover to Conor Murphy
summary: F&G Annuities & Life confirmed Conor Murphy as its new Chief Executive Officer and President, succeeding Chris Blunt, who retired from the role effective June 30, 2026.

headline: Insurers plan bigger private-asset bets despite macro jitters, Goldman survey finds
summary: Goldman Sachs Asset Management's 15th annual global insurance survey found most insurers see geopolitical tension and a possible US slowdown as top portfolio risks, yet 62% still plan to raise private-asset allocations this year.

headline: Merit Financial Advisors adds $900 million Commonwealth advisory team
summary: Merit Financial Advisors acquired a roughly $900 million advisory team that had been affiliated with Commonwealth Financial Network, part of a wave of tuck-in deals following Commonwealth's LPL integration.

headline: US wealthtech funding falls 41% in second quarter as mega-deals cool
summary: US wealthtech companies raised $557.8 million across 91 deals in Q2 2026, down 41% from the $948.9 million raised in Q1, as the number of $100 million-plus rounds dropped sharply.

headline: Old Republic spins out Lodestar as an independent TPA brand
summary: Old Republic International launched Lodestar Claims & Risk Services as a standalone operating company, giving its third-party administrator business its own distinct market identity for the first time in more than 30 years.

headline: UK's FCA lays out 2026 insurance supervision priorities in first annual report
summary: The Financial Conduct Authority published its first annual insurance-sector regulatory priorities report, consolidating prior portfolio letters and putting claims handling and access to insurance for vulnerable consumers at the center.

headline: Innovaccer and AWS sign multi-year deal to scale agentic AI across health systems
summary: Innovaccer and AWS announced a strategic collaboration pairing Innovaccer's healthcare AI platform with AWS infrastructure, including Bedrock and HealthLake, to help health systems and payers move AI pilots into production faster.

headline: BCG says asset managers need a new growth playbook as fee pressure mounts
summary: Boston Consulting Group's 2026 global asset management report argues the industry must rethink its economics as traditional fee-based growth slows and firms turn to alternatives and AI for margin.

headline: Qumis launches attorney-certified AI agents for commercial coverage analysis
summary: Insurtech Qumis rolled out specialist AI agents covering 16 lines of commercial insurance that analyze full programs and produce citation-backed coverage conclusions, already in use at several of the largest US brokers.

headline: NatWest launches embedded home insurance through Uinsure partnership
summary: UK bank NatWest rolled out a new home insurance offering built on Manchester-based insurtech Uinsure's digital infrastructure, part of a broader wave of embedded-insurance partnerships between banks and insurtechs this year.

headline: Japan's largest life insurers report $96 billion in unrealized bond losses
summary: Japan's four biggest life insurers saw combined paper losses on domestic bond holdings swell 7% in the quarter through June, underscoring the strain rising global yields are putting on insurer balance sheets.

headline: TIAA and Nuveen's lifetime-income target-date funds cross 1,000 employer plans
summary: TIAA and Nuveen said their suite of target-date funds with built-in annuity options, including TIAA RetirePlus and the Nuveen Lifecycle Income CIT series, has now been adopted by more than 1,000 employer retirement plans.

headline: Brokers rate the MGAs that stood out in 2026 in Insurance Business Canada's annual review
summary: Insurance Business Canada opened its 10th annual Brokers on MGAs evaluation, inviting brokers to score managing general agents on underwriting responsiveness, technical expertise, compensation and claims support.

headline: India's wealth managers grapple with fragmented data as portfolios grow more complex
summary: Industry panelists at a Hubbis discussion said rapid wealth creation and intergenerational transfer are exposing gaps in Indian wealth managers' legacy data and operating systems, pushing firms toward consolidated platforms and AI tools.

headline: Advisors take a cautious approach to AI tools despite a crowded wealthtech field
summary: At the Future Proof Citywide conference in Miami, 86 wealthtech firms competed for demo slots spanning CRM, tax planning, compliance and agentic AI assistants, but advisors said they remain cautious about full-scale adoption.

headline: Sequoia Financial expands in Colorado with $2.3 billion RIA acquisition
summary: Akron-based Sequoia Financial Group, which manages $34.9 billion in assets, acquired Colorado registered investment advisor BSW Wealth Partners in its latest consolidation move.

headline: Embedded finance's growth collides with a regulatory reckoning
summary: As embedded finance and insurance partnerships proliferate, regulators are increasing scrutiny of sponsor-bank and fintech partnerships, with compliance violations already costing many sponsor banks over $100,000 each.

headline: IRDAI proposes a nationwide Public Insurance Registry to digitize India's insurance ecosystem
summary: India's insurance regulator released a consultation paper proposing a population-scale Public Insurance Registry connecting insurers, intermediaries, reinsurers and policyholders through a single interoperable digital framework.

headline: Aon agrees to buy rival broker USI from KKR for $17 billion
summary: Aon confirmed a deal to acquire middle-market insurance broker USI Insurance Services from KKR for about $17 billion including debt, aiming to build what CEO Greg Case called a "premier" US middle-market platform.

headline: Insurtech Corgi triples valuation to $4 billion in third raise in eight weeks
summary: AI-native insurance carrier Corgi reportedly raised fresh capital at a $4 billion valuation, its third funding round in eight weeks after earlier rounds at $1.3 billion and $2.6 billion.

headline: AIG leans further into private assets to offset softening investment income
summary: AIG plans to raise its allocation to private assets as it looks to reaccelerate net investment income growth, which the insurer expects to resume by 2027.

headline: PLANSPONSOR survey finds recordkeepers still lag on integrated financial-wellness benefits
summary: The 2026 PLANSPONSOR Recordkeeping Survey found only a fifth of recordkeepers let plan sponsors choose from multiple integrated student-loan repayment programs, with many offering just one option or none.

headline: Annuity sales momentum expected to carry into 2026 as advisors court pre-retirees
summary: Industry trade group LIMRA projects continued strength in annuity sales, pointing to sustained demand from clients within five to ten years of retirement seeking protection from market volatility.

headline: Life and annuity carriers move AI from pilot projects to permanent workflows
summary: Industry analysis finds life and annuity insurers shifting AI use beyond isolated efficiency gains into underwriting triage, application intake and product recommendations as 2026 progresses.

headline: UBS taps Human Interest to handle recordkeeping for its retirement plan clients
summary: Wealth manager UBS selected fintech recordkeeper Human Interest, which integrates with more than 500 payroll providers, to automate plan administration workflows for its retirement plan business.

headline: AI-driven claims automation propels TPA market past $400 billion
summary: A global market report estimates the insurance third-party administrator sector grew roughly $32 billion year over year in 2026, crediting AI-driven claims automation and rising outsourcing demand from employer-sponsored plans.

headline: AI captures nearly all insurtech venture funding in a record second quarter
summary: Gallagher Re reported global insurtech funding hit $2.44 billion in the second quarter of 2026, the highest quarterly total since 2022, with AI-focused companies taking 99.1% of the capital raised.

headline: SECURE 2.0's Roth catch-up contribution mandate takes effect for higher earners
summary: Starting January 1, 2026, SECURE 2.0 requires employees age 50-plus earning more than $150,000 in FICA wages to make catch-up 401(k) contributions on a Roth, after-tax basis, a compliance change employers spent the year preparing payroll and plan systems for.

headline: AI-native carrier Corgi raises $108 million and wins regulatory approval to underwrite startups
summary: Corgi secured $108 million in funding along with regulatory authority to operate as a full-stack, AI-native insurance carrier focused on startup companies, with plans to expand coverage options and invest further in underwriting and claims automation.

headline: Insurtech investors write fewer, much larger checks in 2026
summary: The median insurtech funding round size roughly doubled to $30 million in 2026 from $16.5 million a year earlier, as investors consolidate capital behind fewer companies with proven AI-driven underwriting or claims capabilities.

headline: Active fixed-income managers keep beating benchmarks inside target-date funds
summary: J.P. Morgan Asset Management research finds actively managed fixed-income sleeves inside target-date funds have outperformed their benchmarks net of fees in 94% of rolling three-year periods, reinforcing active management's role in DC default investments.

headline: Sun Life and Wilton Re form strategic life and annuity reinsurance partnership, launching Windsor Life Re
summary: Sun Life and Wilton Re signed a definitive agreement combining reinsurance and asset-management capabilities across life and annuity blocks, with Wilton Re establishing the U.S./Bermuda-domiciled Windsor Life Re to support future in-force block origination.

headline: Guaranteed income options gain interest among DC plan sponsors, though adoption still lags
summary: A defined-contribution plan sponsor survey found growing interest in guaranteed retirement income options, but only 17% of sponsors said they are very or extremely likely to add one within the next 12-18 months, underscoring a gap between interest and adoption.

headline: HHS seeks public input on accelerating AI adoption across clinical care
summary: The Department of Health and Human Services issued a broad request for information asking how federal regulatory, reimbursement, and research powers could be used to speed the adoption of AI tools in clinical settings.

headline: Zurich and Farmers Exchanges to acquire MetLife's U.S. property and casualty business for $3.9 billion
summary: Zurich Insurance and the Farmers Exchanges agreed to buy MetLife's U.S. P&C operations for roughly $3.9 billion, part of a broader wave of targeted, capital-efficient consolidation among carriers this year.

headline: Tech-enabled E&S managing general agent Aurenity lands growth investment from Great Hill Partners
summary: Aurenity, a Connecticut-based technology-enabled excess-and-surplus MGA, secured a strategic investment from private equity firm Great Hill Partners to widen its underwriting bench, launch new specialty programs, and build out automation infrastructure.

headline: Caledon Group launches new MGA for complex UK and Ireland home insurance risks
summary: Caledon Group introduced Caledon MGA to write home insurance for unique, high-value, and non-standard household risks across the UK and Ireland, broadening its specialty property portfolio.

headline: Avantia adds Accredited Insurance UK as new co-insurer on its Homeprotect platform
summary: Avantia Group, parent of specialist home insurer Homeprotect, added Accredited Insurance (UK) Limited as a co-insurance partner, expanding underwriting capacity on its digital home insurance platform.

headline: UnitedHealth raises 2026 profit outlook after Q2 earnings beat expectations
summary: UnitedHealth Group lifted its full-year 2026 adjusted earnings guidance to $19.50-$20 per share, up from its prior forecast of more than $18.25, after second-quarter profit came in well ahead of Wall Street estimates.

headline: Health systems report major documentation-time savings from ambient AI scribes
summary: Intermountain Health cut time spent on visit notes by 27% and Cooper University Healthcare says clinicians are saving more than an hour of documentation time daily after deploying Microsoft's Dragon Copilot ambient AI scribe technology.

headline: Nirvana Insurance extends Series D by $100 million, lifting valuation to $1.5 billion
summary: Telematics-focused insurtech Nirvana Insurance raised a $100 million extension to its Series D round, pushing its valuation to $1.5 billion as it builds out an AI-powered operating system for commercial auto insurance.

headline: LIMRA and LOMA anchor September's Life Insurance Awareness Month with a coverage-gap push
summary: LIMRA and LOMA are running a public-education campaign this Life Insurance Awareness Month aimed at highlighting how underinsured many American households remain and encouraging more people to evaluate life coverage needs.

headline: U.S. P&C insurers post sharply higher first-half 2026 underwriting gains as combined ratio improves
summary: The U.S. property/casualty industry's net underwriting gain nearly tripled to $31.7 billion in the first half of 2026 versus a year earlier, with the combined ratio improving to 92.7% even as premium growth slowed and casualty lines stayed under pressure.

headline: Verisk raises average annual insured catastrophe loss estimate to $171 billion
summary: Verisk's latest catastrophe modeling puts expected global insured catastrophe losses at $171 billion annually, up $19 billion from a year ago, underscoring the growing capital cushion insurers need to absorb severe weather and other disaster risk.

headline: AIG names Nancy Bewlay global chief underwriting officer
summary: AIG named Nancy Bewlay as executive vice president and global chief underwriting officer, effective September 8, as the insurer continues refreshing its underwriting leadership team.

headline: Insurers' bond portfolio yields hit highest level since 2012 as allocation mix keeps shifting
summary: Insurance industry bond yields have climbed to roughly 4.7%, the richest level in over a decade, even as insurers' overall bond weighting fell for a third straight year and private-placement holdings reached a record share of fixed income portfolios.

headline: Wealth Enhancement expands into Richmond with $376 million hybrid RIA acquisition from Raymond James
summary: Wealth Enhancement Group added a Richmond, Virginia-area hybrid RIA managing roughly $376 million in assets, continuing its acquisition-led expansion strategy in the mid-Atlantic.

headline: Advisors see AI moving from back-office support to front-office decision-making in 2026
summary: Industry commentary argues 2026 is a tipping point for wealthtech AI, with tools shifting advisors away from manual information-gathering toward embedded, real-time insight and decision support across client workflows.

headline: MGU roll-up thesis eclipses classic MGA roll-up strategy at the top of the market
summary: Specialty distribution analysts say the largest MGA platforms are increasingly pursuing an MGU roll-up model paired with hybrid reinsurance paper, rather than the pure agency roll-up strategy that dominated the sector's growth in prior years.

headline: TPA and claims-services consolidation accelerates as private equity keeps buying in
summary: Advisory firm MarshBerry says consolidation among third-party administrators and claims-services firms is accelerating, reshaping competitive dynamics as private-equity owners like Aquiline Capital Partners pursue growth-through-acquisition strategies in workers' comp and liability claims administration.

headline: CMS's 2026 Medicare Advantage rule tightens prior-authorization protections for hospital admissions
summary: Under CMS's 2026 final rule, Medicare Advantage and Part D plans are now barred from reopening previously approved inpatient hospital admissions except in cases of clear error or fraud, and must decide expedited appeals within 72 hours.

headline: ACA enrollment among young adults drops 8% as subsidy expiration pushes premiums sharply higher
summary: KFF analysis finds ACA marketplace sign-ups among 18-34 year-olds fell by about 542,000 people (8%) in 2026 after enhanced subsidies expired, with some enrollees facing premium increases of up to 114% once rate hikes are included.

headline: Zurich extends agentic AI underwriting platform toward more than 20 markets worldwide
summary: Zurich Insurance is scaling an AI risk-digitization platform built with insurtech Cytora to more than 20 countries over 16 months, after an initial five-country rollout cut manual submission triage time by roughly 80%, from 75 minutes to 15 minutes per case.

headline: French health insurtech Alan closes 480 million euro Series G at a 5.5 billion euro valuation
summary: Alan, the French digital health insurer and prevention platform, raised a 480 million euro Series G round led by Prosus, with participation from Index Ventures and Teachers' Venture Growth, just months after a prior 100 million euro round, as its annualized revenue passed 800 million euros.

headline: AIG hires AXA veteran Nancy Bewlay as global chief underwriting officer
summary: AIG named Nancy Bewlay, most recently AXA's group chief underwriting and pricing officer, as its new executive vice president and global chief underwriting officer effective September 8, bringing more than 30 years of underwriting leadership experience from AXA, Swiss Re and C.V. Starr.

headline: Canopius taps BCG's Nadine Moore to lead its US specialty insurance business
summary: Lloyd's specialty insurer Canopius Group named Nadine Moore, formerly a managing director and senior partner at Boston Consulting Group, as CEO of its US business effective this September, succeeding Lisa Davis as the carrier scales its US retail and wholesale operations.

headline: BlackRock's assets under management climb to $15.3 trillion in the second quarter
summary: BlackRock reported AUM of $15.3 trillion for Q2 2026, with net inflows of $192 billion in the quarter and $321 billion for the first half, driven by ETFs, private markets and systematic equity strategies.

headline: Selective Insurance's investment income jumps as reinvestment yields keep climbing
summary: Selective Insurance Group reported after-tax net investment income of $119 million for the second quarter, up 18% year-over-year, with its fixed-income portfolio yielding 4.4% as insurers keep benefiting from reinvesting maturing bonds at higher rates.

headline: LIMRA reports steady Q2 growth in life insurance sales, led by whole life and variable universal life
summary: LIMRA's Q2 2026 individual life insurance survey found total new premium rose 3% year-over-year to $4.75 billion, with whole life climbing 9% to become the largest driver of growth and variable universal life posting the fastest growth rate at 13%, aided by a rebound in equity markets.

headline: Health Care Administrators Association names its 2026-2027 board of directors
summary: The HCAA, a trade group for self-funded health plan third-party administrators, appointed its board and officers for the 2026-2027 term, naming Professional Benefit Administrators' Jeff Walter as president to lead advocacy and education efforts for the self-funding industry.

headline: Hightower taps data infrastructure startup Dispatch to unify records across its advisory network
summary: Hightower Advisors selected fintech Dispatch to synchronize client data across custodians for its Hightower Signature Wealth channel, which has scaled to roughly $35 billion in assets across 30 locations as the firm consolidates breakaway advisor teams.

headline: Vanguard deepens its push into financial advice with deal to acquire digital RIA platform Altruist
summary: Vanguard, under CEO Salim Ramji, is moving further into financial advice through an agreement to acquire Altruist, seen as an attempt to reshape the RIA custody and advice landscape, though analysts say winning over independent advisors may prove challenging.

headline: Aon agrees to buy broker USI from KKR in roughly $17 billion deal
summary: Aon announced it will acquire USI Insurance Services, the tenth-largest US insurance broker with about $3 billion in annual revenue, from private equity owner KKR for approximately $17 billion in cash, extending Aon's push into the US middle market following its 2024 purchase of NFP.

headline: London NHS trust performs world-first AI-assisted brain surgery
summary: University College London Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust says it carried out the world's first brain operation guided by real-time AI analysis of the surgical video feed, helping the surgical team identify critical structures while removing a pituitary tumor from a 48-year-old patient.

headline: Federal guidance tightens expectations for retirement plan recordkeeping accuracy
summary: A roundup of federal retirement rules highlights sharpened recordkeeping and reporting expectations for plan sponsors and administrators, part of continued fallout from SECURE 2.0 implementation as agencies push for more reliable participant data.

headline: Wealth Enhancement adds Virginia RIA in its third second-half deal of the year
summary: Minneapolis-based consolidator Wealth Enhancement acquired the investment advisory business of Dickerson Jackson & Associates, a hybrid RIA in Glen Allen, Virginia managing about $376 million in client assets, continuing its acquisitive pace into the second half of 2026.

headline: Medicare Advantage industry gathers in San Diego for RISE West as plans prep for 2027
summary: More than 500 health plan executives, providers and policy experts convened at RISE West 2026 in San Diego from September 2-4 to focus on Medicare Advantage risk adjustment, quality performance, AI implementation and operational strategy ahead of 2027 bids.

headline: Vertafore launches Velocity AI Platform with agents built for agency and MGA workflows
summary: Vertafore introduced its Velocity AI Platform along with six purpose-built AI agents embedded directly into the core systems agencies, MGAs and carriers already use, part of a broader push to bring generative AI into everyday broker workflows.

headline: UPMC to acquire CommonSpirit's Trinity Health System in Ohio Valley expansion
summary: UPMC reached an agreement to acquire CommonSpirit Health's Trinity Health System in Ohio, with the deal expected to close this fall as part of a broader rebound in hospital M&A activity that saw roughly 40 hospital deals in the first half of 2026.

headline: Average 401(k) balance hits record high even as more workers tap retirement savings early
summary: Fidelity's latest account data shows the average 401(k) balance rose 13.1% year-over-year to a record $155,800, but the firm also flagged a rising share of savers taking hardship withdrawals or loans amid ongoing financial pressure.

headline: US managing general agent premium volume swells to roughly $128 billion
summary: A new Conning study estimates total premium flowing through US MGAs reached about $128 billion in 2025, crediting the growth to a structural shift toward specialization, AI-driven underwriting and modular distribution rather than simply favorable market conditions.

headline: Ahmedabad's InRisk Labs raises $27 million to build out parametric climate insurance technology
summary: InRisk Labs closed a $27 million Series A co-led by Bessemer Venture Partners and Northpoint Capital to expand its parametric insurance and reinsurance technology, which pays out automatically based on measurable triggers like rainfall or catastrophe indices, and to scale its licensed reinsurance subsidiary EarthRe.

headline: UnitedHealth, Centene and Elevance post steadier cost trends in Q2 earnings
summary: UnitedHealth Group reported a Q2 2026 medical cost ratio of 86.7% on $112 billion in revenue, while Centene's revenue rose nearly 10% to $53.6 billion and Elevance Health topped earnings estimates, together easing investor worries about medical cost trends that had weighed on payer stocks earlier in the year.

headline: AI scribes cut documentation time significantly at Intermountain Health
summary: Intermountain Health says clinicians using Microsoft's Dragon Copilot ambient AI assistant have cut time spent on visit notes by 27% based on Epic usage data, with more than 2,500 clinicians actively using the tool as part of a broader push to reduce documentation burden and burnout.

headline: Swiss Re projects global insurance premium growth will slow sharply to 1.3% in 2026
summary: Swiss Re Institute's latest World Insurance sigma report projects global real premium growth slowing to about 1.3% in 2026 from 3.9% in 2025, with non-life growth nearly flat as pricing competition intensifies and life premiums outperforming the long-term trend.

headline: Insurtech funding accelerates in 2026 as AI-focused deals dominate
summary: Insurtech funding accelerated sharply in 2026, with digital insurance brokers capturing roughly three-quarters of year-to-date funding; CB Insights data shows Q1 2026 alone saw about $1.63 billion raised, with 95% of that flowing to AI-focused companies.

headline: Mapfre to acquire Safety Insurance Group in a $1.54 billion all-cash deal
summary: Massachusetts-based Safety Insurance agreed to be acquired by an affiliate of Spain's Mapfre for about $1.54 billion, or $105 per share in cash, after Safety reported second-quarter net income of $34.5 million.

headline: US individual life insurance sales grow 3% in Q2 2026 as variable universal life leads
summary: Individual life insurance new annualized premium rose 3% year-over-year in the second quarter of 2026, with variable universal life posting the sharpest growth (up 11% to $800 million) and simplified-issue and final-expense products seeing double-digit policy-count growth among lower- and middle-income buyers.

headline: Catastrophe bond market on pace for a second straight year above $20 billion in issuance
summary: Cat bond spreads tightened through the summer as issuance accelerated; Aon Securities projects full-year 2026 volume will again top $20 billion, with insurers like Mangrove Property Insurance securing record reinsurance and cat-bond coverage ahead of the Atlantic hurricane season.

headline: Swiss Re Institute: $750 billion AI investment boom is reshaping the insurance risk landscape
summary: Swiss Re Institute says a roughly $750 billion boom in AI-related capital investment, layered on top of geopolitical fragmentation, is reshaping the risks insurers must underwrite and the opportunities available to their investment portfolios.

headline: China tightens algorithm-governance expectations for AI-driven insurance pricing and claims
summary: Chinese regulators are pushing insurers toward "algorithm governance," requiring that AI-driven pricing and underwriting models be transparent, explainable, and free of discriminatory bias, while barring insurers from offloading core management responsibility to third-party tech vendors.

headline: India's wealth management market on track to grow past $436 billion by 2034

summary: MSIG Asia named Ronak Shah, previously CEO of QBE's Wholesale Markets Asia, as regional chief executive effective October 1, giving him oversight of operations spanning Southeast Asia, Hong Kong, India and Oceania.

headline: Payers post broad Q2 2026 profit gains as medical cost trends ease
summary: UnitedHealth, Cigna, Elevance, Centene and Molina all reported year-over-year profit growth in the second quarter of 2026, with several insurers raising full-year earnings guidance as cost-trend fears eased and stocks rallied off yearly lows.

headline: HSBC's global insurance chief to depart after two decades at the bank
summary: Edward Moncreiffe is leaving HSBC's global insurance business for external opportunities after 20 years, with the bank reportedly planning to split his responsibilities between two regional executives.

headline: Private capital in 401(k) plans could top $1 trillion by 2030, Deloitte projects
summary: Deloitte forecasts regulatory changes could push private-market allocations in U.S. defined contribution plans to roughly 6% of assets by 2030, up from under 1% today, as target-date funds begin adding private equity exposure.

headline: ACA marketplace premiums set to jump as enhanced subsidies expire
summary: With Congress declining to extend enhanced ACA premium tax credits, some marketplace enrollees could see costs rise as much as 114% when combined with insurers' 2026 rate increases, which carriers say already priced in the subsidy expiration.

headline: UK's FCA proposes to strip back prescriptive insurance disclosure rules
summary: The Financial Conduct Authority's Consultation Paper CP26/22, open for comment through September 4, proposes removing ICOBS disclosure requirements it considers duplicative or likely to overload consumers with information, part of a broader insurance-rules simplification push.

headline: Labor Department advances rule opening 401(k) plans to private capital
summary: The Department of Labor is moving forward with a proposed rule clarifying how retirement plan fiduciaries should evaluate private-market investments, following a 2025 executive order directing the agency to widen access to alternative assets in workplace retirement accounts.

headline: Wealth Enhancement adds $345 million Anchorage RIA in latest tuck-in
summary: Minneapolis-based consolidator Wealth Enhancement acquired the advisory business of a four-advisor Anchorage and Fairbanks RIA overseeing $345 million in client assets, part of a near-weekly acquisition pace in 2026.

headline: European wealth managers turn cautious on the region's stock rally
summary: A Bloomberg survey found only 7 of 22 European private banks and wealth managers are now overweight regional equities, down from 10 at the start of the year, as sentiment shifts toward the U.S. and emerging markets.

headline: AIG names Nancy Bewlay global chief underwriting officer
summary: AIG appointed Nancy Bewlay, formerly AXA Group's chief underwriting and pricing officer, as executive vice president and global chief underwriting officer effective September 8, tasking her with strengthening underwriting discipline across the carrier.

headline: Insureon and LIO partner to bring AI underwriting to specialty small-business insurance
summary: Digital insurance agency Insureon partnered with LIO to embed AI-powered underwriting for specialty risks into its small-business insurance marketplace, aiming to speed quotes for harder-to-place coverage.

headline: India's insurers move to new accounting standard Ind AS 117 for insurance contracts
summary: IRDAI facilitated implementation of Indian Accounting Standards as of September 9, 2026, requiring insurers to report under Ind AS 117 for insurance contracts and Ind AS 109 for financial instruments starting in the new fiscal year.

headline: &Partners standardizes estate planning workflow on Wealth.com's AI platform
summary: Advisory firm &Partners named Wealth.com its enterprise-wide estate and tax planning solution, giving more than 100 advisors an AI-driven, standardized way to review client estate documents and spot planning gaps.

headline: AI risk factors seen entering 60-80% of liability and cyber underwriting by 2028
summary: Research firm ScienceSoft predicts AI-related exposures will factor into 60% to 80% of new policies and renewals in E&O, D&O, employment-practices and cyber lines by 2028, though most midsize insurers will keep covering AI risk within existing lines rather than standalone policies.

headline: Savvy Wealth raises $100 million as valuation hits $600 million
summary: Advisor platform Savvy Wealth closed a $100 million funding round that values the company at $600 million, after recruiting more than $4 billion in assets and doubling its advisor headcount to 150 over the past year.

headline: LIMRA projects record annuity sales up to $485 billion in 2026 amid growth of in-plan products
summary: LIMRA's latest forecast points to total annuity sales between $438 billion and $485 billion for 2026, with growth increasingly driven by annuities embedded in employer-sponsored retirement plans.

headline: Private fixed income becomes insurers' second-largest asset class after 141% surge
summary: Insurance asset managers report private fixed-income holdings have grown 141% since 2021, now trailing only public fixed income, as carriers seek income outside historically tight credit spreads.

headline: Catastrophe bond issuance hits record $17.3 billion in first half of 2026
summary: Property-catastrophe bond issuance set a first-half record on abundant investor capital and declining reinsurance prices, with Florida's push to move policies out of its state insurer of last resort a major driver of supply.

headline: NAIC's first nationwide homeowners study finds premiums up as much as 43% in the West since 2018
summary: A first-of-its-kind NAIC analysis of seven years of market conduct data found average homeowners premiums rose 18% in the Northeast, 25% in the Midwest, 27% in the Southeast and 43% in the West even after adjusting for inflation.

headline: IRDAI approves two general insurers to raise foreign ownership beyond 74% under new FDI norms
summary: India's insurance regulator approved two general insurance companies to increase foreign shareholding beyond the previous 74% ceiling, among the first movers since the government opened the door to 100% foreign investment in insurers.

headline: Marpai recognized among 2025's top health-plan third-party administrators
summary: Marpai was named a top health-plan third-party administrator for 2025 by Insurance Business Review Magazine, recognition the company is highlighting as it competes for self-funded employer business.

headline: Munich Re to acquire cyber insurtech At-Bay for $575 million in its largest primary cyber move
summary: Munich Re agreed to acquire At-Bay, a top-10 US cyber insurer, for $575 million, roughly a 2x multiple on At-Bay's gross written premiums, folding it into its Hartford Steam Boiler specialty unit.

headline: Target-date funds edge toward embedding guaranteed lifetime income as adoption nears universal
summary: With target-date funds now used by the vast majority of defined contribution plans, providers are increasingly building retirement-income and annuity features directly into the glide path rather than offering them as separate options.

headline: Sanford Health finalizes merger with North Memorial Health, entering the Twin Cities
summary: Sanford Health completed its merger with North Memorial Health under a 10-year Minnesota oversight agreement requiring $600 million in facility investment, forming a combined nonprofit system serving about 2.5 million patients.

headline: Marsh McLennan Agency acquires 90-year-old Midwest broker The Accel Group
summary: Marsh McLennan Agency acquired The Accel Group, a broker founded in 1936 with seven offices across Iowa, Illinois, Missouri and Kansas and more than 130 employees, extending MMA's Midwest footprint.

headline: White House pledges $500 ACA rebate checks to about 1 million exchange enrollees in 30 states
summary: The administration said it will send $500 rebate checks to roughly a million people enrolled in federal ACA exchanges who don't receive premium subsidies, funded by exchange user-fee surplus, though funding and legal details remain unresolved.

headline: Fintech sector raises $4.5 billion across 18 deals in a single week
summary: Fintech and adjacent technology firms raised more than $4.5 billion across 18 deals in one week, led by a mega-round in AI infrastructure alongside a run of nine-figure raises spanning cybersecurity, wealthtech and digital assets.

headline: Allianz to buy HSBC's Singapore life insurer for S$2.7 billion, inks 15-year bancassurance tie-up
summary: Allianz agreed to acquire HSBC Life Singapore and enter a 15-year exclusive bancassurance distribution partnership with HSBC, a major push to expand its presence in Southeast Asian insurance and wealth markets.

headline: Allianz Global Investors to acquire UOB Asset Management's Southeast Asia business for $433 million
summary: Allianz Global Investors agreed to buy UOB Asset Management, which runs about €28 billion across eight Asian markets, deepening Allianz's asset-management footprint in the region alongside its HSBC Life Singapore deal.

headline: Estate-planning AI startup Luminary raises $22 million Series A backed by BNY and Focus Financial
summary: Luminary, whose AI platform turns estate documents into structured data across more than $500 billion in client assets, raised a $22 million Series A led by Ten Coves Capital with BNY and Focus Financial Partners participating.

headline: India's mutual fund SIP inflows rise 12% year-on-year in July as retail participation grows
summary: Systematic investment plan inflows into Indian mutual funds reached roughly ₹31,961 crore in July, up 12% year-on-year, while the number of active SIP accounts climbed past 10.6 crore.

headline: AI-related claims begin surfacing in cyber, D&O and professional liability policies
summary: Deepfake-enabled fraud, AI-generated phishing and algorithmic hiring or governance failures are starting to generate claims under existing cyber, D&O, EPL and professional liability policies, insurers report.

headline: Global insurance TPA market seen growing to $404 billion in 2026 on AI-driven claims automation
summary: The global insurance third-party administrator market is projected to expand from about $372 billion in 2025 to roughly $404 billion in 2026, with AI-driven claims automation and rising outsourcing cited as key growth drivers.

headline: Embedded-insurance platform Cover Genius raises $100 million at $1.9 billion valuation
summary: Cover Genius raised $100 million from Vista Credit Partners at a $1.9 billion valuation, capital it plans to use to deepen enterprise integrations, scale AI underwriting and pursue strategic acquisitions.

headline: More health systems drop Medicare Advantage plans in 2026 amid prior-authorization friction
summary: A growing number of U.S. health systems are ending contracts with Medicare Advantage insurers, citing prior-authorization denials and slow reimbursement, even as MA now covers more than half of eligible Medicare beneficiaries.

headline: New federal law extends fee-disclosure rules to TPAs and PBMs starting 2028
summary: The Consolidated Appropriations Act of 2026 amends ERISA's service-provider compensation disclosure requirements to apply directly to third-party administrators and pharmacy benefit managers beginning in 2028, part of a broader shift redistributing PBM profits toward plan sponsors.

headline: TPA industry consolidates further as private-equity-backed roll-ups chase scale
summary: Industry coverage of the shifting TPA landscape points to continued private-equity-driven acquisitions as administrators pursue the scale needed to serve multiple lines of business profitably amid margin pressure.

headline: Vanguard agrees to acquire RIA custody platform Altruist in deal valued near $4 billion
summary: Vanguard and Altruist announced a definitive agreement for Vanguard to acquire the venture-backed custody and technology platform, which serves more than 6,000 advisors; Altruist will keep operating under its own brand as the deal is expected to close later this year.

headline: India's GST exemption and 100% FDI reform continue reshaping life and health insurance growth outlook
summary: Analysts say India's move to exempt individual life and health premiums from GST and to allow full foreign ownership of insurers is fueling a bullish 2026 growth outlook, even as regulators push further digital and policy reforms toward universal coverage.

headline: UK regulators propose lighter-touch regime for captive insurers
summary: The Bank of England's PRA and the FCA opened a joint consultation on a bespoke UK captive insurer framework sitting outside Solvency UK, promising lower capital and reporting burdens and a four-to-six-week authorization target ahead of a planned mid-2027 launch.

headline: UK's MGAA appoints Padda Consulting as compliance and regulatory partner
summary: The Managing General Agents' Association named Padda Consulting its new UK compliance and regulatory partner effective September 1, 2026, aiming to help MGA members keep pace with evolving regulatory requirements.

headline: EU insurers face narrowing window to prove AI governance to supervisors
summary: European regulators are converging on binding AI governance standards for insurers, with a monthly regulatory tracker warning that carriers without documented AI oversight frameworks face a shrinking compliance runway.

headline: Bipartisan 'Doctors Not AI Act' would bar algorithms from final medical-necessity denials
summary: Rep. Greg Landsman's bill, introduced September 1, would require a licensed clinician to make the final call on medical-necessity claim denials at group health plans and insurers, permitting AI only in a supporting role with disclosure requirements.

headline: Exclusive Underwriting Managers launches plug-and-play MGA platform
summary: The insurance MGA platform provider launched an advanced plug-and-play system designed to accelerate partner growth and give underwriting teams a faster path to equity participation in the programs they build.

headline: UnitedHealthcare tightens lab-test reimbursement across commercial and government plans
summary: UnitedHealthcare began applying stricter reimbursement rules for lab tests across its commercial, Medicare Advantage, exchange and Medicaid plans starting September 1, part of a broader wave of payer reimbursement changes this month.

headline: Target-date fund assets reach $4.8 trillion as personalization and lifetime-income features gain ground
summary: Morningstar's 2026 target-date fund landscape report found TDF assets grew more than 20% to $4.8 trillion, with falling fees, growing use of collective investment trusts, and rising interest in personalized and annuity-linked designs reshaping the category.

headline: AI-native brokerage platform AGI raises $70 million to scale agency model
summary: AGI secured $70 million to expand an AI-first insurance brokerage operating model it says lifted average agency profitability by more than 50% during a year of testing across ten agencies before its public launch.

headline: Cloud security startup Upwind reaches unicorn status with $250 million Series B
summary: Upwind raised a $250 million Series B led by Bessemer Venture Partners at a $1.5 billion valuation, bringing total funding to $430 million as it scales runtime-first cloud security tools relevant to financial-services risk teams.

headline: Cytora launches Autopilot, an end-to-end automated commercial underwriting platform
summary: Cytora launched Autopilot, described as the first end-to-end AI-automated underwriting platform for commercial insurance, aiming to run entire underwriting workflows with minimal manual intervention.

headline: Sutter Health and Allina Health agree to form $26 billion nonprofit system
summary: Sutter Health and Allina Health signed a definitive agreement to combine into a $26 billion nonprofit system spanning California, Minnesota and western Wisconsin, with Sutter committing $2 billion toward Allina's region.

headline: TWFG continues agency and MGA acquisition streak with latest deal disclosure
summary: TWFG Insurance Services disclosed further agency and MGA acquisitions in an SEC filing, continuing its multi-year roll-up strategy of independent insurance distribution businesses.

headline: PwC's midyear outlook sees insurance distribution M&A staying resilient despite AI uncertainty
summary: PwC's 2026 midyear insurance deals outlook finds that despite growing deal scrutiny tied to how AI may disrupt distribution, the underlying strategic and financial drivers behind broker and MGA M&A remain firmly intact.

headline: F&G Annuities & Life posts mixed second-quarter 2026 results
summary: F&G reported a Q2 2026 GAAP net loss of $81 million but adjusted net earnings of $85 million, as the annuity and life insurer navigated realized investment losses against steady underlying growth.

headline: MSIG Asia names Ronak Shah as regional chief executive
summary: MSIG Asia appointed Ronak Shah as its new Regional CEO effective October 1, 2026, a leadership transition for the Asia-Pacific general insurer.

headline: Vanguard to acquire wealthtech platform Altruist for $4.6 billion
summary: Vanguard agreed to acquire Altruist, an AI-forward RIA custody and wealth-technology platform serving more than 6,000 advisors, in a deal expected to close later in 2026 and push Vanguard directly into custody competition with Schwab and Fidelity.

headline: Bermuda's life and annuity sidecar market nearly quadruples in four years
summary: A new Morningstar DBRS report cited in the Longevity & Mortality Investor shows Bermuda's L&A reinsurance sidecar market has grown almost fourfold over the past four years as carriers seek off-balance-sheet capital solutions.

headline: Goldman Sachs flags four trends reshaping defined contribution plans in 2026
summary: Goldman Sachs Asset Management's 2026 outlook highlights personalized glidepaths, growing lifetime-income features, blended active-passive strategies, and expanding private-market access as the forces redefining DC plan design.

headline: Target-date fund assets approach $5 trillion as adoption nears universal
summary: A 401(k) Specialist deep dive finds target-date fund assets nearing $5 trillion, cementing TDFs as the primary retirement-savings engine even as sponsors weigh new personalization and private-markets features.

headline: Gallagher Re report shows reinsurance capital growth outpacing earlier estimates
summary: Gallagher Re's September half-year 2026 reinsurance market report finds traditional reinsurance capital on pace to grow 6% for the year, above earlier forecasts, on the back of a strong first-half performance.

headline: Device-intelligence fraud platform Fingerprint surpasses $50 million in ARR
summary: Fingerprint said it passed $50 million in annual recurring revenue on September 1, identifying more than a billion unique devices monthly for over 6,000 organizations combating AI-driven fraud.

headline: FinovateFall 2026 draws top US banks as embedded finance dominates agenda
summary: FinovateFall 2026 in New York confirmed attendance from major US banks including JPMorgan Chase and Bank of America, reflecting continued convergence between traditional banks and fintech platforms.

headline: MediaAlpha CFO Pat Thompson to step down, SVP of Finance to succeed him
summary: Insurance marketing platform MediaAlpha announced CFO Pat Thompson will step down effective October 1, 2026, with SVP of Finance Tigran Sinanyan succeeding him as chief financial officer.

headline: September ITL Focus spotlights the technology reshaping agents and brokers
summary: Insurance Thought Leadership's September 2026 agents-and-brokers focus examines how distribution technology, data and AI tools are reshaping the intermediary role across the value chain.

headline: Revolut clears first US hurdle with conditional national bank charter approval
summary: The OCC granted Revolut conditional preliminary approval to form a US national bank, though the fintech still needs FDIC deposit insurance and Federal Reserve sign-off before it can open, with a launch targeted for early 2027.

headline: APAC reinsurance renewal talks shift focus from price to capital and volatility
summary: Reinsurance renewal discussions across Asia-Pacific are pivoting away from pure rate negotiations toward capital management and volatility concerns as the region's protection gap narrows amid resilient growth.

headline: Nearly two-thirds of independent agents now use AI on the job, industry data shows
summary: New industry commentary finds almost two in three independent insurance agents used AI tools at least occasionally over the past year, with reconciliation and workflow automation among the biggest productivity gains.

headline: Higher-for-longer rates keep boosting insurer investment income, analysts say
summary: A markets analysis argues that persistently higher interest rates continue to lift net investment income at several publicly traded insurers, supporting dividend-paying carrier stocks.

headline: Catastrophe bond and reinsurance capital markets stay active into mid-September
summary: The weekly Artemis roundup for the week ending September 13 tracks continued strong catastrophe bond issuance and reinsurance-linked capital markets activity following a record first half of 2026.

headline: Health insurer earnings rebound gains momentum as medical costs stabilize
summary: Analysts point to improving medical-cost trends, with the industry's Q2 2026 medical care ratio falling to 86.7% from 89.4% a year earlier, as evidence that the health-insurer earnings rebound is taking hold ahead of Q3 results.

headline: Groupama posts EUR560 million net income as asset management arm grows AUM to EUR111.3 billion
summary: Groupama's first-half 2026 results show EUR560 million in net income, with Groupama Asset Management's assets under management climbing EUR3.7 billion to EUR111.3 billion as of June 30.

headline: Corgi raises $108 million to scale its AI-native insurance carrier for startups
summary: Corgi Insurance raised $108 million across a new Series A and earlier seed funding after winning regulatory approval to operate as a full-stack, AI-powered carrier, with annual recurring revenue already topping $40 million.

headline: IRIC forecasts faster retirement income and financial wellness adoption in 2026
summary: The Institutional Retirement Income Council's 2026 outlook projects accelerating plan-sponsor adoption of in-plan retirement income and financial wellness features as participants near decumulation.

headline: U.S. property and casualty pricing keeps softening as capital stays abundant
summary: Analysis shows the U.S. P&C market continuing to soften through 2026, with commercial premiums down 1.2% in the first quarter as intensifying competition and ample capital pressure pricing.

headline: Managing general agency deals continue to stir broader insurance M&A activity
summary: Coverage of the managing general agency segment finds MGA transactions remain one of the most active corners of insurance M&A, as platforms pursue both bolt-on and platform-scale acquisitions.

headline: Insurer sues third-party claims administrator over unpaid debt and open claims
summary: Safety National Casualty Corporation filed suit alleging its TPA walked away from its contracts and made large payouts to its principals while roughly 900 claims sat open and a multimillion-dollar debt went unpaid.

headline: BrokerTech Connect Chicago brings insurance and insurtech leaders together
summary: BrokerTech Ventures' BrokerTech Connect Chicago conference, held August 31-September 2, gathered carriers, brokers, startups and investors for sessions on AI, change management and next-generation digital-first distribution.

headline: ACA marketplace premiums rise an estimated 26% on average in 2026
summary: KFF analysis finds ACA marketplace insurers raised premiums by an estimated 26% on average for 2026, with many enrollees facing even sharper net increases as enhanced subsidies phase down.

headline: Congress enacts sweeping pharmacy benefit manager reform in 2026 appropriations law
summary: The Consolidated Appropriations Act of 2026 imposes new PBM reporting, transparency and compensation restrictions on commercial group health plans, phasing in through 2029.

headline: Old Republic spins up Lodestar Claims & Risk Services as standalone TPA brand
summary: Old Republic International launched Lodestar Claims & Risk Services as an independent operating company and brand within the group, its first such standalone TPA launch in more than 30 years.

headline: Malibu Life USA completes acquisition of TruSpire, launching its U.S. retail annuity business
summary: Malibu Life Holdings closed its purchase of TruSpire Retirement Insurance Company, rebranding it as Malibu Life USA and establishing the unit as the company's origination engine for U.S. retail fixed indexed annuities.

headline: DOL grants temporary relief as plan sponsors scramble to comply with new paper statement rule
summary: The Department of Labor issued Field Assistance Bulletin 2026-02 giving retirement plan administrators temporary enforcement relief while they build compliance processes for the revived requirement to mail at least one paper benefit statement per year.

headline: KKR joins Amwins-led consortium in A$7.7 billion approach for Australian broker Steadfast
summary: Global investment firm KKR joined Amwins Group and Dragoneer Investment in a consortium proposal to acquire Australian insurance broker network Steadfast for roughly A$7.7 billion (US$5.33 billion).

headline: Producerflow launches distribution management platform for carriers, MGAs and agencies
summary: New insurtech entrant Producerflow debuted a platform designed to help carriers, MGAs and agencies manage the full producer lifecycle, from onboarding through licensing and compliance tracking.

headline: Schwab courts Altruist advisors as rival custodian digests Vanguard's $4.6 billion acquisition
summary: Charles Schwab is actively pitching advisors on Altruist's custodial platform following Vanguard's $4.6 billion acquisition of Altruist, as custodians jockey for share among independent RIAs.

headline: Acrisure unveils Palantir-powered AI platform for insurance brokerage operations
summary: Broker and fintech group Acrisure introduced a new AI operations platform built on Palantir's technology, aimed at streamlining underwriting workflows and data integration across its brokerage business.

headline: Savvy Wealth closes $100 million Series C, pushing valuation to $600 million
summary: The AI-native RIA platform for independent financial advisors raised a $100 million Series C round, more than doubling its valuation as investors bet on tech-forward advisor recruitment models.

headline: India exempts individual life and health insurance premiums from GST, effective September 22
summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman's GST overhaul removes the tax on individual life and health insurance premiums starting September 22, a move expected to lower policy costs and support demand for private insurers.

headline: White House to issue $500 refunds to nearly a million ACA exchange enrollees
summary: The administration announced $500 rebates for close to a million people enrolled in the federal ACA exchanges, tied to user-fee overcharges collected during the prior administration to fund exchange operations.

headline: Abu Dhabi's Synapse Analytics raises $13 million Series A for agentic AI decisioning infrastructure
summary: Synapse Analytics, which builds agentic decisioning infrastructure for regulated financial institutions including insurers, raised a $13 million Series A round as the UK's InsurTech Corridor plans a fresh push into the US insurance market.

headline: India's life insurers post 20.7% new business premium growth in July on LIC group strength
summary: Life insurance new business premium rose 20.7% year-over-year in July, driven by strong growth in LIC's group business alongside steady expansion from private insurers, signaling resilient demand ahead of the GST premium exemption.

headline: PRA and FCA consult on new bespoke regime for UK captive insurers
summary: UK regulators opened a joint consultation on a proposed prudential and conduct framework designed to make the UK a more competitive domicile for captive insurers, with the comment period closing October 14 and implementation targeted for mid-2027.

headline: IRDAI weighs replacing upfront distributor commissions with staggered payouts
summary: India's insurance regulator is considering a major overhaul of how insurance distributors are compensated, proposing to replace large upfront commissions with payments staggered across the life of a policy to curb mis-selling.

headline: UnitedHealth raises 2026 earnings guidance again as medical cost ratio improves to 86.7%
summary: UnitedHealth lifted its 2026 adjusted earnings outlook to $19.50-$20.00 per share, up from over $18.25 previously, after a 270-basis-point improvement in its Q2 medical cost ratio drove better-than-expected results.

headline: Weekly advisor-tech roundup tracks new AI planning and portfolio tools
summary: A weekly wealthtech briefing covers new AI-enabled financial-planning and portfolio-construction tools advisors are piloting this fall, alongside continued custodian and RIA consolidation activity.

headline: Standard Life agrees to buy Aegon UK for £2bn, creating UK's largest retirement business
summary: Standard Life will acquire Aegon UK in a deal combining roughly £480bn in assets and serving 16 million customers, with Aegon taking a 15.3% stake in the enlarged group as a strategic shareholder; the deal is expected to close around year-end 2026.

headline: BrokerTech Ventures holds second annual BrokerTech Connect conference in Chicago
summary: BrokerTech Ventures brought together brokerage, carrier, wholesaler and startup leaders for its BrokerTech Connect event September 1-2 in Chicago, spotlighting its 2026 accelerator cohort and broker-led innovation model.

headline: Ahmedabad insurtech InRisk Labs raises $27 million Series A
summary: The India-based commercial-insurance underwriting startup raised a Series A co-led by Bessemer Venture Partners and Northpoint Capital to expand its risk-assessment platform.

headline: Study finds consistency checks help clinicians trust AI diagnostic suggestions
summary: New research finds that flagging when an AI model gives stable, repeatable answers across similar cases helps clinicians calibrate how much to trust its diagnostic suggestions, addressing a key barrier to clinical AI adoption.

headline: Zurich's £8.1bn Beazley takeover clears final regulatory hurdle, set to close October 1
summary: Zurich Insurance's all-cash acquisition of Lloyd's specialty insurer Beazley has secured all required regulatory approvals, with a court hearing set for September 22 and completion targeted for October 1, 2026.

headline: AIG's Peter Zaffino to step down as board chair, join Palantir as financial-services head
summary: AIG executive chair Peter Zaffino will depart to lead Palantir's financial-services growth business, including insurers, banks, asset managers and private equity firms; lead independent director John Rice succeeds him as board chair.

headline: AXA XL taps Augustin Gas to lead Asia reinsurance business from Singapore
summary: AXA XL Reinsurance appointed Augustin Gas, formerly of Arch Re and two decades at Scor including as Asia-Pacific P&C chief underwriting officer, to lead its Singapore-based Asia reinsurance team effective September 1.

headline: Lincoln Financial CFO departs amid wave of executive changes
summary: Lincoln Financial's CFO left the insurer for a role outside the industry, with an internal executive named interim CFO, continuing a string of senior leadership turnover at the carrier.

headline: Money market fund assets ease to $7.97 trillion as investors rotate positioning
summary: Total U.S. money market fund assets fell by about $6.1 billion to roughly $7.97 trillion for the week ended September 9, 2026, according to Investment Company Institute data.

headline: TPA consolidation expected to stabilize as financing conditions ease
summary: Deal activity among employee-benefits third-party administrators cooled in 2025 amid higher rates and valuation resets, but private equity sponsors and strategics remain active, with consolidation expected to gradually reaccelerate as financing normalizes.

headline: AI-agent risk auditor AIUC raises $40 million Series A
summary: AIUC raised a $40 million Series A to scale its AI audit and certification standard, AIUC-1, which stress-tests AI agents used in financial services against jailbreaks, hallucinations and data-leak risks.

headline: Kayna launches real-time coverage-gap tool for insurance brokers
summary: Insurtech firm Kayna introduced Risk Manager, a module that scans policy wording in real time to flag coverage shortfalls and prompt brokers toward compliance-driven insurance purchases.

headline: UnitedHealthcare and Humana pull back Medicare Advantage footprints for 2026
summary: The two largest Medicare Advantage insurers are exiting far more counties than they are entering for 2026, with UnitedHealthcare leaving 225 counties and Humana leaving 198, even as CMS raised per-beneficiary MA funding by 8.5%.

headline: FOIA documents show Medicare's AI prior-authorization pilot denying care at high rates
summary: Records obtained by the Electronic Frontier Foundation through a FOIA lawsuit show CMS's WISeR AI prior-authorization pilot has produced denial rates far above traditional Medicare Advantage plans, with one contractor denying more requests than it approved and facing a corrective action plan.

headline: APAC reinsurers weigh stabilizing facultative pricing as regional risk appetite grows
summary: Industry leaders gathering at the East Asia Insurance Congress in Tokyo discussed a softening APAC facultative reinsurance market approaching a floor, alongside resilient non-life demand growth and emerging opportunities in AI, cyber and infrastructure risk.

headline: AM Best finds U.S. life/annuity industry net income dipped slightly in first half of 2026
summary: AM Best's latest special report shows the U.S. life and annuity insurance industry's net income was roughly flat to slightly lower in H1 2026 versus the prior-year period, even as annuity sales held near record levels.

headline: Plan sponsors face year-end deadline to formally adopt SECURE 2.0 amendments
summary: Calendar-year 401(k) and 403(b) plans must complete formal SECURE 2.0 plan-document amendments by December 31, 2026, pushing sponsors and recordkeepers to finalize compliance changes this fall.

headline: Envestnet agrees to acquire wealthtech rival Vestmark to expand trading and tax tools
summary: Envestnet signed a deal on September 9 to acquire Vestmark, a wealth management technology provider supporting more than $2 trillion in assets, adding institutional-grade trading and tax-transition capabilities to its platform ahead of a planned Q4 close.

headline: Sapiens launches autonomous AI insurance platform for carriers
summary: Sapiens International unveiled SapiensAIP, an AI-native platform aimed at helping insurance carriers move beyond pilot projects and embed autonomous AI capabilities across underwriting and claims operations.

headline: Undeclared employee AI use emerges as a blind spot for cyber insurers
summary: Cyber insurance leaders are increasingly treating AI as an extension of existing technology risk rather than a standalone category, but unauthorized employee use of AI tools is complicating underwriting as a growing share of workplace AI activity happens outside corporate oversight.

headline: Health systems report major documentation-time savings from ambient AI scribes
summary: Health systems including Intermountain Health and Cooper University Healthcare are reporting significant reductions in clinical documentation time after deploying ambient AI dictation tools such as Microsoft's Dragon Copilot, even as governance questions around clinician oversight persist.

headline: Wealthtech platform FNZ raises $450 million as advisor AI investment accelerates
summary: UK-based wealth management platform FNZ closed a $450 million funding round as part of a broader wave of WealthTech investment, with more than $1.36 billion flowing into fintech deals in early September and AI-native advisor tools drawing outsized interest.

headline: InsurTech funding hits four-year high as AI captures nearly all new capital
summary: Global InsurTech funding jumped to its highest quarterly level in four years in Q2 2026, with AI-focused companies capturing the overwhelming majority of new investment as mega-rounds returned to the sector.

headline: Indian insurer shares rally on hopes IRDAI will cap distribution commissions
summary: Shares of Indian life and general insurers rose on September 18 as investors anticipated a regulatory consultation paper that could cap the commissions insurers pay banks for distribution, a move that would lower acquisition costs and could widen underwriting margins.

headline: Illumifin wins five-year CalPERS long-term-care TPA contract
summary: CalPERS approved a five-year third-party-administrator contract with Illumifin to run its long-term care insurance program from July 2026 through June 2031, continuing the state pension system's outsourced claims and policy administration.

headline: Insurers weigh fixed-income allocations as AI-driven bond issuance surges
summary: Apollo's fixed-income strategists examined how a boom in AI-infrastructure-linked debt issuance is reshaping credit markets and what it means for institutional and insurance-company bond portfolios seeking yield and diversification.

headline: Zurich's pending Beazley deal would make it the largest cyber insurer
summary: A specialty-lines market report noted Chubb currently leads cyber insurance premium volume, but Zurich's announced acquisition of Beazley would vault it to the top spot once the deal closes, reshaping the competitive order in cyber underwriting.

headline: US surplus lines premium hits record $143 billion as placement shifts
summary: Excess and surplus lines premium in the US climbed to a record roughly $143 billion, Insurance Business reported, as specialty and non-admitted capacity continues to take share from the standard admitted market.

headline: House GOP bill would steer MedPAC's Medicare Advantage overpayment math
