summary: With the benchmark G-sec yield reaching 7.19% in late September, Business Standard explains how retail investors can lock in higher yields through target maturity bond funds.

headline: TD Asset Management sets wind-down dates for its 2026 target maturity bond ETFs
summary: The 2026 TD Target Maturity bond funds and ETFs mature in late November, with units expected to be delisted from the TSX around November 19.

headline: AGF reports September assets under management and fee-earning assets
summary: The Canadian asset manager published its monthly AUM and fee-earning asset update on October 5.

headline: Homeward raises $450M to scale tech-enabled home financing
summary: Fintech.Global reports the company secured $450 million to expand its technology-led home financing offering.

headline: Large commercial property rates fall 14.5% in Q2, Willis reports
summary: Willis data show rates on large, complex property accounts dropped 14.5% in the second quarter versus an 8.4% decline a year earlier, driven by competitive reinsurance capacity.

headline: Casualty loss costs keep outpacing pricing as the commercial market splinters
summary: Chubb's CEO cited primary casualty loss costs rising 6-7% a year and excess casualty 9.5-12%, even as Willis says casualty rate increases are slowing.

headline: Monte Carlo signals 10-15% reinsurance rate declines at January 2027 renewals
summary: Autonomous says the message from Monte Carlo points to a full pricing reversal of the hard market at 1/1.

headline: Moody's survey: 86% of respondents expect property reinsurance prices to fall in 2027
summary: Respondents to Moody's 2026 survey broadly anticipate further softening in property reinsurance pricing over the coming year.

headline: Zurich completes Beazley acquisition, creating the world's largest specialty insurer
summary: Zurich targets over $1B of incremental annual revenue by 2029, at least $150M in annual cost savings and a $1B-plus capital extraction; Kristof Terryn is named Beazley CEO pending approval.

headline: Probitas rebrands as Aviva Syndicates in the Lloyd's market
summary: Aviva's Lloyd's platform adopted the Aviva Syndicates name on October 1, uniting its teams under one brand.

headline: US P/C insurers see fewer ratings downgrades in H1 2026 on improved performance
summary: Insurance Journal reports downgrade activity eased in the first half as underwriting performance improved.

headline: The Hartford names Mo Tooker to succeed Christopher Swift as CEO
summary: Company president A. Morris Tooker will become CEO effective March 1, 2027, according to the company's 8-K filing.

headline: IRDAI clears Patanjali's move into general insurance
summary: Insurance Business Asia reports the regulator approved the group's entry into the general insurance market.

headline: Samsung's insurance arms lead Korean drive for overseas M&A
summary: The report notes DB Insurance's completed $1.65B Fortegra acquisition as a landmark cross-border deal for Korean insurers.

headline: SIAA acquires specialty MGA Canopy Specialty Insurance
summary: The deal gives SIAA's independent agencies deeper underwriting and specialty market access; Canopy keeps its underwriting authority and carrier relationships under CEO Justin Tweedie.

headline: Clear Group buys London broker Commercial Risks and its MGA Troon Underwriting
summary: The acquisition extends Clear Group's specialist wholesale proposition.

headline: Insurance brokers oppose IRDAI's proposed distribution reforms, warn of job losses
summary: Brokers argue the draft commission and expense limits could hurt intermediaries; the broker association says up to 1 million livelihoods may be at risk over five years.

headline: Included Health launches health plan options for self-insured employers
summary: Two configurations combine primary care, navigation, network design and specialty partners as an alternative to carrier-led plans.

headline: TPA consolidation accelerates as PE-backed platforms keep buying
summary: Axia notes active acquirers including Sedgwick, Davies, Cor Partners, Ryze and AvonRisk across health, claims and retirement TPAs.

headline: Gen's Engine opens its Savvy insurance marketplace to AI agents
summary: Engine by Gen launched an insurance shopping site designed for AI agents to browse and buy coverage.

headline: Embedded payments emerge as a prime fintech M&A target
summary: PYMNTS describes banks, processors and infrastructure providers buying into embedded payments to reach new customer segments.

headline: Vertafore introduces four Velocity AI agents for insurance agencies
summary: The agents are reaching early adopters, with general availability planned during 2026.

headline: Coverwatch raises $4.5M pre-seed for AI-native commercial insurance
summary: CoFound and Restive led the round for the AI insurance broker startup.

headline: Ninth annual InsurTech100 spotlights leading insurtech innovators
summary: Fintech.Global published its 2026 list of insurtech leaders.

headline: Wefox hires former Zurich International CEO as chief insurance officer
summary: AM Best reports the insurtech brought in a senior carrier executive for its insurance leadership role.

headline: Final Transparency in Coverage rule standardizes insurer price disclosures
summary: HHS, Treasury and Labor finalized a rule requiring plans to attest their published pricing data is accurate and complete.

headline: Top multi-year guaranteed annuity rates reach 6.95% in early October
summary: Rate trackers show the best MYGA and fixed annuity rates topping 6.9% from lower-rated carriers, while A-rated carriers peak closer to 6.0%-6.45%, keeping accumulation products attractive to savers.

headline: Wealth Enhancement lands a $1.2B RIA breakaway team in its third $1B-plus deal of 2026
summary: The consolidator added another large breakaway advisory team, continuing an acquisitive year for the platform.

headline: bolt launches AI-powered Connected Distribution platform across all lines
summary: The platform brings customer data, workflows and market access into one system for partners.

headline: Hospital M&A stays hot in Q2 with 18 deals
summary: Kaufman Hall counted 18 hospital transactions in Q2 versus eight a year earlier; transacted revenue hit $7.7B.

headline: Labor Department's private-assets safe-harbor rule for 401(k) plans draws fresh attention
summary: The DOL's March proposal would give fiduciaries a process-based safe harbor for adding private equity, credit and real estate to DC menus; a final rule is expected late 2026 or early 2027.

headline: Majority of insurers plan to raise private credit exposure over the next two years, Marsh survey finds
summary: 57% of surveyed insurers intend to increase private credit in 12-24 months, with private credit now about 16% of portfolios and asset-based finance the most-cited growth area.

headline: Asset managers' insurance-sourced AUM climbs to $5.5 trillion
summary: AI-CIO reports insurance assets run by asset managers have risen to $5.5 trillion, underscoring how insurers outsource investing and partner with alternatives firms.

headline: Prudential launches market sale of up to 2% of ICICI Prudential AMC to meet India's float rule
summary: The UK insurer said on Aug. 26 it will sell up to a 2% stake via the open market to help the India asset manager reach the 15% minimum public float within five years of its December 2025 IPO.

headline: First-half 2026 RIA M&A sets a record with 262 deals and $343 billion in acquired assets
summary: ECHELON Partners data cited by Fidelity shows aggregate acquired assets nearly doubling year over year, with Savant, Wealth Enhancement, Cerity and Mercer among the busiest buyers.

headline: Large property insurance rates fell 14.5% in Q2 as competition intensifies, Willis reports
summary: Shared and layered property programmes saw an average 23.4% reduction, while casualty remains firmer on nuclear verdicts and social inflation, though excess casualty increases may be nearing a peak.

headline: Global commercial insurance rates slide 6% in Q2, an eighth straight quarterly decline
summary: The softening cycle continues across regions as capacity and competition grow, with property leading the declines.

headline: U.S. P&C insurers post $31.7 billion first-half underwriting gain, up from $11.6 billion
summary: Private P&C carriers' estimated net underwriting gain for the first six months jumped sharply versus midyear 2025.

headline: Lloyd's puts a first £1.4 billion figure on losses from the Iran conflict
summary: The preliminary, exposure-based estimate mixes marine war and onshore political violence losses, including Gulf infrastructure; the CFO stressed it is mostly IBNR and the market still posted £3.5B first-half profit.

headline: Admiral to cut hundreds of UK insurance jobs under a wider transformation programme
summary: The reductions are tied to the group's previously announced £100m cost-saving target and topped Insurance Times' weekly list for 21-25 September.

headline: Charles Taylor named among Business Insurance's top third-party administrators for 2026
summary: The recognition highlights claims-handling expertise (TPA vertical had little fresh news; this is the most recent item found).

headline: Marsh launches Broker WorkBench, an AI placement platform for London market brokers
summary: Launched 22 September, the tool combines workflows and data processing to help brokers match placement requests to markets, negotiate and bind.

headline: Price Forbes to integrate mea AI across its broking operations
summary: The broker plans to embed the AI platform in its workflows.

headline: ACA insurers seek a median 14% rate increase for 2027 as enrollment sags
summary: About four points of the increase reflect the expired enhanced subsidies; enrollment was down roughly 3 million versus a year earlier (July reporting).

headline: Nonprofit hospital margins rise a third straight year to 1.5%, but OBBBA cuts loom, Fitch says
summary: Strong volumes, easing labor costs and AI tools helped, while expense savings are being accelerated ahead of legislated reimbursement cuts.

headline: Microsoft and Mayo Clinic build a healthcare frontier AI model owned by Mayo
summary: Clinicians will use it first, with Microsoft distributing via Azure Foundry APIs; a patient-facing tool is years away.

headline: Dinesh Pant and Girija Subramanian appointed members of India's insurance regulator
summary: Pant retired from LIC effective Sept. 24, and Subramanian stepped down as New India Assurance chair in July.

headline: Acrisure completes its purchase of tech-first MGA Vave from Canopius
summary: Acrisure closed the acquisition of the property-focused managing general agent, first announced in April (completion date approximate; broker M&A flow has been thin).

headline: AM Best to deliver its life and annuity segment outlook at the ACLI annual conference on Oct. 16
summary: AM Best analysts will present a session titled 'Life and Annuity Segment in Transition' at the ACLI conference in Orlando, covering operating results, investment strategies, rating trends and the agency's outlook.

headline: ADP Retirement Services takes top spot in two PLANSPONSOR 2026 recordkeeping categories
summary: ADP ranked first in single-employer 401(k) plans and in DC recordkeeping plans added in 2025 in this year's survey.

headline: Recordkeepers get operationally ready for Roth-only catch-up contributions for higher earners
summary: Starting in 2026, savers 50+ earning at least $150,000 in prior-year FICA wages must make catch-up contributions as Roth, putting the burden on plan administrators to build the mechanics.

headline: Vanguard agrees to buy RIA custodian Altruist in a deal reported at about $4 billion
summary: Altruist will reportedly run as a standalone unit under Vanguard, a step in Vanguard's push beyond low-cost funds into financial advice and a challenge to Schwab and Fidelity in RIA custody.

headline: Sequoia and Allworth add nearly $3.3 billion in client assets with fresh RIA deals
summary: Sequoia bought Colorado's BSW Wealth Partners (~$2.3B) after its All Star Financial deal, while Allworth pushed past $40 billion AUM via two simultaneous acquisitions.

headline: Savant Wealth Management enters a third New York office through the Socha Financial deal
summary: The partnership with Corning-based Socha (~$542M AUM) closed Aug. 31 and brings Savant to 71 offices in 28 states, making it one of the year's most acquisitive RIAs.

headline: Gallagher's RPS acquires Kansas MGA and wholesale broker Med James
summary: Risk Placement Services bought the Overland Park-based managing general agency, adding to wholesale capacity (older item; broker M&A flow has been subdued).

headline: North Carolina State Health Plan reissues TPA procurement after bids missed minimum requirements
summary: The plan cancelled its earlier RFP and started a new process aiming for a 2028 third-party administrator (older item).

headline: Shelter Insurance Companies taps One Inc to modernise customer payments
summary: The carrier will use the insurance-specific payments network to overhaul how policyholders pay.

headline: Insurtech funding hits $2.44 billion in Q2, with 99% going to AI-focused companies
summary: Gallagher Re's data shows the highest quarter since Q2 2022, driven by $100M+ rounds (ICEYE's $520M Series F) while early-stage funding fell about 52% quarter on quarter.

headline: IRDAI requires all domestic insurers to report under Ind AS from FY2026-27
summary: The new financial reporting framework will reshape insurer accounting.

headline: IRDAI reform package backs 100% FDI and new AI governance working group
summary: Two insurers have already lifted foreign holdings above 74%, four registrations were approved in 2026, and a working group will oversee AI adoption in insurance.

headline: Fed lifts rates a quarter point to 3.75%-4.00%, citing persistent inflation
summary: The FOMC voted unanimously to raise the target range, saying inflation remains elevated. Higher rates raise reinvestment yields for insurers' fixed-income portfolios, though gains build gradually as older holdings mature.

headline: Serial founders launch Singularity Financial Partners to serve RIAs
summary: The newly launched operating company targets the independent advisory market; the announcement did not disclose backers, deal terms or specific acquisitions.

headline: U.S. P&C industry books a $31.7B first-half underwriting gain with a 92.7 combined ratio
summary: Verisk and APCIA report sharply better results than a year earlier, helped by lower catastrophe losses, but net written premium growth slowed to 2.1% and bodily injury and commercial liability losses kept worsening.

headline: India's insurance regulator floats product-level commission caps and clawbacks for mis-selling
summary: IRDAI's consultation paper proposes capped commissions by product and channel, staggered life commissions and limits on bundling insurance with loans. Comments are open until 25 October; nothing is final.

headline: Shelter Insurance picks One Inc to unify premium and claims payments
summary: The carrier will use One Inc's PremiumPay and ClaimsPay on one platform, adding wallet options such as Apple Pay and Venmo and handling multi-party payments like lienholders. Performance claims come from the vendor.

headline: Policybazaar parent PB Fintech plunges 36% and Turtlemint 20% on proposed commission caps
summary: Listed distributors sold off sharply after the regulator's consultation paper, with PB Fintech suffering its worst single-day fall since listing and analysts split on the medium-term impact.

headline: Minnesota insurers pull back Medicare Advantage options for 2027
summary: Local coverage reports carriers narrowing their Medicare Advantage offerings ahead of open enrollment, part of a wider national retreat from unprofitable plans.

headline: Target-date assets climb to about $5.3 trillion as collective trusts take the majority share
summary: Sway Research puts U.S. target-date assets at roughly $5.3 trillion at mid-year, up 11% since January, with CIT-based series now holding 55% of the total as new Vanguard, Fidelity and Principal launches loom.

headline: RIA M&A cooled in August to 23 deals, with Corient's $21B Summit Trail buy the largest
summary: Dakota's monthly tracker counts 23 announced U.S. wealth deals covering about $30.6 billion of client assets, down from 33 deals and $50.5 billion in July.

headline: Commercial property pricing declines for a fifth straight quarter while casualty stays firm
summary: Q2 data show commercial property pricing down about 8%, with reinsurance costs also easing at mid-year renewals, even as casualty lines keep facing pressure.

headline: Aon agrees to buy USI Insurance Services from KKR in a deal valued around $17 billion
summary: The purchase of the tenth-largest U.S. broker, with roughly $3 billion in annual revenue, extends Aon's middle-market push after its NFP deal. Closing is targeted for the fourth quarter of 2026.

headline: Twelve major health systems and Aidoc form a consortium to test diagnostic AI at scale
summary: Members including Cedars-Sinai, Mount Sinai, Northwell and Sutter will co-design AI-assisted workflows and shared governance practices, with first results expected in 2027.

headline: Hospital layoffs are less frequent and shallower in 2026, Becker's finds
summary: Becker's counts 45 systems announcing cuts January through July versus 59 a year earlier, with average reductions down from about 235 to 140 jobs and a shift toward back-office roles.

headline: Utmost names Natalie Yeo head of high-net-worth underwriting in Singapore
summary: The wealth-solutions insurer appoints a 25-year Asia insurance and reinsurance veteran, previously at AIA and Munich Re, effective October 6.

headline: CMS finalizes 2.48% Medicare Advantage payment increase for 2027
summary: The final rate, worth over $13B, beat the near-flat proposal from January and lifted Humana's stock sharply.

headline: UnitedHealth and Humana say benefits are preserved for 2027, but the data tells a different story
summary: Healthcare Dive's analysis of plan data challenges the insurers' claims that 2027 Medicare Advantage offerings maintain benefits.

headline: IRDAI says 11 insurers have moved to Ind AS accounting for FY 2026-27
summary: The regulator reports that eleven insurers have adopted Ind AS this fiscal year and that it is monitoring those granted forbearance until FY 2027-28.

headline: Fed's first hike since 2023 pushes Treasury yields above 5%, reshaping insurer reinvestment
summary: The Fed lifted rates a quarter point to 3.75%-4% on September 16; with the 10-year near 5%, trade coverage frames this as a rich new-money environment for insurers, especially spread-based life and annuity writers.

headline: Large property rates fall 14.5% in Q2, the steepest drop in a decade, Willis finds
summary: WTW says competition is driving property pricing down while excess casualty increases show signs of peaking; light cat losses and new capacity are cited.

headline: Commercial P&C premium growth flattens to its weakest level since 2017
summary: Alera Group's analysis puts first-half 2026 premium growth at about 0.2% as softening property pricing offsets casualty increases.

headline: Zurich names Alex Wells CEO of Zurich U.S. and adds him to group executive committee
summary: The appointment took effect immediately; Wells joined Zurich in 2020 and previously led US Middle Market, Programs, Captives and Direct Markets.

headline: WTW: excess casualty rate hikes may be peaking as MGA and broker-led capacity arrives
summary: Property pricing keeps falling while excess casualty increases show early signs of peaking, partly due to new capacity from MGAs and broker-led facilities.

headline: Insurtech funding hits $2.44B in Q2, the highest since 2022, almost all AI-focused
summary: Gallagher Re's report says 99% of quarterly funding went to AI-centred firms, with ICEYE's $520M Series F alone about a fifth of the total, while early-stage deals cooled.

headline: Conversational AI and embedded finance converge, commentary argues
summary: An August thought-leadership piece contends brands will win by embedding lending, insurance and payments directly into customer workflows. Vendor-style commentary; treat claims cautiously.

headline: Twelve health systems form an AI diagnostic consortium
summary: Becker's August roundup also notes Epic's nurse AI tool reaching a fifth system and CIOs working to rein in AI token costs.

headline: Ascensus set to take over Mutual of Omaha's 401(k) recordkeeping book
summary: Ascensus agreed to acquire the retirement recordkeeping business of Mutual of Omaha, adding more than 2,300 plans and roughly $3.9 billion in assets to a relationship that has run for over two decades as an outsourced service.

headline: Target-date assets hit $4.8 trillion as collective trusts become the majority vehicle
summary: Morningstar notes U.S. target-date assets reached $4.8 trillion in 2025 with collective investment trusts now holding most of them, and says hybrid public-plus-private 'index plus' designs are gaining traction.

headline: Why target-date funds may be the natural home for private-markets capital
summary: Cambridge Associates argues long horizons make target-date products well suited to private assets, while cautioning that daily valuation, rebalancing and redemption of illiquid holdings remain hard to operationalize.

headline: Private credit is about 6% of life insurers' general account, a counterweight to the alarm
summary: An analysis puts private credit at roughly 6% of life insurer general-account assets in 2025, up from about 3% in 2020, though estimates of total exposure vary widely by definition and the Fed has flagged rising concern.

headline: Pave Finance raises $15 million Series A for AI portfolio management
summary: The startup's round at a reported $100 million pre-money valuation signals investor appetite for AI tools aimed at financial advisors.

headline: WealthAi debuts advisor-focused AI platform, pressuring smaller wealthtech rivals
summary: The launch adds competition for firms under $250 million in assets as larger platforms build their own AI features.

headline: Quiet hurricane forecast does not remove loss risk, insurers warn
summary: Forecasters expect a below-normal season, but a single landfall in a densely populated area could still produce major losses.

headline: Yuzu Health raises $35 million Series A led by General Catalyst for a TPA platform
summary: The round arrives as self-funded plans now cover about two-thirds of covered workers.

headline: Sixfold introduces an AI underwriter that remembers past submissions and broker interactions
summary: The agent is designed to retain context from prior decisions to support underwriting judgments.

headline: Australia drives Asia-Pacific insurance M&A in Q1 2026
summary: S&P Global counted 16 regional deals, unchanged from the prior quarter, with Japan steady at three. Older item, kept because APAC flow is thin this week.

headline: Recordkeepers lean on payroll data as Roth-only catch-up contributions roll out
summary: Savers 50 and over earning at least $150,000 must now make catch-up contributions on a Roth basis, but recordkeepers generally do not track the wage data involved, so plan sponsors and payroll providers hold the key information.

headline: Labor Department's proposed 401(k) investment-selection safe harbor still awaiting a final rule
summary: The proposal sets a process-based test built on performance, fees, liquidity, valuation, benchmarks and complexity, prompted by the executive order on private-market access; it neither mandates alternatives nor offers a blanket liability shield.

headline: September roundup: Sequoia, Modern Wealth, Creative Planning and Captrust all add RIAs
summary: FINTRX's monthly list includes Sequoia Financial buying a $2.3 billion Colorado RIA, Modern Wealth acquiring a $710 million Jacksonville firm, Creative Planning taking investment consultancy RVK, and Captrust adding two New York RIAs.

headline: U.S. P&C industry underwriting profit climbs to $31.7 billion
summary: Verisk and APCIA data cited by the outlet show the industry combined ratio improving to 92.7 at midyear from 96.5 a year earlier.

headline: Lloyd's posts H1 gross premiums of £34.7 billion at a 90.8% combined ratio despite softer pricing
summary: Fitch notes Lloyd's remains exposed to the Iran conflict through marine and aviation war, political violence, trade credit and energy lines.

headline: Cinven and La Caisse to buy majority of MGA Optio from Preservation Capital
summary: The deal appeared in Insurance Times' weekly roundup of the biggest M&A announcements for late July.

headline: Priority Health to offer TPA services to small self-funded Michigan employers
summary: The offering, from a unit Priority acquired in 2024, is available January 1, 2027 for employers with 51 to 99 enrolled employees.

headline: Vertafore rolls out four more AI agents for insurance agencies
summary: Early adopters report large cuts in document review and policy intake time, with general availability expected this year as part of the Velocity AI platform.

headline: Insurers narrow Medicare Advantage provider access
summary: Carriers are tightening networks as they chase margin in the program.

headline: ACA insurers seek a median 14% premium hike for 2027
summary: KFF's review of 77 insurers cites rising costs and expiry of enhanced premium tax credits; most requests fall between 10% and 20%.

headline: State insurance regulators defend their oversight of insurers' private credit exposure
summary: In a reply to a senator's inquiry, the NAIC said solvency rules apply to private-credit-heavy and PE-owned insurers, pointing to tougher asset-adequacy testing and capital charges on structured-security residuals.

headline: Vanguard agrees to buy advisor custody platform Altruist in a deal reported near $4 billion
summary: Altruist will stay a standalone business under its current leadership. The purchase pushes Vanguard deeper into advice and into competition with Schwab and Fidelity for independent-advisor custody.

headline: Reinsurance rates drop 16% at midyear with no floor in sight, JP Morgan says
summary: The Guy Carpenter rate-on-line index fell faster at July renewals than at January, and analysts expect pricing pressure to continue given a lighter hurricane forecast.

headline: European Commission clears Zurich's roughly £8.1 billion acquisition of Beazley
summary: Brussels found no competition concerns in the all-cash deal agreed in March after Beazley's board rejected earlier offers.

headline: Medi Assist reports 44.5% of FY26 claims settled cashless and moves Paramount's TPA business in-house
summary: Company investor materials show real-time integrations driving cashless share, with Paramount's book transferred to Medi Assist's TPA entity from 1 February 2026.

headline: Buddy launches bindable commercial insurance marketplace inside Stripe
summary: Carriers and MGAs can sell policies to businesses already on Stripe, who can quote, bind and pay without leaving the platform.

headline: UnitedHealthcare and Aetna narrow Medicare Advantage footprints for 2027
summary: UnitedHealthcare trims PPO-heavy areas while Aetna shifts toward HMOs and exits states, which is expected to cost it roughly 950,000 members.

headline: American Growth Insurance raises about $70 million to roll up agencies onto an AI platform
summary: Backed by Rockbridge and Atomic, the platform buys independent agencies and migrates them to its AI tooling, claiming 50%+ profitability gains in testing.

headline: ACA marketplace insurers propose a median 14% premium increase for 2027
summary: KFF's review of 77 insurers finds requests mostly between 10% and 20%, driven by cost trends and expired enhanced subsidies; these are preliminary filings.

headline: ICICI Prudential Life names Sidharatha Mishra as MD and CEO
summary: ICICI Life filed that Mishra succeeds Anup Bagchi, taking charge from October 6, with the formal board appointment pending IRDAI approval or October 14.

headline: Empower to take on Milliman's retirement administration unit for $340 million
summary: The deal brings roughly 400 defined benefit plans and about $80 billion in assets under administration to Empower, with closing expected in the second half of 2026.

headline: NAIC macroprudential review flags private credit as a growing insurer risk
summary: A report exposed at the Summer Meeting (comments through Sept. 14) notes that private credit holdings are hard to quantify and that PE-owned insurers lean more on structured and non-traditional assets.

headline: Corient adds $21 billion ultra-high-net-worth RIA Summit Trail Advisors
summary: The New York firm works as an outsourced family office and CIO; terms were not disclosed and closing is expected in the third quarter.

headline: J.P. Morgan expects January 2027 property-cat reinsurance rates to fall another 10-20%
summary: The decline is smaller than in recent renewals, which the bank reads as early stabilisation, though it assumes no major late-year catastrophe.

headline: Allianz Insurance Singapore appoints Ong Bi Ying as CEO
summary: The long-serving COO takes over from Hicham Raissi, who is leaving the Allianz Group, effective October 1.

headline: EQT to buy majority of London broker McGill and Partners at a $2 billion valuation
summary: Warburg Pincus sells its full stake; founder Steve McGill stays as CEO. The broker has over $250 million in revenue and 600+ staff across seven countries.

headline: Brown & Brown buys Scottish broker MacKay Corporate Insurance Brokers
summary: Reported as the group's first retail acquisition in Scotland; the Glasgow, Ayr and Aberdeen business becomes its Scottish retail hub. Terms were not disclosed.

headline: Weekly people moves: new chiefs named at Willis Re and Jensten
summary: Insurance Times' round-up for October 5-9 covers senior appointments across the UK market, including new chief executives at the reinsurance broker and the broking group.

headline: Medi Assist folds Paramount's TPA business into its own entity via slump sale
summary: Following the 2025 acquisition, the transfer took effect Feb. 1; the company reports over half of Paramount's claims volume migrated to its platform by April. Older item, included as TPA flow was thin.

headline: ING selects bolttech as embedded insurance partner across European markets
summary: The programme is already live in the Netherlands, Italy, Poland and Belgium, with more markets to follow.

headline: Kenya's Jubilee Health uses embedded distribution to widen cover
summary: The insurer plans to sell policies through banks, fuel stations and retailers and is talking to telcos and buy-now-pay-later providers.

headline: Zywave's summer release extends AI prospecting and renewal tools to brokers
summary: The update adds AI-driven prospecting, renewal management and API-based onboarding to the Apex platform.

headline: American Growth Insurance launches as an AI-enabled brokerage roll-up
summary: The Atlanta platform has nearly $70 million in committed equity and plans to buy independent agencies and layer in custom AI tooling.

headline: Insurtech funding reaches $2.44 billion in Q2, with AI firms taking 99%
summary: Gallagher Re counts 107 deals, with $100M+ rounds making up 68% of the total (including ICEYE's $520M Series F), while early-stage funding fell about 52%. Date approximate.

headline: CMS projects Medicare Advantage premiums to fall about 16.5% in 2027
summary: Average MA premiums are projected at $12 versus $14.37, while stand-alone Part D premiums edge up under a dollar; open enrollment starts Oct. 15.

headline: UnitedHealthcare and Aetna narrow Medicare Advantage networks for 2027
summary: Both lean toward tighter HMO-style products as costs rise; Aetna will operate in 41 states versus 43 now, and UnitedHealthcare is trimming PPO-heavy areas.

headline: ACA insurers seek a median 14% premium increase for 2027
summary: A Peterson-KFF review of filings in 16 states and D.C. found no proposed decreases, with about 4 points attributed to the lasting effect of expired enhanced subsidies. Preliminary rates; older item.

headline: Twelve health systems and Aidoc form a Diagnostic AI Consortium
summary: Members including Cedars-Sinai, Mount Sinai and Northwell will co-design AI diagnostic workflows and share governance practices, with first results expected in 2027.

headline: AM Best life and annuity analysts to brief ACLI conference on a segment 'in transition'
summary: AM Best plans a Hot Issues session on Oct. 16 at the ACLI annual conference in Orlando covering operating results, investment strategies and rating trends for life and annuity insurers. No content from the session has been published yet.

headline: Lloyd's finds ex-CEO John Neal's conduct fell below leadership standards
summary: Lloyd's Council concluded Neal failed to disclose a perceived conflict tied to a close workplace relationship, and has since tightened senior-appointment and disclosure rules.

headline: Willis Re names Conduit Re's Neil Eckert as its first global CEO
summary: Eckert, a Conduit Re co-founder, will lead the relaunched reinsurance broker after leaving Conduit on March 1, 2027; Conduit has named Christian Dunleavy as successor.

headline: Outmarket AI raises $34.5 million Series B led by SignalFire
summary: The agency-automation platform, now with 300+ agency customers, plans to extend into carriers later in 2026 after a Series A only months earlier.

headline: ACCC clears Zurich's roughly A$415 million ClearView Wealth takeover
summary: Australia's competition regulator found the deal unlikely to substantially lessen competition under the new merger regime; APRA, court and shareholder approvals were still needed.

headline: Target-date assets climb 11% in first half to $5.3 trillion
summary: Sway Research data show CIT-based target-date series now hold 55% of assets, with major Vanguard, Fidelity, Transamerica and Principal launches expected to add momentum.

headline: Vanguard agrees to buy RIA custodian Altruist for a reported $4 billion
summary: Vanguard will acquire the advisor-focused custody and technology platform, which will continue operating as a standalone business; close is expected later in 2026 pending approvals.

headline: Insurtech funding hits four-year high at $2.44 billion, with AI taking 99%
summary: Gallagher Re's Q2 report shows mega-rounds driving the rebound while early-stage funding fell about 52% quarter on quarter, signalling narrowing capital concentration.

headline: Humana rebounds, Aetna slips in 2027 Medicare Advantage star ratings
summary: Humana's share of members in 4+ star plans jumps sharply while UnitedHealth and Aetna see double-digit declines; ratings will show during open enrollment starting Oct. 15.

headline: Employers pull back from big-three PBMs as reform pressure builds
summary: A purchaser survey shows employer use of CVS Caremark, Express Scripts or Optum Rx fell from 63.4% to 54.3%, amid FTC settlements and a proposed DOL PBM transparency rule.

headline: Prismic Life takes on about $5 billion of Prudential's Japanese whole-life reserves
summary: Bermuda-based Prismic Life will reinsure roughly $5 billion of reserves tied to USD-denominated Japanese whole life policies. Prudential keeps administering the contracts and policyholder obligations are unchanged.

headline: Pacific Life Re enters the US market with a $3 billion longevity deal
summary: The reinsurer will assume longevity risk on a block of pension risk transfer liabilities written by American National, marking its first move into US retirement-risk reinsurance.

headline: Pacific Life Re closes second structured reinsurance transaction with a Japanese life insurer this year
summary: The deal is the reinsurer's second structured arrangement in Japan in 2026, underscoring continued appetite among Japanese carriers for capital-management reinsurance.

headline: Foreign life insurers get a warm welcome in India, but policy uncertainty lingers
summary: A CNBC newsletter looks at how global insurers such as Prudential, Aviva and AXA are courted in India's liberalised market even as unresolved policy questions complicate their plans.

headline: LIC readies three new non-par plans: a deferred annuity and two health pure-risk covers
summary: From October 19, LIC will sell New Jeevan Dhara II (deferred annuity), Health Shield and New Cancer Cover, all non-participating and non-linked.

headline: Fidelity counts a record 769,000 401(k) millionaires as total savings rate nears 15%
summary: Fidelity's Q2 data shows 401(k) millionaires rising from 646,000 the prior quarter, with combined employee and employer savings at a record 14.4% of pay.

headline: New suit challenges Wellington's use of its own funds in a plan it serves as trustee
summary: A complaint filed in Massachusetts federal court alleges fiduciary failings tied to proprietary fund offerings. The claims are allegations, not rulings.

headline: Goldman's asset and wealth fees hit a record $3.6 billion as NEOS and LCN deals loom
summary: Goldman reported 22% growth in the segment's fees with $97 billion of long-term net inflows, and said the pending NEOS purchase would push active ETF assets above $90 billion.

headline: Blackstone raises about $1 billion private credit continuation fund led by Allianz GI
summary: The secondary-style vehicle drew Allianz Global Investors as lead buyer, while Centerbridge separately closed a $4 billion opportunistic credit fund.

headline: McKinsey: asset management rewards scale as top five managers capture 94% of US passive flows
summary: The firm's 2026 outlook says private credit faces a tougher backdrop, global ETF assets sit near $22 trillion, and gains are concentrating in a few large players.

headline: Life insurers lend to private credit funds they back, adding risk
summary: Analysis based on a WSJ report estimates insurers lent about $24 billion to funds in which they hold stakes worth roughly $12 billion, raising concentration concerns.

headline: US WealthTech funding projected to fall 15% in 2026 even as deal count rises
summary: H1 saw $1.5 billion across 173 deals; full-year deal activity is forecast up 34% while dollars invested decline.

headline: AI data centre losses could cut across policies and portfolios, APAC insurers warn
summary: S&P Global Ratings says data centres complicate business-interruption cover and accumulation modelling, with about $10 billion of new global premium possible in 2026.

headline: US P&C carriers see fewer rating downgrades in H1 2026 on improved performance
summary: AM Best data shows downgrades were a smaller share of rating actions than a year earlier, with most concentrated in commercial casualty and commercial auto.

headline: Aon agrees to buy USI from KKR for about $17 billion
summary: The all-cash deal, expected to close in Q4, would create what Aon calls a premier US middle-market platform; USI has over $3 billion in revenue.

headline: India's insurance regulator eyes 2027 start for commission and expense caps
summary: IRDAI's consultation, open until October 25, proposes limits on insurer expenses and distributor commissions across lines; brokers warn of job losses.

headline: Benefits software firm CHS to buy small TPA America's Choice Healthplans
summary: The target administers plans for 20+ employers on roughly $2.3 million of revenue; CHS frames it as a first step in rolling up fragmented TPAs.

headline: Policybazaar parent PB Fintech sinks 36% as India floats commission caps
summary: Bloomberg reports the online insurance marketplace operator's shares tumbled when the regulator's proposals surfaced.

headline: XPT Specialty rolls out AI tools to widen retail agents' access to SME accounts
summary: The wholesaler deployed a suite of AI tools across its operation to speed placement of small and mid-sized accounts.

headline: Agents use AI, but their agencies mostly haven't formally adopted it
summary: Insurance Business reports a Zywave survey finding that lagging technology is now a leading reason employers switch brokers.

headline: UPMC completes takeover of CommonSpirit's Trinity Health System in Ohio
summary: The deal transfers hospitals in Steubenville, Dennison and St. Clairsville to UPMC; financial terms were not disclosed.

headline: RIA dealmaking races toward a record year as consolidators chase scale
summary: Echelon Partners projects roughly 500 wealth deals in 2026, with 120 transactions in the second quarter alone.

headline: Embedded insurance forecast to grow from $176 billion in 2026 to $1.46 trillion by 2034
summary: A market report cites BCG's estimate of over $70 billion in embedded gross written premium by 2030.

headline: Vertafore introduces four AI agents for independent agencies under 'Agentic Agency' strategy
summary: The agents cover policy servicing, document research and agency operations, with early adopters already using them.

headline: DOL's proposed safe harbor would give 401(k) fiduciaries room to pick alternatives-inclusive options
summary: The proposed rule sets a process-based standard for selecting designated investment alternatives, weighing performance, fees, liquidity, valuation and complexity without requiring the lowest-cost choice. Comments closed June 1; no final rule was found.

headline: Franklin Templeton adds private credit and real estate sleeves to its target-date series
summary: The expanded Retirement Advantage Plus lineup allocates roughly 2%-8% to private markets over an investor's life while keeping daily liquidity. Landmark item, older than the 60-day window.

headline: USI sees property softening while liability rates hold firm
summary: Primary general liability rates rose from flat to 12.5% in the first half, with further increases expected in the second half.

headline: Medi Assist folds Paramount Health's TPA business into its insurance TPA arm
summary: The slump-sale transfer of Paramount's TPA operations took effect February 1, 2026 after a deal valued around Rs 400 crore. Landmark item, older than 60 days.

headline: Paymentology's $175M raise is the largest embedded finance round in one tracker
summary: The tracker counts 46 embedded finance deals from January 2024 to June 2026, with small embedded-insurance rounds among them. Older than 60 days.

headline: Zywave ships AI agents for producers in its Winter 2026 release
summary: Four new agents aim to cut admin work for agencies and brokers and are already with more than 35 early adopters.

headline: GetCovered buys Revyse to link AI vendor intelligence with insurance automation
summary: Reported in a September 15 industry newsletter roundup.

headline: Guidewire launches an agentic framework for insurers
summary: The core-system vendor's August launch follows Duck Creek's April agentic platform, as both big vendors add agent layers.

headline: Hospital deal count jumps to 18 in Q2 with three mega-mergers
summary: Six were divestitures, three involved distressed sellers, and margins dipped slightly in May per Kaufman Hall data.

headline: AHA highlights a Kaufman Hall report on what merger analysis overlooks for patients
summary: The report argues reviews should weigh patient access, especially when deals fall through, not just commercial prices.

headline: ICICI Prudential Life hands the CEO role to Sidharatha Mishra as Anup Bagchi exits
summary: Bagchi stepped down at close of business on October 13; Mishra joined as COO on October 6 and is set to take over as MD and CEO on October 14, subject to regulatory approval.

headline: Dakota counts 36 US wealth deals in September covering about $49B of client assets
summary: The monthly roundup shows volume up from August, with majority buyouts still the bulk of deals while minority stakes and continuation vehicles grow.

headline: CMS projects Medicare Advantage premiums to fall about 16.5% in 2027
summary: Average monthly premium would drop from $14.37 to $12, MA drug premiums fall 38%, and about 34 million enrollees are expected. Open enrollment starts October 15.

headline: Cyber insurance rates hold within roughly plus or minus 5%
summary: Carrier Management reports cyber pricing is essentially flat, in line with a broader picture of softening in property and stabilising casualty lines.

headline: Al Buhaira National Insurance names Ahmed Khalifa as CEO
summary: Khalifa brings more than 30 years of experience across the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Egypt.

headline: Humana shares surge as it emerges as top beneficiary of 2027 star ratings
summary: Analysts estimate the improved ratings could be worth several billion dollars in bonus payments in 2028; the company reports earnings on November 6.

headline: Medicare open enrollment opens with Advantage drug-plan premiums projected to fall for 2027
summary: CMS projections cited by El Cronista put average premiums for MA plans with drug coverage near $7 a month versus $11.32 in 2026, while standalone Part D edges up slightly.

headline: Colorado's Montrose Regional Health cuts 77 positions citing reimbursement pressure
summary: The system aims to trim $8 million, with 34 layoffs and 43 roles removed through attrition, and says reimbursement has not kept pace with costs.

headline: AM Best: U.S. life and annuity net income roughly flat in first half of 2026
summary: Total industry income fell about 8.1% as premiums and annuity considerations dropped, driven in part by a large premium decline at one retirement-focused insurer and a reinsurance reserve adjustment at another.

headline: Wealth Enhancement agrees to buy $22B Boston family-office RIA RWA Wealth Partners
summary: The largest deal in the buyer's history would lift it past $187 billion in client assets, fold RWA's family office into its high-net-worth unit and mark an exit for private equity backer Summit Partners; close expected in Q4.

headline: FINTRX: 60 RIA deals in Q3 and 2026 already tops all of last year
summary: Announced RIA transactions covered about $100.9 billion of acquired assets in the quarter, and 225 deals through September exceeds 2025's full-year total of 193.

headline: Moody's survey: cedents expect property reinsurance prices to fall further in 2027
summary: About 38% expect portfolio-wide declines of 7.5% to 15%, and for the first time in years more respondents expect casualty prices to fall than rise; a major catastrophe could shift expectations quickly.

headline: Aon agrees to acquire USI from KKR for about $17 billion, doubling down on the U.S. middle market
summary: The all-cash deal values USI at roughly 14.5x adjusted EBITDA and follows Aon's NFP purchase; it has not yet closed, and coverage notes investor skepticism and a recent CFO departure.

headline: Hospital mergers in 2026 already exceed last year; Rush and Endeavor plan a 12-hospital system
summary: The piece notes more 'mega-mergers' involving large systems and expects further deals.

headline: ICICI Life taps Sidharatha Mishra as MD and CEO after Anup Bagchi resigns
summary: The board named the ICICI Bank digital-channels head to lead the insurer for five years, effective 14 October or on IRDAI approval; Bagchi left at close of business 13 October.

headline: Indian life insurers post roughly 21% September new-business growth as IRDAI flags distribution concerns
summary: Industry first-year premium rose about 20.6% year on year, with LIC up 19.3%; the regulator's distribution reforms and mis-selling risk remain in focus.

headline: U.S. ETFs take in $140.9B in September, keeping 2026 on a record inflow pace
summary: FactSet says ETF assets ended September near $16.4 trillion; monthly inflows slowed about 30% from August but year-to-date flows exceed $1.5 trillion.

headline: Target-date assets reached $4.8T in 2025 as collective trusts passed half the market
summary: Vanguard led net new assets and asset-weighted fund fees slipped to 27 basis points, per annual industry data.

headline: Fed signals more tightening after September hike, a backdrop for insurer portfolios
summary: The central bank lifted its range to 3.75%–4.00% in September, its first increase since 2023, and most officials see room for another this year.

headline: Anthropic's advisor tools link to Envestnet and Orion as wealthtech vendors race on AI
summary: A wealthtech roundup notes advisors must still approve recommendations and client communications, while LPL and Orion expand work with Anthropic.

headline: U.S. P&C industry posts about $31.7B first-half underwriting gain as premium growth slows
summary: Verisk and APCIA estimate net written premium growth of 2.1%, with results varying widely by line and geography.

headline: London Market Quarterly examines D&O fraud-avoidance and fair-presentation rulings
summary: Browne Jacobson's autumn edition covers Liberty v Chedid and a Court of Appeal decision tied to a Lloyd's broker scandal.

headline: Allianz and MSIG Asia reshuffle senior leadership
summary: Philipp Kroetz moves to lead Allianz Partners from 1 November, and Ronak Shah became MSIG Asia regional CEO on 1 October.

headline: Comprehensive Healthcare Systems agrees to buy TPA America's Choice Healthplans
summary: The Canadian software firm calls the small deal a first step in consolidating the fragmented U.S. TPA market; closing is expected this month.

headline: FinTech funding tops $2.8B in a week as Ramp raises $1.85B
summary: FinTech Global counted 17 deals across AI, payments, insurance and lending, including a €545m ID Finance package.

headline: Bold Penguin and bolttech partner on bundled commercial and personal lines
summary: A deal-tracker entry (secondhand, terms undisclosed) says the partnership took effect 1 October.

headline: Outmarket reportedly raises about $35M Series B
summary: The AI-focused insurtech's round came only months after a prior financing, per a funding-tracker listing.

headline: Proposed 2027 ACA premium increases run in the double digits
summary: Median requests are around 15% before subsidies, driven by hospital and drug costs and a worsening risk pool after enhanced subsidies expired.

headline: Kaufman Hall counts 16 hospital deals worth $8.2B in Q3
summary: Fierce flags two mega-mergers, including Erlanger Health System with Prisma Health.

headline: Duke Health and CaroMont file to jointly build two Charlotte-area hospitals
summary: Certificate of Need applications seek 120- and 80-bed facilities, pending state approval.

headline: Inspira Health CEO Amy Mansue to retire; COO Warren Moore to succeed
summary: The four-hospital South Jersey system announced the year-end transition this week.

headline: FCA announces moves to widen protection insurance cover for millions of UK consumers
summary: Milliman's September life regulatory roundup flags new FCA initiatives aimed at raising protection insurance take-up.

headline: UnitedHealth raises 2026 outlook after Q3 medical cost ratio improves to 88.4%
summary: The company credited pricing, benefit design and cost management and lifted adjusted EPS guidance to at least $20.50.

headline: AI-native advisory firm Savvy Wealth raises $100 million Series C
summary: Halo Fund led an oversubscribed round for the RIA, which reports about $9 billion in client assets, 150-plus independent advisors and annual recurring revenue approaching $100 million; proceeds go to its AI tooling, client service and hiring.

headline: Two advisor teams with $590 million in assets move to LPL and Raymond James
summary: One team left Edward Jones for LPL and a $400 million-plus advisor moved from UBS to Raymond James' employee channel, extending the summer's recruiting flow between wirehouses and independents.

headline: Large North American property rates fall 14.5% in Q2, the steepest drop in a decade
summary: Willis reports sharp declines for large and complex property risks as capacity returns, while casualty pricing stays firmer.

headline: Zurich completes its £8.1 billion takeover of Lloyd's specialist Beazley
summary: The scheme took effect on 1 October, bringing Zurich into Lloyd's for the first time; Zurich targets over $1 billion of extra annual revenue by 2029 and at least $150 million of cost savings.

headline: NAIC publishes first national analysis of homeowners insurance trends
summary: Using seven years of market conduct data, regulators find the market operationally sound with improved 2024 underwriting results, while acknowledging higher premiums, more non-renewals and rising claims costs.

headline: Markel moves a renewables underwriter from London to Singapore to build its Asia-Pacific book
summary: Citing rapid regional electrification, Markel is expanding its renewables and power underwriting in Asia-Pacific with the relocation.

headline: Ong Bi Ying takes over as CEO of Allianz Insurance Singapore
summary: The leadership change took effect on 1 October, succeeding Hicham Raissi who is leaving the Allianz Group.

headline: World Insurance Associates adds Laredo, Texas agency Cubriel
summary: The national broker continues its steady run of small agency purchases, with the deal having closed on 1 June.

headline: IRDAI floats commission caps and clawbacks in a distribution-reform consultation
summary: The paper proposes product-level commission limits, lower expense-of-management ceilings and clawbacks for mis-selling, citing distributor payouts that grew far faster than premiums; comments are due around 25 October.

headline: PB Fintech shares plunge about 36% after IRDAI's commission-cap proposal
summary: Insurance distributors sold off sharply on 24 September as the draft reforms raised the prospect of lower payouts for online and agent channels.

headline: PBM transparency stays on the agenda heading into the midterms
summary: A pharmacy-policy outlook notes bipartisan support for PBM disclosure and reimbursement scrutiny that could continue regardless of the election outcome.

headline: Highmark Health names Karen Hanlon CEO, effective January 2027
summary: The current president succeeds David Holmberg, who moves to executive chairman; she will be the first woman to lead the health plan and provider group.

headline: HealthPartners and Essentia Health agree to combine into a 22-hospital system
summary: Targeted for January 1, 2027 pending approvals, the deal would operate under the HealthPartners name with Essentia facilities keeping their brand.

headline: Duke Health and CaroMont Health plan a joint venture to build two Charlotte hospitals
summary: The project is pending North Carolina regulatory approval.

headline: U.S. annuity sales set a new quarterly record of $123.9 billion in Q2 2026
summary: LIMRA data show second-quarter sales topping $100 billion for an 11th straight quarter, lifting first-half sales to $231.3 billion (up 2%), even as fixed and fixed-indexed products each slipped year over year.

headline: Outmarket raises $34.5 million Series B months after its Series A
summary: SignalFire led the round for the AI platform that automates administrative work for commercial insurance agencies; the company reports 300-plus agency customers (self-reported).

headline: Medicare Advantage plans trim benefits for 2027, with UnitedHealthcare and Humana cutting most
summary: Analyst reviews of 2027 plan data point to reduced Part B givebacks and dental allowances and narrower footprints, despite a 2.48% federal payment increase.

headline: Rush and Endeavor Health plan merger to form a 12-hospital Illinois system
summary: The combined nonprofit would have about $11 billion in revenue and 46,000 employees, with Endeavor pledging $1 billion in investment; regulatory review could take months.

headline: TPG-backed Third Wave buys five Gulf Coast firms, including a self-funded health plan TPA
summary: Third Wave agreed to acquire Acuity Group (which includes TPA BAS) and four other agencies, folding them into the Palmer & Cay brand; terms were not disclosed. Dated late July, included as TPA flow is thin.

headline: Pooled employer plan adoption jumps roughly 45% as 401(k) plan counts keep shrinking
summary: PLANSPONSOR's survey counts about 10,800 employers in 401(k)/403(b) PEPs versus about 7,450 a year earlier, while 401(k) assets near $9.8 trillion and plan counts fall as PEPs absorb small plans.

headline: US wealthtech funding hits a five-quarter high of $1.8B in Q3, led by Ridgeline's $250M round
summary: FinTech Global reports 56 deals in the quarter, with larger average deal size driven by a few big raises such as Ridgeline's AI-native investment management Series E.

headline: UnitedHealth lifts 2026 profit outlook as medical cost ratio improves to 88.4%
summary: Third-quarter adjusted EPS was $4.69 on $112.7B revenue; the company now expects at least $20.50 for the year, helped by $610M of favorable reserve development.

headline: Study says hospital merger reviews miss key points
summary: Chief Healthcare Executive covers a report arguing that current hospital merger reviews overlook important considerations, amid a rebound in 2026 deal activity.

headline: UnitedHealthcare and Aetna tighten Medicare Advantage networks as 2027 costs rise
summary: A report says the large MA carriers are narrowing networks, with insurers arguing reimbursement has lagged medical cost and utilization growth.

headline: MFS survey: few plan sponsors plan to add private assets to DC lineups soon
summary: Only about 4% of surveyed sponsors say they are likely to bring private assets into their plans within the next 12-24 months, a cautious read compared with asset managers' product push into target-date funds.

headline: Medi Assist's revenue grows 24% in Q1 FY27 as group TPA share reaches 37.6%
summary: Operating revenue rose to Rs 236.5 crore, though EBITDA margin eased to 20.3%. Migration of Paramount TPA's claims to Medi Assist's platform is largely complete, with full migration targeted for Q2 FY27.

headline: Evident: agentic AI in insurance is claims-led, with underwriting the fastest-growing area
summary: Q2 tracking shows underwriting and pricing applications growing fastest, driven by P&C carriers, though rollouts are still led more by vendors than insurers and humans keep the final say.

headline: Insurance Business: Asia-Pacific insurance innovators are moving from pilots to scale
summary: The feature profiles regional products and leaders whose innovation programs have progressed beyond pilot stage.

headline: LIMRA's final Q2 count puts U.S. annuity sales at $121.2 billion, a first-half record
summary: Final survey data show second-quarter sales up 2% year over year, with the first half totaling $228.7 billion and the string of $100B-plus quarters extended to eleven. RILA sales hit a quarterly record while fixed-rate deferred sales retreated from a year earlier.

headline: Athene, New York Life and Jackson lead first-quarter annuity carrier rankings
summary: LIMRA's Q1 2026 top-20 list puts Athene first in total annuity sales, with New York Life and Jackson National behind it.

headline: Nuveen completes its roughly £9.9bn takeover of Schroders
summary: The deal closed on October 1 after court sanction, forming a manager with about $2.6 trillion in assets; Schroders will run as a standalone unit for at least 12 months.

headline: Wellington to buy Hartford Funds in a deal expected to close in Q1 2027
summary: Announced in June, the transaction carries a net present value of roughly $1.9 billion according to deal counsel commentary.

headline: Japan's Amova completes purchase of Malaysia's AHAM Capital
summary: Amova AM lifted its stake to about 97.7% in the Malaysian manager, which oversaw roughly RM103 billion in assets as of March 31.

headline: Labor Department's alternatives safe-harbor proposal still awaits real-world uptake
summary: The March proposal lists six prudence factors for fiduciaries, but none of the largest target-date providers has yet put alternatives into their funds.

headline: North Carolina State Health Plan scraps its TPA RFP after no bid met requirements
summary: A fresh procurement is planned; incumbent Aetna's contract runs through the end of 2027.

headline: McGill and Partners embeds a Salesforce Agentforce agent in its Underscore platform
summary: The specialty broker launched an AI agent to support its brokers inside its own platform; the source gives no precise date.

headline: KFF: ACA insurers propose a median 14% premium increase for 2027
summary: Rising costs and the expiration of enhanced premium tax credits drive the requests; this link is MedCity News' KFF topic page.

headline: PBM reform moves from statute to implementation as firms shift to fee-based models
summary: New federal rules, an ERISA fee-disclosure proposal, and Express Scripts and Optum Rx pricing changes reshape PBM economics.

headline: Hospital margins weakened through summer, with 43% of hospitals operating in the red
summary: Kaufman Hall's flash report, as summarized by industry roundups, shows costs outpacing revenue; the August margin figure was about 1.8%.

headline: ADP claims top spots in two categories of the 2026 recordkeeping survey
summary: ADP Retirement Services says it ranked first for single-employer 401(k) plans and for DC plans added in 2025 in PLANSPONSOR's annual survey; this is a company release.

headline: Envestnet to acquire Vestmark, extending into wirehouse and institutional trading
summary: The Bain Capital-owned platform will add Vestmark's portfolio management and trading tools (over $2 trillion in assets) and plans joint AI features; closing is expected in Q4.

headline: Large commercial property rates fell 14.5% in Q2, Willis reports
summary: The decline is steeper than the 8.4% drop a year earlier, while casualty lines such as excess liability stay firmer though possibly nearing a peak.

headline: Insurtech funding hits $2.44 billion in Q2, the highest since 2022
summary: Gallagher Re data show 99% of capital went to AI-focused companies.

headline: Treasury joins regulators' scrutiny of the $1.52 trillion Bermuda life reinsurance market
summary: Treasury Secretary Bessent met state insurance regulators in May to discuss offshore reinsurance and private credit exposure, adding federal attention to a Bermuda sector that held $1.52T in assets as of September 2025.

headline: Allianz agrees to buy HSBC Life Singapore alongside a 15-year bank distribution pact
summary: The roughly €2bn package pairs the acquisition of HSBC's Singapore insurer with an exclusive 15-year bancassurance partnership; closing is expected in the first half of 2027, pending regulatory approval.

headline: DOL proposal offers 401(k) fiduciaries a process-based safe harbor for private-market assets
summary: The March proposal would let fiduciaries include private equity, credit and real estate, including inside target-date funds, without being required to pick the cheapest option; comments closed June 1 and finalization status was not confirmed.

headline: Bermuda life conference: NAIC weighs capital charges for reinsurance recapture risk
summary: Takeaways from the 2026 BILTIR conference suggest regulators are looking at capital rules reflecting recapture risk and weaker reinsurer credit, putting collateral and counterparty strength under more scrutiny.

headline: WTW expects 2027 property cuts of 5-25% while high-hazard casualty keeps climbing
summary: Its Bermuda marketplace outlook sees single-carrier property programs down 5-15%, layered programs down 15-25%, and high-hazard casualty up 5-20%.

headline: AIG appoints Turab Hussain as chief risk officer, effective October 12
summary: The appointment is one of several senior insurance leadership changes reported in October.

headline: Vertafore adds an AI agent for MGA and underwriting submission intake
summary: Its Velocity AI agent checks submissions for completeness and drafts follow-up requests; the 87% early accuracy is a vendor-reported figure and the announcement date was not confirmed.

headline: CMS comment window on pharmacy and Part D contract terms runs to November 23
summary: A September 24 RFI is open while PBM reform retains rare bipartisan support, per a pharmacy policy outlook.

headline: Niva Bupa Q1 FY27 profit jumps 93% as premiums grow 32%
summary: Gross written premium reached ₹2,150 crore with retail health up 47%; a six-month branch expansion restriction was also noted by one source.

headline: Star Health's Q1 FY27 profit rises 25% to ₹550 crore
summary: Retail claims settlement improved to 91% and the combined ratio to 97.0%, reported under Ind AS.

headline: Hospitals use the lead time before 2027 Medicaid cuts to brace for lower revenue
summary: Cuts from the 2025 budget law bite in 2027; systems are leaning on AI and supply-cost management, and some have made pre-emptive layoffs.

headline: NHS plans a wide AI rollout including triage, ambient notes and a single patient record
summary: Part of a £10bn programme under the 10 Year Plan, per Global Government Forum.

headline: The Hartford names president Mo Tooker its next CEO; Christopher Swift to be executive chair
summary: Tooker takes over March 1, 2027 and joins the board October 1, 2026; Swift stays as executive chair into the second half of 2027.

headline: Aon to buy KKR-owned USI Insurance Services in a $17 billion middle-market bet
summary: The deal for the tenth-largest U.S. broker (about $3B revenue) follows Aon's 2024 NFP purchase and is expected to close in Q4 2026.

headline: ASPPA Annual spotlights 'TPA Teammates' honorees from recordkeeper partners
summary: The 2026-27 awards recognize distinguished wholesalers and relationship managers who work with third-party administrators.

headline: Engine by Gen launches an insurance shopping site built for AI agents
summary: The embedded-finance marketplace owned by Gen Digital is aimed at agent-driven purchasing; only the announcement snippet was available, so details should be confirmed.

headline: Insurtech funding hits a four-year high of $2.44B in Q2, with AI taking 99.1%
summary: Gallagher Re counts 107 deals, with $100M+ rounds making up 68% of the total while early-stage funding fell 51.8% quarter on quarter.

headline: A roundup of 12 recent insurtech rounds tops $153M in disclosed funding
summary: The tally, led by Luzern Risk, Outmarket AI and Corridor, comes from a marketing blog, so figures should be verified against primary announcements.

headline: IRDAI moves Indian insurers to Ind AS reporting
summary: Eleven insurers have adopted Ind AS from FY2026-27, with the remainder due in FY2027-28.

headline: Recordkeepers prepare for Roth-only catch-ups with full enforcement due in 2027
summary: Under SECURE 2.0, higher earners' catch-up contributions must be Roth; regulators promised good-faith flexibility for 2026 rollout, with full enforcement in 2027.

headline: DOL's proposed safe harbor for alternatives in 401(k) menus still awaiting finalization
summary: The March 2026 proposal would give fiduciaries a process that creates a rebuttable presumption of prudence when selecting investment options including alternatives; no final rule was found as of this run.

headline: Target-date assets reach $5.3 trillion at mid-year as CITs pass 55% share
summary: Sway Research says TDF assets rose 11% in H1 2026; lifetime-income target-date series from BlackRock, State Street and AB posted double-digit growth.

headline: BlackRock plans target-date series with 5-20% private-market allocation
summary: Developed with Great Gray Trust, the model would scale private equity exposure by investor age; launch timing was not confirmed in coverage.

headline: Life insurers' private credit holdings keep climbing, drawing risk scrutiny
summary: A Chicago Fed paper pegs life-insurer private credit at $849B (14% of balance sheets) in 2024, driven by PE-owned insurers; Moody's flags rising illiquid holdings.

headline: SEC proposes interval fund rule changes
summary: JD Supra lists SEC proposals released Sept 30, including amendments to Investment Company Act rules for interval funds; details should be checked against the SEC release.

headline: Vanguard agrees to buy custody and wealthtech platform Altruist
summary: Announced Aug 26, the deal gives Vanguard a stake in RIA custody; press put the price near $4-4.6B, unconfirmed by either firm. Altruist will operate independently.

headline: Singapore life insurers push into wealth management
summary: WealthBriefing's series opener looks at Singlife, Sun Life and Manulife building wealth capabilities and hiring in Singapore.

headline: India SIP contributions hit record Rs 32,490 crore in September
summary: AMFI data show SIP inflows up about 11% year on year, stoppage ratio down to 78.5%, and net equity inflows near Rs 38,300 crore even as debt funds saw large outflows.

headline: Property-cat reinsurance rates fall up to 25% as capital hits a record
summary: Record reinsurance capital keeps pressure on pricing; J.P. Morgan expects 10-20% declines at Jan 1, 2027, a slower pace suggesting stabilisation.

headline: The Hartford names Mo Tooker to succeed Chris Swift as CEO in 2027
summary: Tooker, currently president, takes over March 1, 2027; Swift becomes executive chair.

headline: Shelter Insurance picks One Inc to modernize customer payments

summary: Higher premiums helped Progressive beat earnings estimates, with net income of about $2.54 billion and an 80-basis-point improvement in the combined ratio.

summary: Business Insurance reports the light catastrophe year is reinforcing softer property pricing heading into the January reinsurance renewals.

summary: A late-September consultation proposes tighter commission limits across health, motor, life and credit-linked products plus curbs on mis-selling and bundling; PB Fintech and Turtlemint shares fell sharply and feedback closes October 25.

headline: Brown & Brown's Q2 organic revenue slips 0.7% as pricing tailwinds fade
summary: The broker's second-quarter filing shows organic revenue down 0.7% (up 0.7% including contingents), following 1.0% growth in Q1, as property rate declines weigh.

summary: The insurer kept more ACA members than expected, now projecting at least 1.2 million at year end, and expects a modestly higher full-year operating margin.

summary: KFF's analysis notes marketing began October 1 and open enrollment runs October 15 to December 7, following CMS's 2.48% average 2027 payment increase.

summary: Coverage details the Express Scripts FTC settlement, continued FTC litigation against Caremark and OptumRx, new fee-disclosure rules and state laws separating pharmacy and PBM ownership.

summary: Alternative Credit Investor tallies 2026 deals, including Sun Life buying the remaining 49% of Crescent Capital for C$829 million and Nuveen's agreed acquisition of Schroders.

summary: Sequoia Financial Group acquired the Boulder and Denver firm, which had about $2.3 billion in client assets at mid-year; the same week saw Wealth Enhancement and Savant announce further tuck-ins.

headline: Travelers posts 86.8% combined ratio in Q3 despite 34% jump in catastrophe losses
summary: Pre-tax catastrophe losses rose to $538 million, but favorable prior-year reserve development and a strong underlying ratio kept profitability above last year's level.

headline: Cinven and La Caisse to take majority stake in specialty MGA Optio
summary: Insurance Times' weekly round-up notes the pair will buy into Optio from Preservation Capital Partners to back specialist underwriting and international growth.

summary: Gallagher Re data show 99.1% of capital went to AI-focused companies while early-stage funding fell about 52% quarter over quarter.

headline: Fidelity: assets of acquired RIAs nearly doubled in 2026
summary: Fidelity data show the median size of acquired RIAs rising from $517 million to $630 million even as first-half deal counts dipped 9%.

headline: Vertafore introduces four Velocity AI agents for insurance agencies
summary: The agents, now with early adopters, target agency workflows and are expected to reach general availability this year.

headline: Guidewire releases agentic framework for P&C insurers to build AI agents
summary: The framework lets carriers create and manage agents on Guidewire's cloud, with prebuilt agents for claim summarisation, policy changes and first notice of loss.

headline: Eleven payers exit individual Medicare Advantage market for 2027
summary: Becker's, citing CMS data, says Molina and Horizon BCBS NJ will remain only through special needs plans, while four new entrants arrive.

headline: Twelve health systems join collaborative to advance diagnostic AI
summary: A group of hospitals formed a consortium aimed at speeding diagnostic and imaging AI adoption.

headline: Becker's: OHSU halves late surgical cancellations with AI outreach
summary: A Becker's newsletter roundup also covers Cooper's nurse AI assistant pilot and 20 systems opting for Epic Health.

headline: AM Best to assess life and annuity segment at ACLI conference
summary: AM Best is scheduled to present its view on operating results, investment strategies and rating trends for the life and annuity segment at the ACLI Annual Conference in Orlando on Oct. 16.

headline: Commercial premium decreases accelerate to 2.0% in Q2, umbrella the exception
summary: The Council reports average commercial rates fell faster than in Q1, while umbrella pricing rose 5.3%.

summary: Preliminary filings in 16 states and DC show insurers citing a sicker risk pool after the enhanced subsidies lapsed.

summary: Medical cost ratio came in at 88.4% and adjusted EPS guidance rose to at least $20.50, though enrollment figures slightly disappointed analysts.

summary: An analysis of federal data finds roughly 11% of individual MA enrollees face plan discontinuations for 2027, with enrollment running through December 7.

headline: Target-date assets hit roughly $5.3 trillion at mid-year, with CITs now the majority vehicle
summary: Sway Research data show mutual fund and CIT target-date assets rose about 11% in the first half, with collective investment trusts holding 55% of the total.

summary: Property fell about 10% on ample capacity and a quiet hurricane season, while US casualty rates rose 6%, making casualty the only major line still firming.

summary: CRC's renewal index shows the pace of reductions beginning to moderate across July through September.

summary: The consultation paper would restore commission ceilings dropped in 2023; PB Fintech fell about 36% on day one and Turtlemint hit its lower circuit, with comments due 25 October.

summary: IRDAI's 23 September consultation floated tighter expense-of-management limits and payout caps; HDFC Life stock fell 6.2% the next day, while its September first-year premium rose 36% to about ₹4,000 crore.

summary: The payments network extends its Guidewire partnership, with its ClaimsPay solution planned for the Guidewire Marketplace in fall 2026.

summary: A stock exchange filing reported by UNI India shows Mishra stepping into the chief executive role from 6 October, with a later managing director appointment.

summary: The bank reads the slower decline as early stabilisation heading into 1/1 renewals; other surveys still expect further property reinsurance softening in 2027 absent a major catastrophe.

summary: The platform turns patient conversations into clinical notes across outpatient, inpatient and emergency settings.

headline: Prismic Life takes on roughly $5B of Prudential's Japanese whole life business via reinsurance
summary: Bermuda-based reinsurance platform Prismic Life agreed to reinsure part of Prudential Financial's recently written Japanese whole life policies, a deal reported at around $5 billion.

summary: The Labor Department's March proposal would give plan fiduciaries a process-based, rebuttable presumption of prudence when picking investments, including alternatives. It has no effect until finalized; law-firm analyses expect it to spur CIT-based alternative products.

summary: The FOMC held after September's quarter-point increase on a 10–2 vote, with markets now watching for a possible December move that would affect insurer investment yields and annuity crediting rates.

summary: The announcement describes agents spanning underwriting and claims; some capabilities are early access or roadmap. Details from a secondary write-up.

summary: FINTRX's quarterly activity report tallies the third-quarter deal flow, continuing the record dealmaking pace in advisor consolidation.

summary: Press reports say the Japanese group is exploring an acquisition worth upwards of A$20 billion in Australia. These are reports of talks, not an announced deal.

headline: Savant adds a third New York office with Socha, its ninth deal of 2026
summary: The deal keeps Savant the most active RIA buyer of the year.

headline: Health system CEOs name their biggest AI fears as ambient AI gets measured

summary: PLANSPONSOR's 2026 recordkeeping survey also finds 36 recordkeepers covering about 97% of the DC market. Publication date not stated in the result.
