summary: Envestnet relaunched its advisor trading experience alongside its third 2026 Adaptive WealthTech release, which added advisor-level opportunity grids and finer client segmentation.

headline: Lloyd's marks 40 years of Lime Street with new syndicates and new owners
summary: As the Lloyd's building turns 40, the market is opening Lime Street to managing-agency and broking staff from 18 to 25 November while a wave of new syndicates and ownership changes reshapes the market.

headline: Octave Partners: distribution, not tech alone, makes MGAs acquirable
summary: Octave's president told Insurance Business that broker loyalty and distribution depth separate commercially viable MGA targets; a separate tally counted 52 P&C specialty deals by 41 buyers through September 2026.

headline: Australia's insurance 'dealfest' raises odds of further buyouts
summary: Following a string of large approaches for Australian insurers and wealth groups, Insurance Business examines whether more take-private and foreign-buyer deals are on the way.

headline: Sedgwick launches Carrier and Captive Solutions unit
summary: The claims administrator created a dedicated offering for carriers and captives, drawing on 50-state workers' compensation capability and a platform handling about 1.2 million liability claims a year.

headline: Oliver Wyman: a narrower, more targeted 2027 Medicare Advantage market
summary: Oliver Wyman's November analysis finds 2027 MA plan exits concentrated in PPOs, with HMOs and special needs plans growing as insurers refocus on profitable segments.

headline: Four new carriers enter Medicare Advantage for 2027
summary: Becker's Payer Issues identifies four insurers launching MA plans for 2027 even as larger incumbents and several regional players pull back county footprints.

headline: UnitedHealthcare calls 2027 MA market competitive as it trims footprint
summary: UnitedHealthcare says it will further simplify its Medicare Advantage footprint for 2027 while emphasising $0-premium plans, according to Healthcare Dive.

headline: Payers' Q3 calls center on margin recovery, product exits and PBM overhaul
summary: Becker's rounds up third-quarter earnings commentary showing large insurers rebuilding margins by exiting unprofitable products and restructuring pharmacy benefit operations.

headline: Parkview Health to acquire Ovation Healthcare as Redesign Health and ARC Global merge
summary: Parkview agreed to buy hospital-management firm Ovation Healthcare, while Redesign Health and ARC Global combine, folding AI products and company-building capabilities into the arrangement.

headline: AIA New Zealand moves simpler police-scheme applications to automated underwriting
summary: AIA NZ now runs eligible applications in its NZ Police Association group scheme through a rules engine built on local insurtech Intelligent Life, accepting and issuing them without manual underwriter review; it did not disclose volumes.

headline: IRS lifts 2027 401(k) deferral limit to $25,500; IRA cap unchanged at $7,500
summary: The IRS's annual inflation adjustments raise the elective deferral limit for 401(k)-type plans by $1,000 for the 2027 tax year, while the IRA contribution limit holds steady.

headline: Prudential paper urges DC plans to make guaranteed lifetime income a default
summary: A Prudential white paper argues sponsors should build lifetime income into defined contribution plans automatically rather than as an opt-in, routing a portion of participant savings into annuity-based income.

headline: NAIC sizes U.S. insurers' private credit at roughly $1.21 trillion
summary: A new NAIC analysis estimates private credit under a broad definition at about 13% of insurers' cash and invested assets at year-end 2025, and says enhanced disclosures adopted in 2026 will sharpen classification in year-end 2026 filings.

headline: Analysts flag about $544 billion of hard-to-assess private credit on U.S. insurer books
summary: ThinkAdvisor reports analyst estimates that a large slice of insurers' private credit holdings is opaque, adding to scrutiny of how life and P&C portfolios value and disclose these assets.

headline: Raymond James picks up $18.7 billion and about 70 advisors via Pinnacle–Synovus deal
summary: Pinnacle Financial Partners is combining Synovus Securities with its own asset and wealth management arm under an expanded Raymond James relationship, adding the assets to Raymond James's financial institutions channel.

headline: Prudential Wealth Advisors posts record sales after adding 450+ experienced advisors
summary: Prudential's wealth unit reported record third-quarter sales and roughly $80 billion in client assets, crediting an 18-month recruiting push that drew advisors from Raymond James, JPMorgan, Ameriprise and Morgan Stanley.

headline: Intact to fold U.K. and European specialty lines into one London operation
summary: Intact plans to combine its U.K. and European specialty businesses into a single London-based unit from January 1, 2027, simplifying its international specialty platform.

headline: Safety Insurance shareholders back Mapfre's $1.54 billion takeover
summary: Stockholders approved the $105-per-share all-cash merger at a November 3 special meeting; closing still needs Massachusetts regulatory sign-off and is expected in Q1 2027.

headline: Selective's Q3 combined ratio improves to 96.8% despite heavier catastrophe losses
summary: Selective Insurance more than doubled underwriting income year on year as its combined ratio fell from 98.6%, even as cat losses and its expense ratio rose.

headline: Marsh agrees to buy Wilshire, adding a ~$1.6 trillion investment platform
summary: Marsh plans to acquire Wilshire to bolster its advisor-led wealth and investment capabilities, following its completion of the AltamarCAM purchase earlier in November.

headline: Self-funded employers take a carrier's ASO arm to court over claims administration
summary: TPA MedBen highlights a lawsuit in which self-funded employers challenge how a major carrier's administrative-services-only unit handled their plans' claims, a signal of rising fiduciary scrutiny of plan administrators.

headline: IRDAI overhaul nudges Policybazaar parent PB Fintech toward non-insurance services
summary: With India's regulator reworking commission and distribution rules, PB Fintech is leaning further into services beyond insurance broking to diversify revenue.

headline: Providers start suing employers, not insurers, to collect surprise-billing arbitration awards
summary: STAT reports an air ambulance operator is pursuing self-funded employers in court to force payment of No Surprises Act arbitration awards, opening a new front in out-of-network billing fights.

headline: Insurer exits and subsidy changes reshape choices in 2027 ACA open enrollment
summary: Healthinsurance.org notes several carriers are leaving state marketplaces, fewer lawfully present immigrants qualify for subsidies, and Oregon moves to its own enrollment platform as higher 2027 premiums hit shoppers.

headline: Integris Health to join Kaiser-backed Risant Health
summary: Oklahoma's Integris Health will become part of Risant Health, extending Risant's model of acquiring regional nonprofit systems while letting them keep local operations.

headline: Hospital deal activity opens November with a burst of transactions
summary: Becker's rounds up a cluster of early-November hospital and health system moves, including closings of previously announced affiliations, as consolidation momentum carries into year-end.
